Job.JobTitle: Manager, Digital GTM Business Capabilities & Performance - REMOTE
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Experience: 10+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Manager role at Siemens translating Digital GTM strategy into business requirements, leading capability delivery, and overseeing business acceptance testing. Responsible for digital business process governance, performance management, and cross-functional leadership across sales, product, and operations teams.

Good fit if you have experience with go-to-market strategy, business process management, and leading cross-functional teams in complex organizations.

Full job description

Company Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Manager, Digital GTM Business Capabilities & Performance to translate Digital GTM strategy into actionable business requirements and processes. This manager will collaborate with the Business Platform team to ensure new capabilities meet business needs, oversee Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), and monitor operational health and business performance of our global Digital Go-to-Market (GTM) business.

The successful candidate will translate Digital GTM strategy and operational priorities into executable business requirements, lead cross-functional capability delivery, govern critical business processes, establish performance management frameworks, and partner with Technology and Operations teams to ensure digital business continuity.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring strong business acumen, structured execution, analytical capabilities, and the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Digital GTM Business Capabilities & Delivery

• Translate Digital GTM strategy and operational priorities into business requirements, leading their definition, documentation, validation, and prioritization.

• Partner with the Business Platform Product team to ensure planned capabilities address business needs, monitor delivery progress, and escalate risks, dependencies, and gaps.

• Lead Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), including acceptance criteria, test scenarios, execution coordination, defect tracking, and end-to-end validation of digital sales journeys across Land, Expand, and Renew.

• Coordinate resolution of business-critical functional gaps and defects with responsible teams, and oversee business acceptance, sign-off, and go-live readiness.

• Ensure new capabilities are supported by appropriate business process documentation, operating procedures, and rollout readiness, collaborating with Digital Sales Programs & Enablement on communications and adoption.

• Monitor post-launch capability effectiveness, gather business feedback, and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency and business performance.

Digital Business Process & Operational Governance

• Own the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of selected business-critical Digital GTM processes, establishing clear procedures, controls, and accountabilities.

• Oversee the digital eligibility modeler and related business processes, including opportunity identification, eligibility criteria, transaction governance, and documentation of supported digital sales and renewal scenarios.

• Partner with Digital Sales Programs & Enablement to operationalize digital sales programs, translating program requirements into executable processes, business rules, and administrative procedures.

• Serve as the primary Digital GTM business counterpart to Digital Commerce Platform Operations, monitoring service performance, transaction failures, incident resolution, and adherence to agreed service levels.

• Assess the business impact of operational issues, coordinate escalations and corrective actions with Platform Operations, and support operational readiness and the transition of appropriate activities to the platform team.

• Drive process simplification, standardization, and automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and the digital sales experience.

Digital Business Performance & Analytics

• Own the Digital GTM performance management framework, establishing KPIs and reporting requirements to measure business health and progress against strategic objectives.

• Monitor financial and commercial performance, including GMV/TCV, ACV, ARR, GRR, NRR, revenue growth, transaction volumes, digital adoption, conversion, and renewal performance.

• Track operational health and efficiency through key indicators such as transaction success rates, cycle times, exception volumes, and platform service performance.

• Partner with the Analytics team to define reporting requirements, ensure data accuracy, and develop meaningful dashboards and performance insights.

• Analyze business trends, performance gaps, and the effectiveness of digital capabilities, sales programs, and process improvements to identify opportunities and recommend corrective actions.

• Lead recurring business performance reviews and deliver executive-level reporting, insights, and recommendations to support strategic decisions and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Delivery Accountability

• Build strong partnerships across Digital GTM, Product Management, Platform Operations, Sales, IT, and Analytics to align business priorities, capability requirements, and operational expectations.

• Establish cross-functional governance and accountability mechanisms to manage dependencies, monitor commitments, and facilitate timely issue resolution.

• Influence and constructively challenge stakeholders without direct authority, proactively escalating risks, delivery gaps, and competing priorities with clear business impact assessments and recommendations.

• Communicate strategic priorities, execution progress, operational risks, and business performance insights effectively to senior leadership, supporting informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

People Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, coach, and develop two direct reports responsible for Digital GTM business testing, system support, and process management.

• Oversee team activities across Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), business readiness, process design, documentation, governance, and retained operational responsibilities.

• Establish clear objectives, accountabilities, and performance expectations, while prioritizing resources across strategic initiatives, operational needs, and continuous improvement activities.

• Foster a high-performing team culture built on ownership, collaboration, analytical thinking, structured execution, and continuous improvement.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 7–10 years of experience in a B2B software environment, preferably in digital sales, digital commerce, business systems, or business transformation.

• Proven experience translating business priorities into system requirements and processes, including requirements documentation, Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), and business readiness.

• Strong cross-functional leadership experience, collaborating with Product Management, IT, and Operations, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage complex initiatives without direct authority.

• Demonstrated experience in business performance management, analytics, and KPI development, combined with strong people leadership and excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong understanding of B2B software business models, digital commerce, subscription sales, and Land, Expand, and Renew processes.

• Familiarity with Salesforce CRM, CPQ, and enterprise order-to-cash processes; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is desirable.

• Experience in business process mapping, requirements management, functional testing, and defect tracking.

• Proficiency in business analytics, subscription revenue metrics, and reporting tools such as Tableau and Power BI.

**May be open to candidates in other locations**

Export Control Compliance


This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

Work Authorization

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.


Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Translate project requirements, contract documents, and customer standards into complete control system design packages, including drawings, panel layouts, I/O lists, network architecture, bills of materials, sequences of operation, and commissioning documentation.

Demonstrate expertise in engineering, contracting processes, and design-build project execution by designing PLC and DDC control strategies for HVAC systems, central plants, critical environments, and process systems, while ensuring compliance with submittal requirements, documentation standards, equipment safeties, alarms, interlocks, and fail-safe operational requirements.

 · System Integration & Network Architecture

Develop automation network architectures and integration solutions utilizing platforms and protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, Proﬁnet, EtherNet/IP, Siemens APOGEE, Desigo, and other enterprise-level systems.

· Technical Coordination & Project Execution

Collaborate with programmers, project managers, commissioning specialists, ﬁeld technicians, contractors, consultants, and customers to ensure designs are executable, technical issues are resolved, and project objectives are achieved.

· Engineering Review & Quality Assurance

Review plans, speciﬁcations, codes, and customer requirements while performing design reviews, quality assurance checks, technical evaluations, and risk assessments to ensure compliance and project success.

· Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Serve as a senior technical resource by mentoring engineers, supporting standards development, managing design changes and re-estimates, and driving consistency and best practices across complex automation and industrial controls projects.

  • Experience collaborating with programmers and automation specialists to support implementation, commissioning, and ﬁeld execution of control systems.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred Qualifications: 


  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, or a related ﬁeld.

  • Experience designing control systems for data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, cleanrooms, central utility plants, or other critical environments.  Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical reviews, support engineering standards, and coordinate multi-discipline design teams.

Job.JobTitle: Head of Vertical Governance & Operations Foundational Sales
Job.JobDescription:
Location: Any Siemens location within United States

Department: FS V 

Job Grade: Senior Management 

Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time

Welcome to Foundational Sales – a new global organization at Siemens level. Our mission is to build ONE Sales Fabric: a consistent, scalable, and data-driven go-to-market foundation that empowers our Sales Units to win in their Verticals and markets – and that makes it easier for our customers to do business with Siemens. 

Our work spans six focus areas – Process and Data Domain, Sales Enablement and Activation, Digital Sales Channel, Vertical Governance and Operations, Partner Sales, and Demand Acceleration. Together, we create the shared standards, systems, and AI-enabled capabilities behind one coordinated face to the customer. 

Do you want to help redefine how a global tech company sells in the AI era? Then join us – and through radical collaboration and the "Together, unless" principle, help unlock the power of ONE. 

How you will make an impact with us as Head of Vertical Governance & Operations:

You will build and lead the global Vertical Governance & Operations organization, working across Sales Units, Global Vertical teams and corporate functions to turn Vertical strategy into measurable growth, stronger strategic-account performance and a more consistent customer experience. 

Shape Vertical strategy and governance 

  • Set the vision and operating framework for how Siemens shows up as ONE Tech Company in its priority Verticals, enabling Global Vertical teams to drive cross-Sales-Unit industry strategy and Sales Unit Vertical teams to execute in their markets. 
  • Establish the enterprise framework for prioritizing industry segments and determine how they are anchored across Siemens businesses. 
  • Define the governance, decision rights and ways of working that enable consistent Vertical execution while preserving clear business accountability. 
  • Shape the cross-business resource allocation framework for global industry teams, industry-related investments and market activation. 
  • Establish a common performance management and review cadence that connects Vertical strategy with execution and measurable business outcomes. 

Elevate strategic and global account excellence 

  • Shape and operationalize the global account framework, including account nomination principles and expectations for cross-Sales-Unit collaboration and joint selling. 
  • Establish a consistent approach to executive relationship management for Siemens' most strategic customers. 
  • Define the future direction of strategic account management, including role expectations, proficiency standards, accreditation and capability requirements. 
  • Partner with Sales Units and relevant functions to continuously strengthen the commercial engagement and incentive frameworks supporting global and strategic accounts. 
  • Enable account teams to bring together the breadth of Siemens' portfolio around customer priorities, creating a more coordinated experience for strategic customers. 

Drive Vertical performance and operations 

  • Establish common planning, KPI and performance-management disciplines across the global Vertical organization and strategic account portfolio. 
  • Create transparent, comparable performance reporting that enables leadership to steer Vertical growth, strategic-account performance and cross-business success. 
  • Establish the business requirements for intelligence, analytics and AI-enabled insights built on Siemens' common sales data infrastructure. 
  • Turn fragmented information into a consistent steering foundation that enables faster, more informed commercial decisions. 
  • Drive continuous improvement of the Vertical operating model as strategies, technologies and market requirements evolve. 

Activate cross-business growth 

  • Orchestrate the cross-business mechanisms that translate Vertical strategy into joint customer opportunities, market activation and differentiated industry propositions. 
  • Advance cross-business Digital Thread engagement by aligning businesses around shared sales assets, deployment approaches and foundational ways of working. 
  • Enable collaboration across businesses to advance high-value, differentiated industry scenarios and joint offers. 
  • Shape industry-specific market activation priorities together with Vertical and marketing teams, supporting coherent positioning and messaging across businesses. 
  • Influence the orchestration and investment of cross-business industry campaigns and maintain transparency on their performance. 
  • Support the growth of partner-enabled Vertical business by connecting Vertical priorities with partner, enablement and Digital Thread activities. 

Build the organization and lead through influence 

  • Build and lead a diverse, global Vertical Governance & Operations organization through its leadership team, creating the capabilities required to deliver the mandate. 
  • Develop strong talent across experience levels and grow the next generation of leaders. 
  • Establish effective interfaces across Sales Units, Global Vertical teams and functions, creating clarity where responsibilities span organizational boundaries. 
  • Lead through influence in a matrixed global environment, bringing senior stakeholders together around shared priorities and enterprise outcomes. 
  • Shape a culture of radical collaboration, accountability and commercial impact, turning ambition into measurable outcomes. 

What you bring 

We are looking for a senior leader with commercial experience who combines strategic perspective with the ability to turn ambition into execution in a complex global organization. 

  • Experience & Skills
    • Significant senior leadership experience in global sales, commercial transformation, industry/Vertical management or sales operations within a complex multinational organization.
    • Demonstrated track record of driving growth across business and organizational boundaries, setting direction and aligning senior executives around a shared commercial agenda.
    • Deep experience with industry-led go-to-market models and strategic/global account management, including executive-level customer engagement.
    • Proven ability to translate strategy into operating models, governance, performance management and scalable execution across multiple businesses, markets or functions.
    • Strong commercial and analytical capability, with experience using data, technology and AI-enabled insights to improve performance steering and decision-making.
    • Experienced people leader with a track record of building organizations, leading through other leaders and developing strong global talent 
  • Ways of working
    • You combine an enterprise mindset with commercial orientation, balancing what creates the greatest value for Siemens overall with the realities of individual businesses and markets.
    • You are a highly effective collaborator and influencer, able to create alignment across senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.
    • You are comfortable operating in a mixed greenfield and brownfield environment, building new capabilities while simplifying, harmonizing and improving what already exists.
    • You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity, momentum and accountability while structures and operating models continue to evolve.
    • You can move comfortably between strategy and execution, translating complex topics into clear choices and action. 
    • Experience in industrial technology, software or another complex technology ecosystem is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
  • Languages
    • High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus

About this job

Technical Marketing Engineer for Siemens EDA focused on Advanced IC Packaging solutions, particularly 2.5D and 3DIC design flows. Role involves developing technical marketing materials, building demonstration workflows using Tcl and Python, and engaging customers to translate design challenges into product solutions.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in 2.5D/3DIC design or EDA support, strong Tcl and Python scripting skills, and experience in customer-facing technical roles.

Full job description

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Summary

The Technical Marketing Engineer is responsible for driving technical marketing and solution development for EBS-centered offerings in the area of Advanced IC Packaging, with particular focus on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows.

This role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and use cases, and to translate them into solution-oriented workflows by connecting planning, layout, and verification tools using scripting technologies such as Tcl and Python. The ideal candidate will be able to engage customers in technical discussions, articulate solution value, and help shape future workflow directions, including emerging approaches that may involve agent-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver technical marketing materials such as videos, presentations, and lab/demo content for Advanced IC Packaging solutions.
  • Build and demonstrate solution workflows for 2.5D and 3DIC design by connecting multiple tools, including planning, layout, and verification tools, using Tcl and Python.
  • Engage customers in technical discussions to understand design challenges, workflow gaps, and use-case requirements.
  • Translate customer technical requirements and related business needs into actionable input for development teams.
  • Understand newly developed products and enhancement features, and communicate their technical value and applicability to customers.
  • Support the definition and evolution of solution concepts that address current and future customer workflows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams across product, development, and field organizations to align solutions with market needs.

Accountability / Expected Contributions

  • Understand the goals of each assigned project and the role expected within that project.
  • Proactively drive assigned responsibilities to support successful project execution and achievement of business objectives.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute effectively in project-based activities.
  • Help identify and shape future solution opportunities based on customer engagement and market direction.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in English.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in 2.5D / 3DIC design, Advanced IC Packaging, or technically supporting such flows from an EDA perspective.
  • Strong understanding of design workflows spanning planning, layout, and verification.
  • Practical scripting experience using Tcl and Python to automate or integrate workflows across multiple tools.
  • Ability to engage directly with customers in technical discussions and help define solution use cases.
  • Ability to use Linux as an end user in a business or technical environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products for business use.
  • Formal academic background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technical marketing, application engineering, solution engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept workflows, or presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with EDA solution positioning for semiconductor or packaging design customers.
  • Interest in emerging workflow technologies, including AI- or agent-assisted solution approaches.

Travel Requirements

  • Customer visits are required.
  • Domestic travel will be the primary travel requirement.
  • International travel may also be required occasionally.

Work Environment / Additional Considerations

  • This role requires collaboration with teams in Asia and Europe.
  • As a result, work may occasionally take place during early morning or evening hours to accommodate global collaboration.

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).  Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

We are looking for a Project Management Coordinator. This position will report into our Wendell, NC office and can be remote.

The Sr. Project Management Coordinator is responsible for independently and proactively overseeing and advocating Siemens’ interests for new customer proposals/contracts in the acquisition phase and supporting project implementation, including change orders, claims, and customer notices, including but not limited to commercial review and drafting of contract changes to proposals/customer contracts.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Conduct and coordinate commercial contract reviews and negotiations for Customer proposals and contracts (master agreements, blanket agreements, standalone contracts)
  • Coordinate interdepartmental reviews and changes to proposals and customer contracts, align stakeholders, and follow up on key issues to support timely proposal and customer contract decisions
  • Identify commercial risks, draft proposed changes to contract documents as required to ensure compliance with Siemens’ requirements, and communicate risks and required changes to proposal managers and proposal engineers in a timely manner
  • Prepare and maintain risk checklists, interdepartmental reviews, and management approval documentation, including legal/commercial risk categorization and PM notes, for stakeholder review and approval
  • Provide regular workload and productivity updates to the team and management.
  • Engage, advise and coordinate among internal groups to optimize Proposal & Customer contract outcomes. 
  • Review purchase orders for compliance with proposal management approvals and for conflicts with negotiated contract terms.
  • Onboard other Project Management Coordinators, including performance coaching, setting expectations, and distributing workload across the team.
  • Develop and deliver business partner training, playbooks, templates, and reference guides on contracts, commercial management, and contract review processes for Sales, A/E, Project Management, Commercial Project Management, Contract Management, and Proposal Management teams.
  • NDAs, Supplier Forms, SOWs, POs, supplier flowdowns, and other miscellaneous agreement requests – specific assignments may be adjusted depending on volume.
  • Support continuous improvement of contract processes and the development, evaluation, and adoption of department tools, templates, resources, CLM systems, and AI-assisted workflows, including prompt libraries, playbooks, and intake processes.
  • Support project execution by evaluating customer-directed changes, delays, suspensions, cancellations, and warranty/storage issues; prepare notices, customer correspondence, change order requests, and cost recovery positions that preserve Siemens’ rights while remaining commercially reasonable.
  • Manage supplier and customer flowdown requirements, including identifying applicable terms for the project.
  • Provide guidance and escalation support to proposal managers, project managers, and contract managers on contract interpretation, notice requirements, and contractual rights.
  • Perform other proposal/acquisition and project-implementation tasks as assigned by the manager.

You will win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, business administration, law, or other related field 
  • 5-8 years proposal and/or contract management experience specific to electrification and automation, energy, or construction industry 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills 
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation and organizational skills; ability to multi-task and shift focus as priorities change 
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis; Siemens will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visas for this position, now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expertise in contract management
  • Experience with CLM systems and AI-assisted contract review tools
  • Experience with claims, change orders, and delay/disruption matters
  • Knowledge provisions in commercial contracts
  • Familiarity with approval processes (Limits of Authority, risk assessment)
  • Strong analytical skills and understanding of contract terms, with the ability to assess risks and draft appropriate contract language.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex contract concepts to non-legal stakeholders, draft firm but customer-friendly correspondence, and communicate effectively with senior management, senior-level customers, and large audiences.
  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently and to allocate work among a team effectively in a highly matrixed, high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple complex contract generation and approval activities while meeting deadlines and schedules.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

Position Overview:

Ready to keep America's trains running strong? Siemens Mobility is hiring Rail Technicians at our Orlando, FL facility, with openings on 2nd or 3rd shifts. You'll be hands-on with the inspection, maintenance, and repair of a fleet of locomotives, coaches, and train sets, handling everything from day-to-day running maintenance to unscheduled repairs. Guided by maintenance instructions in our Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS), you'll help make sure every train is safe, reliable, and ready to roll. Shifts include weekdays, weekends, and holidays, and may occasionally flex to other shifts based on operational needs. If you take pride in your craft and want to be part of a team that keeps the railway moving, this is your opportunity!

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Follow all available maintenance instructions to keep every train in compliance and meeting high-quality standards.
  • Document every defect, task, and incident in the CMMS so issues are tracked, resolved, and closed out with a complete record.
  • Perform body, welding, and paint repairs on locomotives, coaches, and train sets to return equipment to service looking sharp and running strong.
  • Keep your workstation and work areas clean and debris-free for a safer, more efficient workspace.
  • Represent Siemens Mobility and build strong working relationships with our customer, creating trust and lasting partnerships.
  • Comply with all Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) safety rules, laws, and regulations to protect yourself, your team, and the public.
  • Partner with leadership on site issues, systems, and facility operations to solve problems quickly and keep operations running smoothly.
  • Willing to perform other functions as needed, including forklift operation and daily cleaning, to keep the team and the site moving forward.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with a railroad or in another technical field; relevant technical training may be considered with lesser work experience.
  • Strong preference for in-depth knowledge of the technical aspects of rolling stock and depot operations

Physical Demands/Facility Information

The physical demands described here are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential job duties:

  • Frequently walk, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Frequently required to climb stairs, steps, and ladders
  • Frequently required to work on elevated platforms.
  • Perform work overhead.
  • Occasionally lift and move at most 40 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus.
  • Pushing and pulling objects towards and away from origin of force.
  • Keyboarding on a computer or other machine by means of a traditional keyboard.
  • Gross and Fine Manipulation to include holding, grasping and pinching using hands and fingers.
  • Driving forklifts, golf carts, yard buggies etc.
  • The ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech and/or other sounds in person or via communication radio.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Candidates should be willing to work in non-climate-controlled environments and inclement weather if required or if applicable.

Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without needing current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Job.JobTitle: Enterprise AI Principal - Intelligence Center X
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote

About this job

Enterprise AI Principal leads complex, first-of-a-kind agentic AI engagements for major industrial companies using Siemens' Intelligence Center X platform. You design enterprise ontologies and agentic solutions, work hands-on with customer data, and help shape the product roadmap based on strategic customer needs.

Good fit if you have presales or consulting experience with enterprise AI, ontology modeling, agentic applications, and industrial software platforms like Databricks or Snowflake.

Full job description

Bring Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases.

About Intelligence Center X

Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.

Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.

How we engage with customers
Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer - on relevant data, against their problem - and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.

The role
Enterprise AI Principals are our most experienced ICX Presales engineers. You lead the ideation and creation of our most strategic customer engagements — modelling complex domains as enterprise ontologies, designing agents and machine learning that reason over them and act on them, and delivering agentic applications that compel customers to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.

This is a global role. You are based in the Americas, and you support opportunities worldwide within your areas of expertise. You:

  • Lead the most complex engagements - first-of-a-kind and hands-on, often combining ICX with Siemens' wider industrial software portfolio.
  • Set the standard - for how ICX is positioned and implemented, through reference architectures, patterns and value cases the field builds from.
  • Help shape the ICX roadmap - align roadmap and implementation, carry use cases and requirements back into product, and make what works repeatable. Identify and create opportunities for Siemens ICX R&D to work directly with lighthouse customers on new use cases.
  • Engage executives and strategic partners - build and defend the business case with senior customer stakeholders, mobilize Siemens leadership, and lead strategic partnerships with GSIs, ISVs and hyperscalers.
You work alongside sales leadership, our ICX Engineering teams, strategic partners and R&D.

An example engagement:
A manufacturer's leadership wants to know whether agentic AI can improve a mission-critical process that stretches across their enterprise. The use case has first-of-a-kind requirements, and the answer depends on connecting engineering, manufacturing, supplier and service data owned by four different organizations. You frame the ambition with the executive sponsor, architect the enterprise ontology and the agentic approach, and guide the team that builds it. Along the way, you bring in R&D to explore how the product can improve based on the customer's use case and requirements.

Who you are:
  • You are an experienced presales architect who is hands-on with agentic AI and ontology. You design end-to-end solutions, and you still build.
  • You lead at the executive level. You build and defend business cases with executives, and you can mobilize a large organization to unblock what a deal team cannot.
  • You build for reuse. Your patterns outlive your engagements, and others build on them.
  • You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined - with some of the largest companies in the world.

Skills and experience
We look for experience in the following areas:

  • Technical leadership on strategic enterprise accounts - leading complex, first-of-a-kind solutions with executive buyers.
  • Senior technical consulting - leading strategic agentic AI, data and analytics engagements for client executives at a consultancy or systems integrator.
  • Presales solution architecture - end-to-end design across enterprise ontology, agentic applications and machine learning.
  • Ecosystem positioning - showing where ICX is differentiated and where it complements the platforms a customer already has, so it fits their enterprise agentic AI architecture.
  • Data engineering and analytics - making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.
  • Modern data and AI platforms - experience working with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.
  • Agentic AI - designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.
  • Agentic development tools - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.
  • Enterprise ontology - modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.
  • Machine learning and data science - building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.
  • Industrial software - product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations or industrial IoT.
  • Industry depth - manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.

Travel
Some travel is expected, up to 25%. Global travel is possible, though not required. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.


Why us?
  • Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.
  • Shape the global practice. The standards you set become how ICX is built and positioned in every zone.
  • The problem every enterprise is working on. Agentic AI grounded in a company's own data and context.
  • Direct influence on the product. You lead the engagements that help shape the ICX roadmap.
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We’re committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

The Project Manager facilitates the execution of project/program solution plan for clearly defined sub-projects or sub-programs. This role requires the coordination and delivery of multiple, simultaneous projects considered small to medium in complexity with financial impact between $100K and $2.5M.

As a Project Manager, you will: 

  • Have fiscal responsibility for all project facets, including project billing, job cost reporting, and overall customer satisfaction. 
  • Be responsible for delivery of results for the respective process steps.
  • Guide technical or administrative staff.
  • Act as a functional process resource on projects or programs
  • Contribute to continuous improvement plan.
  • Perform active role in maintaining functionally focused client relationships.
  • Be responsible for several small projects.
  • Review project specifications, drawings and project-specific documents to establish project intent.
  • Develop and maintain a project schedule and coordinate needs with the project team. Identify time-sensitive installation needs.
  • Manage the requisition of supplies and materials to complete projects. 
  • Review plans and specifications and participate in project cost reviews.
  • Assist Operations Manager in the solicitation and contracting of subcontractors.
  • Conduct an orientation for project technicians and provide project documentation, including scope of work, drawings, applicable specifications, application-engineered drawings, project contacts, etc. 
  • Track resources and projects progress. 
  • Document project events that impact the schedule, scope of work, and project efficiency.
  • Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities. 
  • Coordinate and pursue project-specific billing; coordinate with Accounting team and Operations Manager. 
  • Schedule project-specific commissioning resources and provides commissioning documentation. 
  • Expedite the return of project-specific mark-ups for as-built development. 
  • Complete project-specific close-out documentation.
  • Effectively manage and coordinate subcontractors to meet scope, scheduling, and financial requirements.
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures; report unsafe conditions and actions.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience managing projects
  • Ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project 
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree 
  • Technical experience in the HVAC controls industry
  • 3+ years of technical experience in the HVAC controls industry
  • Knowledge and understanding of HVAC industry applications; ability to read and understand MEP drawings and specifications, and electrical, network, and control wiring diagrams
  • Knowledge of industry-standard communication protocols such as Ethernet, Modbus, and BACnet

About this job

Entry-level position servicing trains in Orlando, including fueling, refueling water tanks, sanitizing systems, and assisting with mechanical maintenance. Work includes 2nd or 3rd shifts on weekdays, weekends, and holidays.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, basic mechanical aptitude, can work nights and weekends, and are legally authorized to work in the US.

Full job description

Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Position Overview:

Ready to start a hands-on career where your work keeps trains moving? Siemens Mobility in Orlando, FL is looking for entry-level Train Service Technicians to join our team! As a key part of our maintenance crew, you’ll get trains clean, safe, and ready to roll by servicing locomotives, coaches, and train sets – emptying toilet systems, refilling water tanks, and fueling operations. You’ll help us uphold the highest safety and quality standards every step of the way. Positions are open on the 2nd or 3rd shift with a schedule that includes weekdays, weekends, and holidays. If you’re looking to get your foot in the door of the rail industry, this is your chance to hop on board!

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Perform basic train servicing tasks so trains are clean, safe, and ready for departure:
    • Empty and sanitize onboard toilet systems and refill water and windscreen washer tanks, keeping trains hygienic and fully stocked.
    • Refuel locomotives and connect trainsets to ground power, keeping equipment powered and ready for on time departures.
    • Clean HVAC components, supporting comfortable and reliable climate control.
  • Assist technicians with mechanical and electrical maintenance tasks as needed, helping keep repairs on schedule and trains available for service.
  • Follow Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) instructions and accurately log all tasks, defects, and incidents, ensuring reliable records and faster issue resolution.
  • Keep work areas and equipment clean and organized, creating a safe and efficient workspace.
  • Operate tools and equipment such as forklifts, cleaning systems, and basic hand tools to complete work safely and efficiently.
  • Support minor bodywork, welding, or painting tasks under supervision, helping return equipment to service-ready condition.
  • Follow all safety protocols and Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) regulations and communicate effectively with team members and supervisors, protecting your crew and keeping every shift running smoothly.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • High School Diploma / GED,
  • Basic literacy and numeracy skills to read instructions, complete checklists, and enter data in English,
  • Strong communication skills to report issues clearly and follow instructions in English,
  • Flexibility to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays,
  • Basic mechanical aptitude or a genuine interest in learning to use tools and equipment,
  • A commitment to following safety procedures and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE),
  • Reliable transportation to and from the work site.

Physical Demands/Facility Information

  • Frequently walk, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Frequently required to climb stairs, steps, and ladders

  • Gross and Fine Manipulation to include holding, grasping and pinching using hands and fingers.
  • Driving forklifts, golf carts, yard buggies etc.
  • The ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech and/or other sounds in person or via communication radio.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

The Energy Engineering Manager supports our growing EPS (Energy Performance Solutions) business. In this role, you will be responsible for all engineering activities for large performance contracting guaranteed energy savings projects within your area of responsibility. This position can be based out of any of our Southeast (FL, GA, NC, SC) branch locations. Work from home option is possible.

 As the Energy Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Oversee supervision of a small team (typically 3-7) of energy engineers
  • Manage EPS project engineering and project development. Guide engineering development within the business including: savings calculations, project cost estimates, development cost estimates, sales support, and implementation support.
  • Supervise engineering activities, manage engineers, manage labor utilization, and coordinate with sales team. Mentor teams through goal setting, employee review meetings, and project reviews.
  • Participate in all required project risk reviews and sales to operations turnover meetings. Review engineering design to verify proper application of engineering principles, code compliance, adequate safety factors for costs and savings, and proper documentation of scopes of work.
  • Develop engineering schedules and monitor progress to meet deadlines and budget. Determine resources needed to manage schedules.
  • Assist sales team in the identification and qualification of potential performance contracting projects
  • Develop preliminary and final performance contracting proposals. Analyze blueprints and perform site surveys to identify mechanical, electrical, and controls systems to determine facility operational characteristics.
  • Apply building energy calculations to develop energy, cooling, and heating load building models using accepted Siemens calculation models. Develop design concepts and schematics concerning recommended FIMs, including scope of work descriptions, code deficiency evaluations, savings potential, cost estimates, and data to verify FIMs.
  • Prepare financial models related to repayment, including Return on Investment (ROI), life cycle costs, and internal rate of return
  • Evaluate energy supply side savings opportunities, including trash management, co-generation, water conservation, and renewable technologies for including into performance contracts
  • Create performance assurance plans and assist with performance contracting contract writing
  • Monitor project performance, particularly those that guarantee savings
  • Independently manage energy and performance assurance plan development, implementation, and ongoing support
  • Independently manage site visits and proposal development
  • Utilize financial and monthly forecasting tools and work with other team members to monitor, manage, and control costs
  • Maintain business best practices, ensure LOA, and boundary conditions are adhered to
  • Execute at a minimum Monthly Project Coordination (MPC) meetings for assigned projects

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
  • Certified Energy Manager or Professional Engineer
  • Minimum of 5 years’ of Energy industry experience supporting performance based projects or energy services; Knowledge of energy supply side savings, and ability to evaluate savings potential.
  • Experience with energy savings calculations, international and/or local building codes, and IMVP performance assurance methodologies
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license with limited violations
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Certified Energy Manager or Professional Engineer

Company Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.


Position Overview

This globally focused role drives partner technical readiness and accelerates revenue growth by orchestrating high impact enablement programs for the Siemens Software partner ecosystem. The position transforms partner presales and technical teams into confident advocates for cloud based industrial software solutions.

Working autonomously (with guidance from the Global Team) with global scope, the successful candidate makes fast decisions on program priorities, serves as subject matter expert to Global Learning and Development teams on Partner requirements and needs, and coordinates energizing enablement experiences that partners value. The role delivers immediate results as partners apply training to win deals and grow their business with Siemens. About this job

Field Service Safety Expert position supporting Environmental, Health, and Safety programs for Siemens field service operations on electrical infrastructure systems. Role involves jobsite visits, hazard identification, safety coaching, and incident investigation with up to 75% travel.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in construction, industrial, or electrical field safety, know OSHA regulations and NFPA 70E, and can travel 75% to customer sites.

Full job description

Transform the everyday with us!

At Siemens, we enable sustainable progress through technology. We do this by empowering our customers and employees to combine the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today—and for the next generation.

We are looking for a Field Service Safety Expert. This position will be based in the United States (fully remote) with up to 75% travel. 

This role supports Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs for Siemens field service operations performing work on electrical infrastructure systems. The position provides a strong field safety presence across customer sites, partnering closely with field teams and leadership to reinforce safe work practices, identify risk, and intervene when necessary. The role is highly visible and plays a direct role in strengthening safety culture across a rapidly growing field organization.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Providing hands-on safety oversight and field support for Siemens Field Service Engineers, contractors, and project teams working on electrical distribution systems
  • Conducting scheduled and unannounced jobsite visits to identify hazards, verify controls, coach teams, and reinforce safe behaviors
  • Supporting installation, commissioning, inspection, and service activities involving medium- and low-voltage switchgear and other industrial electrical equipment
  • Verifying hazardous energy control, including lockout/tagout and Live–Dead–Live testing, and exercising stop-work authority when conditions are unsafe
  • Monitoring high-risk activities such as energized work, complex installations, lifts, and elevated work to ensure compliance with safety requirements
  • Participating in incident, near-miss, and safety investigations, including fact-finding and root cause analysis
  • Partnering with leadership to drive continuous improvement, strengthen safety culture, and reduce risk across field operations

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience with the following:
    • Construction, industrial, or electrical field safety environments
    • OSHA regulations and electrical safety practices, including NFPA 70E
    • Electrical power distribution systems or industrial electrical equipment
    • Hazard recognition, jobsite inspections, and field-based safety coaching
    • Incident investigation, documentation, and corrective action follow-up
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 75% to customer job sites
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Additional years of experience in construction, industrial, or electrical safety leadership roles
  • Experience supporting medium- or low-voltage switchgear installation, commissioning, or service activities
  • Certifications or training such as OSHA 30-Hour Construction, OSHA 510/511, CHST (or higher), NFPA 70E, Fall Protection Competent Person, or First Aid/CPR
  • Experience working in high-reliability or complex environments such as utilities, data centers, semiconductor facilities, or large industrial sites
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence safe behaviors, manage difficult conversations, and build trust with field teams

Siemens seeks a sales executive to develop fire alarm and life safety solutions business in the Tampa area. The role involves managing contractor and end-user relationships, achieving booking goals, and influencing new construction specifications.

Good fit if you have 2+ years in commercial fire alarm/life safety sales or 8+ years in similar commercial construction sales, with financial expertise.

Full job description

Position Location: This role supports our customers throughout the greater Tampa, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. Transform the everyday with us! 

 

The Solutions Senior Sales Executive (or Account Executive) is committed to supporting our Solutions (New Construction) business within our commercial Smart Buildings Total Fire Alarm & Life Safety Solutions team. In this role, you will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, authority having jurisdiction, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines.  Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customers will help them optimize and facilitate a safe, emergency-ready workplace. 

This position can be either a Sr. Sales Executive (mid-level) or an Account Executive (senior-level) based on directly related experience.

As a Solutions Senior Sales Executive/Account Executive, you will:

  • Understand market, competitor offerings, customers and decision influencers across the region, segments, and verticals within the region. Stay updated on automation, electrical, fire, mechanical, and IoT market trends.  
  • Develop a vertical market and account management plan for strategic growth. Identify new business opportunities and create “go-to-market” strategies for end-user customers.   
  • Maintain a qualified funnel of opportunities, achieve new order/booking and profit goals consistently.  
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams for excellent customer outcomes. Partner with other sales divisions for new projects and accounts.  
  • Attend industry-specific networking events; actively participate in professional organizations such as NFPA, NFSA, ASHE, NBFAA, AFAA, IFMA, SAME, 7x24, etc. to build a network of contacts and to represent Siemens in the market.  
  • Influence new construction specifications by developing relationships with consulting engineers and architects.   
  • Work jointly with the multiple levels of the customer’s organization to understand and document their business goals and success metrics.   
  • Perform customer site surveys to support the development of multi-offering estimates and proposals across a broad fire and life safety portfolio.  
  • Develop value-based proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations. Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale.  
  • Ensure a smooth sales-to-operations turnover and follow through on sold projects to ensure satisfactory completion. Maintain relationships with customers to ensure highest satisfaction levels and future business.   
  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends.   
  • Travel overnight up to 10% for training and business development.  

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:  

  • Senior Sales Executive (mid-level): 2+ years of sales or business development experience within the commercial fire alarm/life safety or similar commercial building construction industries (such a low-voltage); we will also consider candidates with technical experience in a customer-facing role (such as project management or technician) within the commercial fire alarm/life safety industry
  • Account Executive (senior-level): 8+ years of sales experience within the commercial fire alarm/life safety industry or similar commercial building construction industries (such a low-voltage)
  • Must be able to demonstrate financial expertise estimating and selling technical solutions and service product lines effectively and independently and account development and strategic sales skills  
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English 
  • Experience using Microsoft Office suite  
  • High School Diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering 
  • On-the-job experience with common fire and life safety systems and equipment and experience with building fire alarm codes and standards (IFC, IBC, NFPA, etc.) 
  • NICET Certification
  • Experience selling to electrical and general contractors and performing fire alarm design services with electrical/fire protection engineers  
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM  

 

Ready to create your own journey? Join us today!

About this job

Presales Solution Consultant supporting software sales for Tecnomatix discrete event simulation solutions across the U.S. Lead customer engagements, deliver technical demonstrations, and mentor junior consultants while working remotely with up to 60% travel.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of discrete event simulation experience, understand manufacturing planning, and are legally authorized to work in the USA without visa sponsorship.

Full job description

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview

This position is to join a team Presales Solution Consultants aiming at supporting customer engagements in Americas with the main focus being U.S.

As part of a Software Sales organization, participate in or lead relevant PreSales processes to facilitate sales of software with a focus of landing new customer business, support the customer in adopting the solution and expanding the install base at existing customers.

Leading conversations to gather customer business and technical requirements, existing information technology infrastructure and determine customer business needs.

Applying knowledge of customer business needs, engineering and manufacturing processes, industry best practices and competitive differentiation, support product and solution positioning by preparing and delivering demonstrations of the technical capabilities of the proposed solutions to customers using

customized and standard material.

Speak with authority on our customer's business challenges, and how DI SW can improve their business using messaging tailored to the customers context and industry, aligned with the Account Orchestrator. Typically works under self-management.

Mentor less experienced PreSales Solution Consultants.

Responsibilities

• Lead sales pursuit milestones for medium to large engagements in collaboration with AO and TAM teams.

• Conduct assessments of prospect businesses and provide strategic recommendations.

• Serve as Subject Matter Expert for DI SW business value and value propositions in the Tecnomatix solution domain.

• Develop comprehensive technology proposals and lead Proof-of-Concept activities with customers.

• Bridge customer needs with product development and marketing teams.

• Facilitate seamless transition from PreSales to the Delivery Services team.

• Gather and analyze customer business and technical requirements.

• Contribute to PreSales Standard improvements and industry best practices development.

• Serve as country/vertical subject matter expert and mentor to other GSCS team members.

• Provide coaching and guidance to PSCs in technical demonstrations and storyboard development.

NOTE: Applicants must not require employer sponsored work Visa authorization, now or in the future for employment in the USA. This would include H1B, TN, OPT, F1, etc. Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the USA.


Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

·         7+ years of hands-on experience with discrete event simulation software used to model, simulate, analyze and optimize production systems. 

·         Strong understanding of object-oriented simulation modeling and inheritance to efficiently scale and maintain simulation models.

·         Experience integrating simulation within the Siemens Xcelerator portfolio, such as Teamcenter, NX, Heeds, Optimize MyPlant, and Digital Twin Composer.

·         Knowledge of Virtual Commissioning concepts and interfaces, such as PLCSIM Advanced, OPC UA, MQTT, and Socket communication.

  • Previous industry experience or experience in presales or delivery services/consulting roles
  • Understanding of the Manufacturing Planning domain
  • Ability to deliver structured and value-based presentations to all organizational levels, including department leaders and executives
  • Self-motivated to effectively support working remotely (virtual office)
  • Self-directed learning, proactivity, teamwork, adaptability, and a growth mindset
  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities in complex environments
  • Effective consultative interpersonal communication skills
  • Experience with Python programming languages
  • Bachelor's degree (completion of an engineering or scientific discipline)
  • The job will require traveling up to 60% of the time
  • High proficiency in English (spoken and written)
  • Must currently reside in the continental USA (This is a firm requirement)

Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience


  • Knowledge of Siemens software portfolio for Manufacturing planning: NX Line Designer, Teamcenter, Process Simulate, Optimize my Plant, Digital Twin composer, Heeds.
  • Knowledge of point cloud scanning, post-processing, and their areas of application in Digital Manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of Siemens OpSoftware portfolio: Opcenter Execution, Siemens Digital Logistic, Insight Hub
  • Expertise in artificial intelligence and agentic AI solutions

Our Building Automation System Specialist – Data Center Programming position creates and provides a complete programming package to the project team. As a Building Automation Systems Specialist, you will:

  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability and willingness to differentiate types/colors of wire, use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet and the ability to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be willing and able to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field
  • 1+ years of experience with Building Automation and HVAC systems

Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.  

As a Siemens Construction Program Manager, you will lead and manage a cross functional program delivery team to scope, design, procure, install and commission an advanced, digitally integrated manufacturing capability.  You will establish and communicate clear program priorities and program activities.  This role is the primary point of contact to align the customer, stakeholders, and the multiple Siemens business unit delivery teams.  
    
As part of the Advanced Manufacturing Plant Construction team, you will lead, guide and work with multi-functional Project Managers integrating their team’s efforts to achieve a successful result for the Customer.  

Responsibilities:
•Manage the Advanced Manufacturing Construction Program through the Project life cycle, leveraging industry standard project management framework 
•Lead Program wide governance approach. Coordinate with scope specific Project Managers to execute project governance.  
•Manage customer requirements and program scope to achieve program objectives, effectively coordinating project expectations with customers and stakeholders in a timely and concise fashion.    
•Manage and combine individual subproject schedules into an integrated Master schedule, coordinating interdependencies between sub-projects to ensure on time delivery.   
•Manage cross functional, multi-team configuration and deployment activities including software, industrial equipment manufacturers and Facilities experts.  These team members will be coordinated to complete the design, procurement, installation, configuration, validation, and acceptance of the facility improvements and planned Manufacturing Capabilities.
•Work with third-party contractors to ensure overall program execution and success including site safety planning, material ordering coordination, and solution/system validation. 
•Provide program management activities to control scope, cost, schedule, and quality across all sub elements.   
•Define and execute required processes in alignment with stakeholders including appropriate communication to all levels.
•Perform program quality management, ensuring that the solution meets contractual requirements and is to the appropriate quality and management compliance for industry or customer protocols, regulations, and standards.   
•Perform program reviews and retrospectives regularly and present the results and lessons learned to the program and organization.
•Ensure the projects in the program are meeting the approved budget and agreed margin and are reviewed on a regular basis.   
•Conduct Stakeholder meetings to manage and guide stakeholders through scope clarification, design review and installation activities
•Set the standard and maintain project artifacts such as status, risk, issues, opportunities (RIO), schedule or IMS, decision log, program management plan, safety plan, FMEA, CAP, or other artifacts as needed to support project rigor as required by customer or industry standards.
•Confidence creating and presenting content to all levels of management, both internal and external.  
•Coordinate difficult scope, cost, resource conversations with customers.  
•Lead successful project closeout and successful user-acceptance and adoption of deployed project capability; or participated in customer witness tests or similar events, industrial equipment validation and start up procedures.  Coordinate integration of all Systems 
•Manage contract acceptance and handover of projects to the customer. Develop proactive closeout procedures to avoid extended on site durations.
•In conjunction with Engagement Management, identify, and create new opportunities and renewals for current projects/programs.   
•Mentor and support the development of team members.

•Bachelor’s degree in any accredited Engineering, Technology, or equivalent years of experience (8+) in technical fields of work.
•Eight to ten years in a project manager/leadership role, guiding a cross-functional team of project managers and consultants during significant facility or industrial equipment implementation.
•Eight to ten years of experience working in a US Federal Government customer-facing environment with a focus on USACE/NAVFAC Construction processes. Including US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies, procedures and quality and safety programs.

•Product Scheduling experience with Critical path method schedules using MS Projects, Primavera or similar software.
•Demonstrated experience operating within an industrial setting such as a plant, shop, building infrastructure, shipboard, or other industrial setting.

•Leadership skills and proven track record of leading multi-disciplinary teams, including services

Job Title: Learning Portfolio Consultant (f/m/d) 
Department: Sales Enablement & Activation 
Location: Flexible / Siemens Global

Overview 

Sales Enablement & Activation defines and governs the sales motion architecture, orchestrates adoption and change for all tool rollouts and process changes, and designs shared standards and content for cross-unit enablement – unlocking cross-unit value and turning strong local capabilities into shared, scalable enterprise advantage. 

Within it, Sales Enablement defines enablement design standards and partners with SMEs and Sales Units to create sales-specific cross-unit content – governing what content exists, where it lives, and when it is used, while consolidating, standardising, and retiring low-value material to keep the sales asset base focused and current. 

The Big Picture

As our Learning Portfolio Consultant, you will own, govern, and streamline our cross-unit enablement catalogue. You will be the architect of portfolio clarity—turning local materials and central assets into a lean, credible, and easily accessible enablement engine that empowers sales teams globally.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Build the Single Source of Truth: Establish and maintain the comprehensive cross-unit enablement catalogue—mapping existing learning assets across all Sales Units and mapping them against real sales roles and skill baselines.
  • Rationalize & Reduce Overload: Hunt down overlap, duplication, and conflicting materials. Partner with stakeholders to consolidate resources, retire low-value assets, and keep our content landscape clean and high-impact.
  • Drive Content Governance: Apply lifecycle frameworks to audit currency and relevance. Coordinate regular reviews with content owners to ensure everything in the catalogue is up-to-date and tied directly to active sales motions.
  • Collaborate Across Boundaries: Engage with Sales Units, subject matter experts, and regional teams to build shared visibility and ensure local innovations feed into our broader enterprise advantage.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Portfolio Expertise: Hands-on background managing, auditing, and rationalizing learning or content portfolios at scale across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Governance Know-How: Deep familiarity with content lifecycle management—knowing how to review, consolidate, and gracefully retire out-of-date assets.
  • Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to map learning content against competency frameworks and role catalogues to spot coverage gaps instantly.
  • A Builder's Pragmatism: You thrive in a greenfielding environment where frameworks are still taking shape. You know how to apply structure and drive momentum without waiting for perfection.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional coordination and influencing skills across time zones, backed by high proficiency in written and spoken English.

 

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you! 

Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as level 8(GRIP level).
