Job.JobDescription:
Position Location: This role is remote and will support the Central Region, which includes ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, MN, IA, MO, AR, WI, MI, IN, and IL. The Central BDM will need to live in territory. 

  

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.    

Transform the everyday with us!


The Business Development Manager (Software & Digital Services) is Smart Infrastructure Buildings' primary industry developer supporting software and digital services. The role identifies, activates, and advances digital opportunities across assigned markets and accelerates proactive growth through net-new, area-sourced pipeline and installed-base activation. 

Business Development Managers provide opportunity support and work in close coordination with National Business Managers who build seller readiness. They may be deployed by industry or market segment and geography. Success is measured by the quality and velocity of pipeline created, while assigned sellers retain ownership of closing transactions. 


As a Business Development Manager (Software & Digital Services), you will:

  • Industry Development and Market Penetration
    • Develop deep expertise in assigned industry segments and the digital needs of customers within those markets. 
    • Identify and map installed-base accounts with inactivated digital opportunities. 
    • Build relationships with economic buyers, facilities leaders, sustainability officers, and other key stakeholders to drive demand with Area teams. 
    • Represent the SI Buildings digital portfolio with credibility and authority at the industry level. 
  • Pipeline Generation and Opportunity Creation
    • Own area-sourced pipeline creation as the primary measure of success, with pipeline coverage expectations aligned to assigned digital targets. 
    • Identify, qualify, and advance net-new digital opportunities across assigned markets and accounts. 
    • Execute growth activation campaigns targeting installed-base segments and underserved markets. 
    • Maintain accurate, current opportunity data in CRM and consistently demonstrate strong pipeline hygiene. 
  • Growth Acceleration and Seller Handoff
    • Engage directly in early-stage opportunity development to create momentum, then transition execution to the assigned seller. 
    • Establish clear handoff protocols with Sales Managers to support opportunity continuity after transition. 
    • Provide market intelligence and deal context that helps sellers advance opportunities to close. 
    • Reinforce digital rules of engagement in every seller interaction as a peer holding the standard. 
  • Digital Growth Behaviors and Collaboration
    • Model and reinforce sustainable digital growth behaviors, including ownership, urgency, and customer-first engagement. 
    • Participate in digital business reviews with Area leadership, National Business Managers, and the Head of Software & Digital Services Growth. 
    • Contribute market and competitive intelligence that informs enterprise growth strategy. 
    • Share best practices across the Business Development Manager team to raise collective performance. 
  • Role Boundaries
    • Partner with National Business Managers on seller readiness, onboarding, and digital coaching rather than owning those activities. 
    • Create and advance opportunities and coach through close while preserving seller ownership of the transaction. 
    • Avoid becoming a substitute for seller digital ownership. 
    • Coordinate technical product demonstrations with technical specialists or NBMs. 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, technology, marketing, or a related field, or a comparable combination of education and relevant experience. 
  • 3+ years of experience in business development, industry sales, digital sales, or a comparable customer-facing role in a complex environment. 
  • Must be able to demonstrate:
    • CRM discipline and a data-driven approach to market and pipeline management. 
    • Ability to translate customer needs into credible digital opportunity and value positioning. 
    • Ability to proactively create and advance pipeline. 
    • Relationship-building and influencing skills in a matrixed organization 
    • Communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage and motivate sales teams 
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time within the assigned market and nationally as business needs require. 
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Will need to reside in the central territory (or willing to relocate): ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, MN, IA, MO, AR, WI, MI, IN, and IL

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry knowledge in commercial real estate, healthcare, education, government, industrial, or data centers. 
  • Experience with digital services, software-enabled solutions, IoT, analytics, or connected-building offerings. 
  • Experience on a sales team within SI Buildings, Siemens, or the Buildings market. 
  • Experience activating installed-base opportunity and coordinating clean opportunity handoffs to field sellers.

Quick facts

About this job

Customer Solution Architect for Siemens' Digital Industries portfolio in chemicals, glass, and energy sectors. Remote role supporting vertical sales teams by driving adoption of automation and digitalization solutions, with focus on oil and gas value chain expertise.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in technical sales or solution consulting for industrial automation, deep knowledge of oil and gas operations, and strong customer advisory skills.

Full job description

Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people ﬁrst. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

As a Customer Solution Architect within Sales Acceleration, supporting the Chemicals, Glass and Energy, you will be a key individual contributor reporting to the Manager of Sales Acceleration, Chemicals, Glass and Energy. You will empower vertical sales teams and customers by driving adoption of Siemens' Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a focus on automation and digitalization solutions. This role maximizes solution and product sales by applying the Digital Thread methodology and leveraging the Challenger Sales Approach to deliver meaningful customer outcomes, and accelerating their realization. You will translate customer insights into effective, cost-efficient solutions that align with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model, serving as a trusted advisor to vertical sales teams and customers.

This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the continental US.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Expertise across the oil and gas value-chain: Have a firm and thorough understanding of one/more of the U.S. upstream (onshore, offshore), midstream (Pipelines, LNG) and Refinery value-chain. Key aspects of knowledge/expertise should reside in understanding the industry value-chain, customer segmentation, budget centers, competitive insights, product-market fit analysis and track record in positioning/selling automation and software related engagements across Tier I, II and III operators.
  • Solution Development & Architecting: Translate complex customer challenges into clear, actionable requirements and work to deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that meet their evolving needs.
  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently drive and apply a Sales Engagement Model with your assigned accounts to achieve the sales acceleration targets.
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as a primary technical and strategic advisor to customers and internal sales teams, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens' cutting-edge technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management in the Zone, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities.
  • Market & Customer Identification: Identify key and emerging markets and support the definition and identification of target customers across the Digital Industries Automation portfolio nationwide.
  • Assessing portfolio/productmarket fit for the instrumentation portfolio: Having a strong knowledge on process industries is essential as you will own the process of portfolio fit with strategic customer markets that have a high willingness to buy. 

You’ll win us over by having the following qualiﬁcations: 

Basic Qualiﬁcations:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Strengthening the familiarity with the automation ecosystem in the oil and gas market. 
  • Identify opportunities to co-create reference architectures, standards, preferred vendor positions, and reusable engineering approaches that increase Siemens specification rates.
  • Familiar with key Tier I, II and Tier III oil and gas operators.
  • Leverage industry relationships, market knowledge, and professional networks to expand Siemens' visibility and credibility throughout the oil and gas ecosystem.
  • Translate Siemens' automation, instrumentation, digitalization, and software portfolio into solutions that help oil and gas projects. 
  • Lead technical strategy and value messaging that aligns Siemens capabilities with the unique needs of process industries such as Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, and Energy Transition projects. 
  • Drive cross-business-unit collaboration to present a unified Siemens solution strategy spanning Process Automation, Instrumentation, Digital Industries Software, Industrial Communications, AI, and Digital Twin offerings.
  • Experience working with End Users, primarily in process and energy-oriented industries, such as oil and gas, chemicals, hydrogen, carbon capture, LNG to name a few
  • Technical expertise in Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies to solve complex customer problems
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industrial automation market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation
  • Exceptional customer interaction, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a strong customer-centric approach
  • Experience with various project collaboration models and sales processes
  • Excellent verbal, written and time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 35%, with occasional international travel
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States permanently, without company sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • 10+ years of experience in process automation, industrial digitalization, ecosystem business development, solution consulting, application engineering, or technical sales. 
  • Existing relationships within U.S. based oil and gas operators, EPC’s and solution partners to aid in the industry growth for Siemens. 
  • Experience supporting automation and software projects in oil and gas during concept, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, or commissioning phases. 
  • Deep familiarity with one or more CGE segments including Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Energy Transition, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, or related industries. 
  • Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and influence technical standards before projects reach the bid stage. 
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage both C-suite leaders and hands-on engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineer, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape
  • Organizational Agility: Knows how to get things done through formal and informal networks. Works effectively in a matrix structure to exploit opportunities. Rallies the team behind the right opportunities and initiatives
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment

Fire Inspectors play a vital role in preventing, detecting, and mitigating the impact of fires. You will perform tasks such as minor repairs and visual and functional testing on fire alarm systems in accordance with all national and local standards. In addition to your primary responsibilities, you will also act as a mentor, providing on-the-job training to entry level fire alarm inspectors, fostering a culture of growth and knowledge-sharing within our team.  Our fire inspectors significantly contribute to public safety, property protection, and overall emergency preparedness.

As a Fire Inspector, you will:

  • Follow and maintain high structured inspection schedules providing inspection, testing, and performing minor service and deficiency repairs for fire alarm equipment to comply with NFPA72 standards as well as state and local codes. Note deficiencies, remedies, and review pricing with customers. Complete service ticket documentation before leaving the customer site. Follow-up on corrective actions
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of all tests performed. Generate reports within Siemens tools and upload to city municipality websites
  • Provide instructions to customer personnel regarding proper operation and routine inspections. Assist with training
  • Work overtime when needed, and maintain stock, tools, and equipment in vehicles
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures
  • Complete required training and certifications within the time requirements for this role


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 1+ year of experience performing Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance (ITM) of Fire Alarm and/or Fire Life Safety Systems or low voltage electrical or mechanical experience
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of environments in and around mechanical and electrical equipment, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high-lift equipment, working in ducts, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions; use hand tools, laptop (Microsoft proficient), email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be able to differentiate types/colors of wire
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Must obtain NICET Fire Alarm Certification Level I within 12 months

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field preferred
  • 3+ years’ experience performing Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance (ITM) of Fire Alarm and/or Fire Life Safety Systems
  • Ability to read/understand design and construction documents

Job.JobDescription:

The Siemens Electrification and Automation business provides power distribution systems and service solutions that help customers improve the reliability, safety, and performance of their electrical infrastructure.

We are looking for a Project Manager, Customer Services to join our Project Management Office. In this customer-facing role, you will lead service projects from initiation through final closeout while managing safety, scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and customer expectations.

You will work across a matrixed organization and coordinate with engineering, field service, commercial, finance, vendors, contractors, and customers. This position may be performed remotely or based in Wendell, North Carolina, with travel required approximately 10% to 25% annually.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Directing all phases of assigned service projects from initiation through completion, including project planning, execution, monitoring, closeout, and lessons learned.
  • Managing project scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, resources, revenue forecasting, and overall performance while developing recovery plans when projects are not meeting expectations.
  • Identifying project risks, including potential safety risks, and developing mitigation strategies that support the safe and successful completion of service activities.
  • Communicating project milestones, field activities, financial status, risks, changes, and performance updates to customers, project teams, leadership, finance partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinating internal and external resources, including engineering teams, field service personnel, vendors, suppliers, consultants, and contractors, to support project requirements and site schedules.
  • Managing contractual requirements, change orders, claims processes, supplier agreements, requests for quotation, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Project and system experience may include:

  • Installation, commissioning, maintenance outage testing, electrical retrofits, and electrical system emergency response or disaster recovery.
  • Turnkey, design-build, and engineer-procure-construct projects.
  • Power system studies and field service projects involving internal teams and third-party suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Low-voltage and medium-voltage air-insulated switchgear, medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear, switches, panelboards, and automatic transfer switches.
  • Transformers, motor control centers, medium-voltage contactors, integrated electrical house systems, cable systems, busways, connectors, and supporting systems.
  • Solar photovoltaic systems, inverters, battery systems, and related electrical infrastructure.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 5+ years direct project management experience supporting service projects involving low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • 3+ years experience working in field service operations or a field service environment, such as a field service technician, engineer, project manager, or project specialist.
  • Demonstrated experience with low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10% to 25% annually.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction management, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional certification. If not currently certified, ability to obtain the certification within one year of employment.
  • Project management experience in electrical switchgear field service, engineer-procure-construct projects, construction, energy, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams that include engineering, field service, commercial, finance, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Experience interpreting project contracts and managing change orders, claims, liquidated damages, specifications, supplier scope, schedules, and budgets.
  • Experience using Microsoft Project to develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules.

Lead digitalization and AI strategy for Siemens Smart Infrastructure Finance Operations across North American factories. Develop and execute finance operations digitalization initiatives, coordinate data analysts, and drive analytics and automation projects to improve financial transparency and performance management.

Good fit if you have 8-10+ years in finance and digitalization, expertise in SAP FI/CO and tools like Tableau or Snowflake, and manufacturing experience.

Full job description

Senior Business and Digitalization Professional


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Join our Smart Infrastructure (SI) team as our Senior Business and Digitalization Professional to help us to successfully manage all digitalization and AI strategy and projects across our network of factories. The successful candidate will report to the Electrical Products Finance Operations Manager of Governance and Performance Controller, partner closely with the Head of Finance, North America Operations, Fin. Director of Operations, Systems, EP NA Factories, the Segment Fin teams and other functions while owning and improving digitalization transparency to improve accuracy of books and records, planning and controlling, measuring the achievement of KPIs and driving improvement projects



We are looking for Senior Business and Digitalization Professional. This position will be based preferably at Peachtree Corners, GA or at one of our US Plant locations, Remote work would also be considered.

You’ll make an impact by:


  • Lead the Digitalization and AI agenda for EP NA Finance Operations across the North American factory network, with a focus on improving financial transparency, performance management, governance, and productivity.

  • Develop and execute the Finance Operations Digitalization and AI strategy, translating business needs into scalable solutions.

  • Coordinate and align Data Analysts and TEA Coordinators across the plant finance network to promote common standards, methodologies, and solutions.

  • Partner with Finance, Operations, and technical teams to implement dashboards, automation, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases.

  • Lead standard and ad hoc analytics, Digitalization and AI projects, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Develop management presentations, business reviews, and decision proposals that translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert, providing governance, guidance, and best practices for reporting, analytics, Digitalization, and AI.

  • Continuously improve business intelligence and reporting solutions to increase transparency, standardization, efficiency, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Analyze business performance against targets and identify emerging trends, risks, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.

  • Lead fact-based performance discussions with factories and key stakeholders to drive accountability and business results.

  • Provide backup support across Finance Operations Governance and Performance Controlling and support additional strategic priorities as needed.


Key Competencies

  • Digitalization & AI Leadership

  • Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Strategic & Analytical Thinking

  • Financial & Performance Controlling

  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

  • Project & Change Management

  • Executive Communication

  • Process Improvement & Standardization

  • Stakeholder Management & Influencing

  • Continuous Learning & Innovation

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS in Accounting, Finance and/or Data Science

  • 8-10 years’ experience in Finance and Digitalization/AI, preferably in a manufacturing plant environment (*depending on level)

  • Very strong in depth knowledge of Digitalization, AI, automation tools (Tableau, Knime, Snowflake etc), SAP (FI/CO)

  • Strong Networking-, Collaboration- and Stakeholder Management skills

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Project Management Skills and Experience / Change Management experience

  • Solution oriented thinking and ability to practically apply methodic approaches to overcome business challenges

  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines, prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience and in-depth know how of large and complex manufacturing environments

  • Comprehensive SCM- and manufacturing process understanding (beyond finance)


Job Level Disclosure

*This position will be posted and hired at one of two job levels based on candidate qualifications and experience in a related field and successful demonstration of Key Responsibilities and Knowledge as presented above

Level 6: Requires a minimum of 8+ years of applicable professional experience- Salary Range: $91,463-$156,794

Level 5b: Requires a minimum of 10+ years of applicable professional experience- Salary Range: $109,670 - $188,006

About this job

Area Head of Finance for Siemens Smart Buildings in Miami or Orlando, Florida. Hybrid role requiring minimum 3 days onsite, serving as commercial partner to branch managers while overseeing financial performance, accounting activities, and strategic initiatives across assigned areas.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance, 6+ years of accounting/finance experience, and strong knowledge of GAAP/IFRS and internal controls.

Full job description

Area Head of Finance

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way our business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Area Head of Finance  works to meet business goals while partnering with area, sales and operations managers, project/service teams, Finance and Business Administration (FBA) colleagues, and auditors. This position is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days onsite and can be located in Orlando or Miami, FL.


As an Area Head of Finance, you will:

  • Acts as commercial partner to the Branch Managers and assumes responsibility for Area financial performance. Along with Branch management, is responsible for the Area’s financial performance including P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.
  • Leads, manages, and oversees finance, accounting, and business administration activities for all SI RSS Businesses.
  • Responsible for assigned Areas’ day-to-day business transactions and strategic initiatives in strong collaboration with Area GMs and drives, implements and monitors in cooperation with the Branches Management – productivity initiatives to further improve profitability and competitiveness.
  • Partners with Commercial Project Managers, Sales, and Operations Managers on large, more impactful projects in the Areas to ensure adequate project controlling.
  • Ensure compliance with external and internal accounting and reporting guidelines and operational Area performance (operational balance, slip, absorption, & utilization).
  • Area cost center controlling and Mentor/lead Commercial Project Managers and other team members as applicable, as well as participate in special projects related to either the local business or in support of field or home office initiatives.
  • Analyze and report financial risks, opportunities, inconsistencies, and potential fraud indicators to Branch/Region Finance and Business Administration leadership.
  • Monitor operating expense controls and recommend cost-savings and continuous improvement actions to support financial performance goals.
  • Oversee inventory valuation by maintaining sound financial control policies, procedures, and reporting practices.
  • Provide financial guidance and support to enable high-quality employee performance, development, and accountability.
  • Deliver or coordinate financial training for sales, operations, and finance teams to strengthen understanding of policies, procedures, and controls that impact the integrity of the P&L and Balance Sheet.
  • May manage, directly or indirectly, employees performing finance and accounting functions in the region.
  • Participate in special projects supporting local business priorities, field operations, or home office initiatives.
  • Support contract execution and review contract terms to provide financial guidance, improve Net Working Capital, and mitigate contractual risk.
  • Serve as a company representative and liaison with customers and local authorities to build productive relationships and reinforce a positive Siemens Smart Buildings image.

About this job

Design and architect large-scale AI, HPC, and cloud infrastructure for Siemens' AI Factory globally. Role involves evaluating emerging technologies, developing reference architectures, and translating IT requirements for electrical, cooling, and facility teams.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in compute, storage, or hyperscale infrastructure and 5+ years in architecture or principal engineering roles with data center experience.

Full job description

AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect

 

Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect will serve as a global technical authority for compute, networking, storage, memory, and IT infrastructure architecture within Siemens' AI Factory organization. The role will track how AI, hyperscale, cloud, HPC, and enterprise platforms are evolving and convert those changes into actionable AI Factory reference architectures and go-to-market guidance. The successful candidate will bring practical experience building or architecting large-scale compute, network, and storage environments and enough data-center fluency to translate upstream IT decisions into clear implications for power, cooling, controls, physical topology, resiliency, and deployment strategy. A critical responsibility is to partner with electrical, thermal/liquid cooling, controls & automation, digital thread, and regional Solutions Architects, rack density, cluster topology, network fabrics, storage architecture, and workload behavior are accurately reflected in the complete AI Factory architecture. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Serve as the technical authority for AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures. 
  • Evaluate emerging processor, accelerator, networking, memory, and storage technologies and assess their impact on AI Factory designs. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures spanning compute, storage, networking, racks, clusters, and data hall environments. 
  • Translate IT infrastructure requirements into actionable inputs for electrical, cooling, controls, and facility design teams. 
  • Partner with customers, hyperscalers, enterprises, and technology partners on infrastructure strategy and architecture planning. 
  • Develop technical guidance, architecture frameworks, and thought leadership content supporting sales and go-to-market initiatives. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; Master’s preferred. 
  • 10+ years of experience in compute infrastructure, networking, storage, cloud, HPC, enterprise systems, or hyperscale environments. 
  • 5+ years in architecture, principal engineering, technical leadership, or equivalent roles. 
  • Proven experience designing or architecting large-scale infrastructure environments. 
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, HPC, hyperscale, or high-density data centers. 
  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to travel up to 30-50%. 
 

Technical Expertise 

  • Large-scale compute, AI, HPC, cloud, or hyperscale infrastructure environments. 
  • Server, CPU, GPU, and accelerator architectures. 
  • AI training and inference platforms. 
  • Data center networking including Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, and AI fabrics. 
  • Enterprise and high-performance storage architectures. 
  • Linux, virtualization, containers, and distributed systems. 
  • Rack-level infrastructure, power, cooling, and high-density deployments. 
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into scalable architecture strategies. 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in compute, HPC, networking, AI infrastructure, hyperscale systems, or a related domain. 
  • Broad knowledge across compute, networking, storage, and data center infrastructure. 
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate technology trends into business and architectural value. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Executive presence with strong communication and presentation skills. 
  • Ability to simplify complex technologies into actionable architectural decisions. 
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for learning emerging technologies and industry trends.

Full job description

About Siemens Digital Industry Software 

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer-aided design, 3D modeling, and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large enterprise and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world-class software portfolio. Position Summary 

The Industry Marketing Manager for Semiconductors turns industry strategy, customer insight, and Siemens’ portfolio strengths into focused go-to-market (GTM) priorities, differentiated messaging, executable campaign direction, and high-impact sales enablement materials. Serving as the marketing subject-matter expert for the semiconductor industry, you will connect market opportunities, customer needs, industry priorities, solution capabilities, and business objectives to create actionable strategies that accelerate awareness, engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth. Operating as a key integrator across industry leadership, product marketing, sales, technical experts, and implementation teams, success in this role requires both strategic industry leadership and the ability to navigate a complex, matrixed organization while maintaining a razor-sharp focus on customer relevance and business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Ownership & Evolution: Own and continuously evolve the semiconductor go-to-market intent, translating high-level strategy into clear target segments, buying groups, personas, Digital Thread and Solution Domain priorities, and campaign plans.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the industry marketing lead within cross-functional implementation. Bring customer and market relevance to delivery teams, clarify business rationale, surface dependencies and risks, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Audience & Persona Strategy: Lead buyer-audience definitions and validate persona-to-topic mapping to reflect how semiconductor companies organize, buy, and transform.
  • Messaging & Value Proposition: Develop and maintain industry messaging frameworks and briefs that connect customer challenges to differentiated Siemens value. Translate highly technical input into credible, outcome-led narratives for executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with industry leaders, solution managers, Digital Thread Factory leads, solution/core marketers, technical experts, and sales to align solution definition, audience strategy, and messaging.
  • Campaign & Content Direction: Lead integrated campaign definitions from strategy through handoff, providing complete inputs for campaign overviews, prioritized topics, audiences, imperatives, messaging, and content requirements while supporting content creators with clear strategic direction.
  • Sales Enablement: Own the creation and delivery of enablement and go-to-market materials that sellers use because they map directly to real customer priorities. Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Industry Fluency: Monitor fast-moving semiconductor market and technology developments, including AI and custom silicon, EDA, software-defined development, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, fab/sub-fab digitalization, manufacturing optimization, sustainability, and supply-chain resilience.
  • Governance & Execution: Resolve ambiguity, escalate gaps in ownership or portfolio readiness with clear business implications, and rigorously document decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.
  • Evangelism: Represent the semiconductor industry in internal planning, executive reviews, customer engagements, and key industry forums.
What Success Looks Like
  • Delivery of customer-relevant messaging with the deep technical credibility required by semiconductor audiences.
  • Tight, measurable alignment across industry, solution, campaign, sales, and technical stakeholders. A focused, evidence-based semiconductor campaign strategy that teams can easily understand and execute.
  • High adoption of campaigns and enablement assets by sales teams due to their direct connection to real-world buyer challenges.
  • A trusted, up-to-date industry point of view that adapts to market shifts and sharpens prioritization over time.
Required Skills & Capabilities
  • Industry Expertise: Deep understanding of the semiconductor industry, its ecosystem, value chain, business models, buying dynamics, and technology trends.
  • Technical Agility: Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts and distinguish enduring customer needs from short-lived market hype.
  • GTM Strategy: Strong command of go-to-market strategy, segmentation, audience definition, positioning, messaging, and B2B campaign planning.
  • Executive Storytelling: Exceptional strategic writing and storytelling skills; ability to make complex engineering and software topics clear, differentiated, and relevant across all levels of a customer organization. Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
  • Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.
  • Influence Without Authority: Proven ability to lead through a global matrixed organization, aligning senior leaders, technical specialists, marketers, sales teams, and external agencies.
  • Project Leadership: Strong leadership and project management skills, including prioritization, decision framing, dependency management, issue escalation, workshop facilitation, and on-time delivery.
  • Business & Sales Acumen: Ability to connect marketing choices directly to growth priorities, pipeline requirements, adoption barriers, and seller readiness.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable thriving in environments characterized by ambiguity and constant change.
  • Communication: Executive-ready verbal communication and presentation skills, coupled with excellent written English.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field (advanced degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, go-to-market strategy, product marketing, or industry marketing, preferably within the semiconductor, EDA, or industrial software environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing audience strategies, messaging frameworks, campaign briefs, thought leadership, sales enablement, and executive presentations.
  • Extensive experience collaborating with global, cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in complex, matrixed corporate structures.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience spanning multiple segments of the semiconductor value chain, or successfully bridging EDA, systems engineering, simulation, lifecycle management, and manufacturing narratives.
  • Hands-on experience supporting both overarching GTM strategy and integrated tactical campaigns.
  • An established professional network within the semiconductor ecosystem, with strong familiarity with major industry events, associations, and the media landscape.

About Siemens Digital Industries Software
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a global leader in industrial software, empowering companies worldwide to drive innovation and digital transformation through our comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions. Our cutting-edge technology helps create precise digital twins, enabling customers to master the complexity of smart products and processes.


Join our dynamic Global Storage Team, a strategic pillar supporting Siemens Digital Industries Software's engineers and corporate staff across numerous R&D centers and offices worldwide. 


The Role

As a Senior Storage Administrator, you will be instrumental in driving efficiency and innovation by assisting with the automation of our enterprise storage infrastructure. You'll leverage your deep expertise in NetApp and EverPure/Pure Storage to deliver highly available, performant, and cost-effective solutions, playing a critical role in our digital transformation journey.


Key Responsibilities

The Senior Storage Administrator will also be responsible for critical storage operations support in a primarily NAS environment and will participate in a global on-call rotation. Must be able to perform problem resolution in an effective and timely manner in accordance with SLA's and customer expectations. Time management and prioritization skills will be required to accommodate business requirements and manage scheduled activities. Must work well in a team environment and possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Infrastructure Management: Storage platforms administration, monitoring, upgrading, installation and setup, configuration, testing, and deployments optimized for software development and build environments.

  • Performance Engineering & Tuning: Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments with high IOPs and throughput demands (supporting CI/CD pipelines, EDA workloads, and developer scratch spaces).

  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Spearhead process automation, expert scripting, and IaC to enable self-service storage provisioning for engineering teams.

  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with architecture, DevOps, and service delivery teams on new and existing infrastructure initiatives; manage vendor escalations for critical support issues.

  • Operations & Support: Handle tier-3 support tickets for complex customer/developer issues and participate in a global on-call rotation. Ensure reliable operations in a primarily NAS/SAN environment in accordance with strict SLAs.

Job Qualifications

  • Education: BS degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MS degree is preferred.

  • Experience: 5+ years of directly applicable enterprise storage administration experience in large-scale corporate or software engineering environments.

  • Core Storage Expertise:

    • 5+ years working with Network Appliance NAS/SAN technologies, including in-depth experience with NetApp Cluster Mode (cDot) and management tools (e.g., Active IQ Unified Manager).

    • Hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Everpure Storage or modern all-flash scale-out platforms.

    • Robust understanding of Data Protection technologies, including SnapMirror/Snapvault replications and disaster recovery paradigms.

  • Software Development & Engineering Support Alignment:

    • Demonstrated experience supporting software development organizations, understanding the unique IO profile of software builds, test execution, compilation workloads, and artifact repositories.

    • Familiarity with High-Performance Computing (HPC) and EDA (Electronic Design Automation) storage requirements (handling high small-file IOPS, concurrency, and massive throughput).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, REST APIs, and Terraform/IaC to eliminate manual administrative toil.

  • OS & Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of networking protocols (NFS, SMB/CIFS, TCP/IP) and deep operating system administration skills (Linux and Windows) for diagnosing client-side storage bottlenecks, permissions, and mount issues.

  • Operations Mindset: Solid understanding of problem management, incident management, and change control processes in a global enterprise. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Knowledge / Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Development Toolchain Familiarity: Exposure to modern developer tools and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes persistent volumes).

  • Certifications: NetApp Certified Storage Associate/Professional (NCSA/NCIE) or Pure Storage certifications highly desired. 

  • Virtualization & Cloud: Experience with OpenStack, VMware, or hybrid-cloud storage tiering.

  • EDA Industry Knowledge: Specific familiarity with semiconductor or mechanical EDA tool storage tuning.

About this job

Senior MuleSoft Developer role at Siemens focused on designing, developing, and deploying APIs and integration solutions using the Anypoint Platform. Good fit if you have 5+ years of MuleSoft development experience, strong proficiency with Mule 4 and API design, and experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins and Maven.

Full job description

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy MuleSoft solutions, including APIs, integrations, and connectors like SFDC, SAP, Queue, Database, etc.
  • Design and develop MuleSoft applications using RAML 1.0, API Designer, API Management, and implementation of policies.
  • Strong understanding of DataWeave 2.0 and ability to develop complex logic using DataWave 2.0.
  • Design and develop Munits as part of unit testing.
  • Deployment of applications on on-prem and cloud hub 2.0.
  • Lead the technical design and implementation of integration solutions, ensuring adherence to best practices and scalability.
  • Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Implement MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including API Gateway, Anypoint Studio, and CloudHub.
  • Lead the design and development of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and troubleshooting of MuleSoft solutions to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Ensure the security, performance, and scalability of the integration solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers and team members.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and solution architecture to promote best practices and maintain high code quality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal downtime and efficient resolution.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest MuleSoft features, tools, and industry trends to continually improve the integration solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development with a focus on MuleSoft and API integrations.
  • Strong experience in an object-oriented programming language.
  • Proficiency in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including Mule 4, Anypoint Studio, API Manager, and CloudHub.
  • Strong experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and microservices architecture.
  • Proficiency in integration patterns, EAI, ESB, and SOA concepts.
  • Experience with data formats such as JSON, XML, and understanding of data transformation tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based technologies, specifically in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Strong knowledge of security standards, such as OAuth, SAML, and API security best practices.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, or similar.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Jenkins, Maven and Databases is necessary.
  • Strong experience with all types of integration patterns.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, Maven, etc.).
  • Knowledge of database technologies (SQL/NoSQL) and integration with MuleSoft.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and development practices.

  • Participate in Operational Testing, Verification, and Acceptance: run routine reports to review system operation, conduct final inspections and testing, and support customer acceptance and the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ).

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be willing and able to differentiate types/colors of wire; use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field

Good fit if you have hands-on experience customizing, coding, configuring or administering Active Workspace and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. As part of a zone or country Enterprise Learning and Adoption team, work with Professional Services and project management to deliver high-quality Learning and Adoption Services and end user training.  Contribute to the delivery of Enterprise Learning and Adoption programs in agreed DI domains that enable customers to minimize user adoption risks and to achieve superior adoption of the Digital Enterprise solution.

Deliver standard and custom instructor-led training in center, at customer sites or as distance learning.  Apply aspects of Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of Customer user communities.  In collaboration with the lead Learning Architect, follows the Learning and Adoption work stream of customer programs deploying multiple Siemens DI products within a single domain (for example: DI, STS, DER) to multiple locations.

Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices.  Works under self-management on routine assignment/projects and light supervision on new assignment/projects.  Works on projects/assignments of basic to moderate scope.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in person and online training classes to our customers utilizing our Active Workspace and Teamcenter product suite.
  • Will have previous Active WS customization, coding, configuration or Admin experience in order to carry-out trainings.
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, command of specific technical subject matter, ability to learn new technologies very quickly, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in the simplest possible terms (relative to the audience)
  • Stimulate interest and enhance learner understanding through appropriate anecdotes, stories, analogies and humor. Use activities that allow learners to review and apply content at appropriate intervals.
  • Apply Adult Learning strategies and Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices to address the needs of customers user communities.
  • Actively participates in and contributes to the global "Learning" Community of Practice and contributes to the definition, development and curation of the Siemens Learning and Adoption best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Bachelor’s Degree is required for this position
  • Strong experience either coding, customizing, configuring or being an admin of Active WS is critical and required!
  • *Please have Active WS clearly written in your resume as to which job/position you used it in*
  • Experience with additional Teamcenter products is helpful, however must have experience with Active WS.  
  • Preferred, not required: 3-10 years of experience in design, development and delivery of training, and blended-learning solutions

NOTE: Applicants must not require employer sponsored work Visa authorization, now or in the future for employment in the USA. Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the USA.

Must be able to support US Dept of defense requests

Siemens Grid Software's consulting business Power Technologies International (PTI) is seeking a Portfolio Consulting Manager to lead a team focused on transmission planning and interconnection consulting services across the ERCOT and SPP regions. This leadership role combines people management, business development, customer engagement, and project execution. The successful candidate will lead a team of power system consultants while partnering with utilities, developers, and large energy users to address evolving grid reliability, electrification, and interconnection challenges.

Location: This is a remote role within the contiguous U.S.

What You Will do:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of power system consultants.
  • Grow Siemens PTI's transmission planning and interconnection consulting business in ERCOT and SPP.
  • Build and maintain relationships with utilities, developers, RTOs, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Lead customer engagements, proposal development, project planning, and contract execution.
  • Oversee the execution of transmission planning and interconnection studies, including steady-state, short-circuit, transient stability, and related reliability assessments.
  • Ensure successful project delivery with respect to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage portfolio performance, including revenue growth, profitability, utilization, forecasting, and resource planning.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in transmission planning, operations, generator interconnection, load interconnection, or power system studies.
  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams or managing consulting organizations.
  • Working knowledge of power system analysis tools such as PSS®E, TARA, PSLF™, PowerWorld, TSAT™, or PSCAD™.
  • Strong understanding of NERC Reliability Standards and regional planning criteria.
  • Excellent communication, customer engagement, and technical report writing skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • Prior consulting experience in the electric utility industry.
  • Experience with utility-scale generation, renewable energy, or large load interconnection studies.
  • Experience with ERCOT and/or SPP planning and interconnection processes.
  • PE license preferred.

Success in this Role:

The successful candidate will balance three key areas of responsibility:

  • People Leadership - Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing consulting team.
  • Business Growth - Expand Siemens PTI's market presence and consulting portfolio across ERCOT and SPP through strong customer relationships and strategic business development.
  • Project Delivery - Ensure high-quality, profitable execution of complex customer engagements while maintaining customer satisfaction and long-term client relationships.

Engagement Manager - CTO in Process Industries

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Siemens Digital Industries is hiring an Engagement Manager (EM) to lead architect a small portfolio of strategic end-user accounts in the process industries: Chemicals, Glass, Energy, Life Sciences, and Consumer Packaged Goods.

The scope of this role is automation in manufacturing environments — process control systems, batch and continuous production, plant-floor operations technology, predictive maintenance, IT/OT with an emphasis of industrial AI in operations, and the modernization of legacy control system installed base.

The EM spearheads the technical and commercial engagement across the process industries accounts. You will define the multi-year automation "first of's" and modernization roadmaps for each customer, architect the lifecycle program that delivers it, and lead the cross-functional team that sells and executes it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; you will lead through influence across sales, product, services, marketing, and customer executive stakeholders.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.


You'll make an impact by:

  • You architect the automation in manufacturing vision and map the customer from where they are to where they want to be, with the lifecycle program to get them there.
  • Own the multi-year outcome roadmap for a small set of strategic accounts — from C-suite ambition (operational performance, modernization ROI, time-to-value, sustainability targets) to the technical execution that makes it real.
  • Protect scope integrity end-to-end. No surprise scope creep. No "we'll figure it out in execution." You are the integrity check between what was sold and what gets delivered.
  • Compress order closure speed on your accounts — you are the roadblock breaker, the escalation path, the deal architect.
  • Build next-wave pipeline from inside the install base, and the champion for new large labels — every closed deal is a launchpad for the next three. Cross-portfolio thinking is the default, not the upsell.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional account teams — sellers, application engineers, product specialists, service leads, and partners — toward one coherent engagement.
  • Coach by example. No org chart authority required — your influence comes from being the most prepared, most strategic, and most outcome-focused person in the room.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in the process industries — Chemicals, Energy, Life Sciences, or Consumer Packaged Goods. 
  • Worked as the end-user in any of the process industries
  • As senior Systems Integrator architecting automation solutions in these industries
  • You are an automation-in-manufacturing Subject Matter Expert — practitioner-grade.
  • You have personally designed, production automation systems: control system architectures, batch and continuous process control, IT/OT convergence, predictive maintenance, plant network and infrastructure design, and modernization/migration paths from legacy installed base to current-generation platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of large, strategic end-user accounts — multi-site, multi-stakeholder, multi-year.
  • You have personally architected and sold lifecycle contracts. Multi-year service and lifecycle agreements, performance-based contracts, managed services, outcome-based agreements, and subscription or as-a-service commercial models.
  • The ability to translate technical complexity → executive clarity and back again.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
  • Travel requirements 30%-35%.

Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! Transform the everyday with us! 

This position will be a remote position with extensive travel required. The employee must live within an hour of a major airport.

You’ll make an impact by:

Siemens is seeking a Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer to provide expert onsite and remote support for industrial drive systems across customer facilities. This role supports installation, startup, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, upgrades, retrofits, and customer training for Siemens low voltage drive products and related automation systems.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who enjoys solving complex problems in industrial environments, working directly with customers, and helping keep critical manufacturing and process operations running safely and reliably.

Seventy percent travel or more is expected and proximity to a major airport is required.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform field service activities for Siemens low voltage drives, including SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, Masterdrives, DC drives, and related drive platforms.
  • Support installation, startup, commissioning, testing, tuning, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and modernization work at customer sites.
  • Diagnose hardware, software, communication, motor, and power-related issues using electrical schematics, drive parameters, diagnostic tools, meters, and test equipment.
  • Provide technical and operational support for low voltage drives, motion control, PLC/HMI interfaces, motor control centers, and related industrial automation equipment.
  • Perform emergency break-fix service and scheduled service work in manufacturing, process, utility, marine, and heavy industrial environments.
  • Create clear service reports, timesheets, test records, recommendations, and follow-up actions after each assignment.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, project managers, technical support, sales, and internal service teams.
  • Train customer maintenance and operations personnel on proper equipment operation, inspection, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Identify opportunities for spare parts, service agreements, upgrades, retrofits, training, and reliability improvements.
  • Follow Siemens safety procedures, customer site requirements, lockout/tagout practices, and applicable electrical safety standards.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electrical engineering technology, automation, mechatronics, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or maintaining low voltage AC drive systems in industrial environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of variable frequency drives, motors, power electronics, control wiring, industrial networks, and electrical troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical layouts, and technical manuals.
  • Comfort working independently at customer sites while managing priorities, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and customer service skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet customer site access requirements.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Travel: Ability to travel frequently, including short-notice assignments, overnight travel, overtime, weekends, and emergency service support when required up to 70% or more of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Siemens SINAMICS drives, STARTER, Startdrive, TIA Portal, PLCs, HMIs, and industrial communication networks is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, DCM, SIMOVERT Master drives, and similar industrial drive systems.
  • Experience supporting drive applications such as pumps, fans, compressors, conveyors, cranes, mills, extruders, and process equipment.
  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance practices, insulation testing, parameter backup/restoration, firmware updates, drive replacement, and system recommissioning.
  • Experience with PLC integration, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, or other industrial networks.
  • Familiarity with OSHA, NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout, and customer site safety practices.

Siemens Industry Inc. is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer to join our Services Execution Division.

We are looking for a Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer. This home-office-based position reports to the Operations Manager, Factory Automation Field Service, and requires approximately 50-75% travel.

In this critical role, you will provide advanced technical support, engineering, troubleshooting, product expertise, and commissioning services for Siemens factory automation equipment and systems. You will support customers both on-site and remotely and serve as a key technical resource, particularly during complex and high-pressure situations.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Providing expert second- and third-level technical and operational support for complex Siemens factory automation equipment and systems, including diagnosing and resolving issues that may not be covered by standard procedures.
  • Guiding and performing the installation, configuration, commissioning, and integration of Siemens automation hardware and software at customer sites.
  • Engaging directly with customers through active listening, clear communication, and structured problem-solving, while remaining composed and effective during demanding situations.
  • Conducting scheduled and emergency field service support, completing software version updates, and providing ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting assistance.
  • Integrating computer hardware and software components within automation systems.
  • Supporting project teams with startup and commissioning activities, including managing subcontractors and monitoring delivery when needed.
  • Implementing requested system changes using programming languages and methods that include LAD, FBD, GRAPH, SCL, and STL.
  • Guiding customers in maintaining and adjusting complex equipment and reviewing task plans, drawings, and installation schematics throughout task execution.
  • Following safe job practices, including completing daily safety briefs before work begins, and developing detailed daily field reports that document job activities.
  • Assisting with customer proposal planning by estimating labor hours, materials, travel expenses, and per diem costs.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, OR equivalent experience in industrial controls or another relevant technical discipline.
  • 10-15 years of successful experience in factory automation field service or an engineering/maintenance similar role.
  • At least 10 years of hands-on experience with Siemens factory automation equipment and software, listed below.
  • Proficiency with S7-Classic and TIA Portal software.
  • Experience with Profibus, PROFINET, wireless communication, and OPC UA protocols.
  • Strong knowledge of programmable logic controllers, advanced control systems, coordinated drive systems, and automation principles and concepts.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate effectively with customers, listen actively, and remain composed under pressure.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50-75% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SIMOTION.
  • Knowledge of Siemens S7-1500T technology controllers and technology blocks.
  • Experience providing customer training.
  • Experience with Siemens SINAMICS drives.

As an Applications engineer with Siemens EDA Technology Solutions Sales, you will support consultative sales efforts at the world’s leading semiconductor and electronic equipment manufacturers.


As an Applications Engineer at Siemens EDA, your primary responsibility is to secure technical design wins for Siemens EDA's product and service offerings. Specifically, you will be responsible for technical wins with the industry leading solutions Innovator 3D IC Layout,  Innovator3D IC Integrator, Xpedition, Calibre, HyperLynx, and other product families. Responsible activities will include delivery of technical presentations, conducting product demonstrations and benchmarks, and participation in development of solutions and account strategies leading to market share gains for Siemens.  This position is also expected to help architect and prototype Siemens EDA’s emerging 3DIC solution through the development of flows and integration scripts to link tools into a solution.


Your territory coverage consists of Key Accounts located throughout the US.  You will be responsible for integrating with peers located all over the world, communicating essential status to a variety of stakeholders and influential customers.  International travel may be required.

Job Qualifications

MSEE/BSEE with 4+ years design experience. Significant experience in advanced IC Package layout design and/or interposer layout design. Experience with IC design is a plus.  Necessary technical skills include satisfying many of these areas:

  • Knowledge of IC Package Design (Cadence APD/SiP, Siemens Xpedition/i3DL) is required.
  • Practical experience with Package design tools from design setup (stackup/constraints/etc), to implementation (routing/outgassing/re-use/etc), through generation of manufacturing documents is required.
  • Familiarity with Package / Interposer planning solutions (Siemens XSI/i3DI, Cadence OrbitIO/ISP, Synopsys 3DIC Compiler, Excel) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with 2.5D and 3D chiplet-based design solutions (TSMC InFO, CoWoS, Intel EMIB, Foveros, ASE FoCUS, Amkor SWIFT, Samsung I/H/X-Cube, etc.) is preferred.
  • Knowledge of IC data formats (Verilog, LEF/DEF, GDS, OASIS, etc.) is desired.
  • Familiarity with signal/power integrity tools (HyperLynx, Sigrity, SIWave, ADS, etc) and analysis flows is preferred
  • Experience with Siemens Calibre DRC, LVS, and/or 3DSTACK solutions is highly desirable.
  • Above average competency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Scripting/Programming: VBS, Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar languages.
  • Working OS knowledge of Windows and Linux.
  • Prior experience as an Applications Engineer is preferred.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Possess a passion to learn and perform at the cutting edge of technology.
  • Have a desire to broaden exposure to the business aspects of the technical design world.
  • Enjoy contributing to the success of a great team.
  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Effectively influence people at any level.
  • Enjoy helping and motivating others to be successful.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong rapport and credibility with customer organizations while maintaining a company internal network of contacts.
  • Be willing to travel domestically and internationally.

  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends. 
  • Expected to spend minimum 50% of time in customer facing activities, performed in person and on customer site.
