As a Senior Building Automation Programmer – PLC & Industrial Controls create advanced programming solutions for complex building automation, HVAC controls, and PLC-based control systems in new and existing facilities. This role supports data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other mission-critical environments by developing reliable control logic, PLC programs, system integration programming, point mapping, functional testing documentation, and technical solutions that meet customer requirements, improve operational performance, and support successful project execution.

 

As a Building Automation Programmer, you will:

  • Program large, complex, and custom projects using PLC-based programming platforms and control logic.
  • Develop and implement PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal, including structured control logic for mission-critical building automation and industrial control applications. 
  • Design, conﬁgure, and support visualization solutions, including HMI and SCADA interfaces, to provide operators with clear system status, alarms, trends, and control information.
  • Provide post-sale assistance for programming labor estimating.
  • Test PLC programs prior to initial release for quality assurance and functional performance.
  • Create functional testing and commissioning documents utilized to validate PLC logic, system integration, and ﬁeld performance.
  • Support commissioning, start-up, optimization, error analysis, and troubleshooting of PLC-based automation systems in coordination with project teams and ﬁeld resources.
  • Document PLC software solutions, system conﬁguration, testing results, revisions, and integration requirements to support quality control and long-term maintainability.
  • Assist the Graphics Design team by coordinating dynamic point information, alarms, trends, and PLC-integrated system data into graphics.
  • Collaborate with the Design Team to identify speciﬁcation discrepancies, coordinate PLC integration requirements, and request clariﬁcation as needed.
  • Work both independently and in team dynamics in a remote environment.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical assistance to other team members.
  • Travel as needed up to 25%

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • High School Diploma, or state-recognized GED. 
  • Demonstrated experience programming commercial building automation, HVAC, or industrial control systems using PLC-based control strategies.
  • Solid knowledge of Siemens PLC programming, especially Siemens S7-1200/1500 platforms and Siemens TIA Portal.
  • 5+ years of experience with structured programming methods aligned with IEC 61131-3 programming standards; ladder logic is the preferred programming language for this role.
  •  5+ years of demonstrated experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and system integration.
  • Demonstrated electro-mechanical aptitude to read and understand design drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, points lists, and construction documents.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%. 
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Office.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
Preferred Qualiﬁcations:
  • Associate or Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years of experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and integrated system programming
  • Demonstrated knowledge of PLC-based control systems, industrial communication protocols, and building automation system integration, including PROFINET, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, or similar protocols based on applicable work experience
  • Experience with HMI/SCADA visualization platforms, drives technology, high-level programming languages such as Python or C#/.NET, robotics, or IT security in industrial systems

Siemens Project Management Office (PMO) is looking for a Customer Services (CS) Project Manager to join our Data Centers team. This position is remote.

Role Description:

As a CS Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Headquartered in Wendell, NC, the EA PMO executes a diverse portfolio of projects, and this position will be focused on service solutions within our Customer Services business. This role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens mission to empower people with a growth mindset. As a customer facing team, we keep customer satisfaction at the forefront as we manage large projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Project Management: Manage projects from inception to completion, ensuring safety, budget, schedule, quality, and performance objectives are met.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and management, providing regular updates and managing customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Resource Management: Identify, assign, and manage project resources, including engineering, field personnel, vendors, and 3rd-party services.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and monitor/control 3rd-party vendors to ensure contract adherence.
  • Financial Leadership: Track project budget, schedule completion, and perform monthly revenue forecasting.
  • Contract Management: Review and understand contractual obligations, manage change orders, and participate in vendor negotiations.
  • Quality & Process Improvement: Develop project execution plans like quality & testing plans, schedules, and risk registers. Implement recovery plans to address performance issues.
  • Collaboration & Relationship Building: Collaborate with internal/external teams and clients to develop site schedules, maintain client relationships, and provide "Lessons Learned" feedback to improve project offerings.

 You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Experience with MS Project or other relevant scheduling software
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in leading cross-functional project teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status, and issues to internal and external Customers.

Ao longo de sua história, a companhia contribuiu ativamente para a construção e para a modernização da infraestrutura brasileira, com um portfólio de soluções inovadoras que capacita seus clientes a acelerarem sua própria transformação digital e a alcançarem maior sustentabilidade. 🚀 Quer fazer parte desse time?

Veja nossa oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria de Projetos Pl.
Se inscreva e compartilhe 👏

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

• Executar análise financeira de projetos, acompanhando custos, orçamentos, viabilidade econômica e fluxo de caixa sob orientação da equipe sênior;
• Dominar processos em SAP relacionados a reconhecimento de receita, gestão de custos e planejamento econômico;
• Participar de project reviews e apresentar análises técnicas e financeiras de projetos;
• Desenvolver conhecimento técnico avançado com suporte da pessoa sênior, atuando como referência técnica em desenvolvimento;
• Colaborar com áreas de negócio, fornecendo análises financeiras que suportem decisões sobre projetos;
• Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos e implementar melhorias contínuas;
• Garantir conformidade com políticas corporativas e normas aplicáveis de controladoria.

Quais requisitos estamos buscando?

• Formação superior em Administração, Economia ou Ciências Contábeis;
• Experiência mínima de 2 a 3 anos em controladoria de projetos ou gestão financeira;
• Conhecimento em SAP;
• Experiência com reconhecimento de receita, gestão de custos, planejamento econômico e fluxo de caixa;
• Domínio de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI;
• Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos;
• Inglês avançado;
• Espanhol será considerado um diferencial;
• Experiência prévia em ambientes com projetos complexos será considerada diferencial.

Local de trabalho e modelo de contratação:

• CLT, modelo híbrido (home office em alguns dias da semana!)
• Local de trabalho – Jundiaí/SP

Por isso, buscamos talentos de diferentes origens, gêneros, idades, raças, orientação sexual e pessoas com deficiência. Na Siemens, as oportunidades são para todos.

Informamos que as nossas pessoas recrutadoras não solicitam documentos ou dados pessoais sensíveis via e-mail, WhatsApp ou redes sociais. Além disso, ressaltamos que não realizamos cobrança de taxas de quem participa dos nossos processos seletivos e não exigimos a realização de cursos para preenchimento das vagas. Job.JobTitle: Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Experience: 8+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Drive adoption of Siemens automation and digitalization solutions for chemicals, glass, and energy customers. Remote role translating customer challenges into cost-efficient solutions while supporting vertical sales teams across the continental US.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in technical sales or solution consulting for industrial automation, with process industry experience and familiarity with EPCs and system integrators.

Full job description

Customer Solution Architect, Chemicals, Glass and Energy

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people ﬁrst. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

As a Customer Solution Architect within Sales Acceleration, supporting the Chemicals, Glass and Energy, you will be a key individual contributor reporting to the Manager of Sales Acceleration, Chemicals, Glass and Energy. You will empower vertical sales teams and customers by driving adoption of Siemens' Digital Industries (DI) portfolio, with a focus on automation and digitalization solutions. This role maximizes solution and product sales by applying the Digital Thread methodology and leveraging the Challenger Sales Approach to deliver meaningful customer outcomes, and accelerating their realization. You will translate customer insights into effective, cost-efficient solutions that align with the Siemens Sales Engagement Model, serving as a trusted advisor to vertical sales teams and customers.

This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the continental US.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Solution Development & Architecting: Translate complex customer challenges into clear, actionable requirements and work to deliver innovative automation and digitalization solutions that meet their evolving needs.
  • Driving Sales Engagement: Independently drive and apply a Sales Engagement Model with your assigned accounts to achieve the sales acceleration targets.
  • Trusted Advisory: Serve as a primary technical and strategic advisor to customers and internal sales teams, guiding them through the adoption of Siemens' cutting-edge technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong collaboration with Sales teams, Marketing & Communication, Product Management in the Zone, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless value delivery and maximize market opportunities.
  • Market & Customer Identification: Identify key and emerging markets and support the definition and identification of target customers across the Digital Industries Automation portfolio nationwide.
  • Assessing portfolio/productmarket fit for the instrumentation portfolio: Having a strong knowledge on process industries is essential as you will own the process of portfolio fit with strategic customer markets that have a high willingness to buy.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualiﬁcations:

Basic Qualiﬁcations:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in a technical sales, solution consulting, application engineering, or similar individual contributor role within industrial automation or digitalization
  • Strengthening the familiarity with the automation ecosystem 'EPCs and System Integrators'
  • Identify opportunities to co-create reference architectures, standards, preferred vendor positions, and reusable engineering approaches that increase Siemens specification rates.
  • Familiar with key Tier I, II and Tier III Engineering, Procurement & Construction firms.
  • Leverage industry relationships, market knowledge, and professional networks to expand Siemens' visibility and credibility throughout the capital project pursuit ecosystem.
  • Translate Siemens' automation, instrumentation, digitalization, and software portfolio into solutions that help capital projects.
  • Lead technical strategy and value messaging that aligns Siemens capabilities with the unique needs of process industries such as Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, and Energy Transition projects.
  • Drive cross-business-unit collaboration to present a unified Siemens solution strategy spanning Process Automation, Instrumentation, Digital Industries Software, Industrial Communications, AI, and Digital Twin offerings.
  • Experience working with End Users, primarily in process and energy-oriented industries, such as oil and gas, chemicals, hydrogen, carbon capture, LNG to name a few
  • Technical expertise in Siemens Industrial Automation and Digitalization Portfolio, with a proven track record of applying these technologies to solve complex customer problems
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industrial automation market drivers, trends, and evolving customer needs, particularly in the context of digital transformation
  • Exceptional customer interaction, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a strong customer-centric approach
  • Experience with various project collaboration models and sales processes
  • Excellent verbal, written and time management skills
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 35%, with occasional international travel
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States permanently, without company sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualiﬁcations:

  • 10+ years of experience in process automation, industrial digitalization, ecosystem business development, solution consulting, application engineering, or technical sales.
  • Existing relationships within North American process-industry ecosystem, including EPC’s and system integrators.
  • Experience supporting capital projects during concept, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, or commissioning phases.
  • Deep familiarity with one or more CGE segments including Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Energy Transition, Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Power Generation, or related industries.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and influence technical standards before projects reach the bid stage.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage both C-suite leaders and hands-on engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to foresee future trends in industrial automation and digitalization, contributing to competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with knowledge of current and future practices, trends, and information impacting the industrial business landscape
  • Organizational Agility: Knows how to get things done through formal and informal networks. Works effectively in a matrix structure to exploit opportunities. Rallies the team behind the right opportunities and initiatives
  • Exceptional Customer Focus: A dedication to understanding and meeting customer needs, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement in products, solutions, and services
  • High Degree of Professional Ownership: Demonstrate strong personal accountability and take initiative to drive projects to completion, even in large, complex working groups
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and thrive in a remote, virtual work environment

This role is not about responding to opportunities. It is about creating them. You will help shape how major capital projects are designed, specified, and delivered across North America's leading process industries. Your impact will be measured not only in revenue, but in the long-term market influence and strategic partnerships you create for Siemens.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose, adding real value for customers.

About this job

Remote internship with Siemens Grid Software working on power system analysis and grid interconnection research. You'll apply transmission and distribution modeling changes while collaborating with energy industry experts on software that processes over 70% of the world's electricity.

Good fit if you are pursuing a master's degree in electrical or power systems engineering and can work full-time remotely for 12 weeks starting May or June 2027.

Full job description

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Transform the everyday with us!  

Our Siemens Grid Software team works to accelerate and secure the energy transition. We ensure a reliable, affordable energy supply in a decentralizing, decarbonizing, digitalizing, and all-electrifying energy world. No matter where power comes from or where it must go, we ensure it makes its way – every step of the way. Over 70% of the world's electricity flows through infrastructure planned or analyzed by Siemens Grid Solutions. Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy and what part you can play: Decoding the Future of Energy. 

We are seeking qualified candidates for our Energy Developer Solutions Internship beginning in May or June 2027. This is a fully remote role. 

You'll make an impact by: 
  • Applying transmission and/or distribution power system model topology changes. 
  • Analyzing transmission and/or distribution power systems through steady state, short circuit, or transient stability studies. 
  • Conducting research on the processes and guidelines for load and generation interconnections to the power grid & new challenges for the future of the grid. 
  • Working with experts in the Energy industry who have developed the software, products, and services that electrify the world. 

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications: 
Basic Qualifications: 
  • Pursuing a master’s degree Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related field. 
  • Ability to work remotely full-time (40 hours per week) for the duration of the 12-week program. 
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. 
  • This internship is a structured experiential learning program for individuals currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program who will continue their studies following the assignment. Current and continuing enrollment is a condition of participation. Applicants who have completed or expect to complete their educational program before or during the assignment period are encouraged to explore our Early Career Development Program opportunities. 
Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Familiar with Python programming languages. 
  • Familiarity with Transmission Power System Simulation Software and Distribution Power System Simulation Software. 
  • Working knowledge of applications of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. 
  • Experience using collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, or Discord. 
  • Ability to work effectively with multinational and diverse groups and demonstrate leadership skills.
  • Self-starter with good time management skills and the capacity to effectively prioritize a variety of concurrent activities. 
  • Comfortable working as part of a fully remote team, with the initiative and self-direction to work independently and collaborate effectively.
As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy.

Job.JobTitle: Application Solutions, Semiconductor Process and Device Simulations (TCAD)
Job.JobDescription:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software.
Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively.


Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Application Solutions, Semiconductor Process and Device Simulations


Join the Calibre™ R&D Team at Siemens EDA

We are seeking a highly motivated researcher and application engineer, preferably with expertise in semiconductor fabrication process (integration flow and key modules as sputter etch, chemical etch, CMP, deposition, Epitaxy, ion implantation, annealing, etc.), semiconductor metrology (optical or eBeam based), semiconductor devices physics, Design-Technology Co-optimization (DTCO).


About Us

The Calibre™ family of tools is the industry leader in EDA/CAD solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, enabling simulations and diagnostics from the transistor to the package level. As the semiconductor industry continues its rapid growth, there is a critical demand for high-fidelity modeling and high-throughput numerical simulations to support the production of stable, high-volume chips at advanced technology nodes.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate with industry leaders to develop groundbreaking tools that accelerate semiconductor manufacturing and device performance study at the most advanced technologies (logic 2/1.4/1.0/0.7nm and beyond, 3D NAND, 6/4F2/3D DRAM, CIS, and 3DIC packaging). Our solutions will deliver significant performance gains over conventional approaches, essential for supporting high-volume manufacturing and the agile turnaround times our customers demand.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess the following education and experience in one or more of following areas:

Education & Background

• PhD (or MS + 5+ years of research/industry experience) in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or Other Engineering (Material Science, Mechanical, etc.), with expertise in:

o Physics-based Modeling Experience: has good intuitive to build physics-based models to solve real-world problems, capable to derive simplified models for complex systems.

o Semiconductor Fabrication Process: unit process modules such as plasma-based dry etch, wet etch/cleaning, CVD, PVD, ALD, CMP, Epitaxy, Ion Implantation, Annealing, etc. Integration flow for advanced logic transistors (FinFET, NSFET, CFET), DRAM (COB, vertical PassGates, 3D), 3D NAND and 3DIC (TSV, RDL), CIS, LED, etc.

o Semiconductor Device and Multi-Physics: semiconductor band-structure and carrier transport, reliability issues (BTI, TDDB, SHE, EM/IR drop), etc.

o Semiconductor Metrology: Optical (scatterometry, ellipsometry), eBeam (SEM) based.

Key Skills & Attributes

• Strong problem-solving skills with a passion for tackling complex application challenges.
• Ability to estimate application task complexity, timeline and deliver on schedule.
• Open and collaborative team mindset. Good communication skills.

Locations

Preferred US national or hybrid mode



The salary range for this position is 135,800 to 217,300 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:

The EA Business Unit in Wendell, North Carolina, which is its U.S. headquarters, focuses on photovoltaic inverters, medium-voltage power distribution equipment including packaging and services, and solutions, including automation.

We are looking for a Sr Proposal Engineer. This Hybrid position will be based in Wendell, NC. Relocation assistance is available. This position could be fully remote for an experienced MV Switchgear Proposal Engineer.

We are seeking a Sr. Proposal Engineer to lead technical excellence, engineering strategy, and continuous improvement across our Solutions organization. In this high-impact role, you'll work closely with Siemens Sales to prepare offers supporting customers in the industrial, construction and utility markets on technical, contractual, and commercial issues.

This role may be converted to a remote position based on experience and qualifications, with occasional travel to Wendell for trainings, workshops, and key meetings

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Translating customer requirements and specifications into innovative, cost-effective power distribution solutions.
  • Leading the development of complex proposals, including scope definition, equipment selection, and technical configurations.
  • Creating conceptual layouts and engineering deliverables that clearly communicate proposed solutions.
  • Partnering with engineering, procurement, and product teams to evaluate technical options and optimize solution design.
  • Developing project estimates, cost models, and customer-facing proposal packages for large-scale opportunities.
  • Supporting customer discussions and serving as a trusted technical advisor to sales and business development teams.
  • Driving engineering excellence through continuous improvement, technical mentorship, and successful project handoff to execution teams.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • 7+ years of application engineering experience supporting engineered-to-order solutions and customer proposals.
  • 3+ years of quotation, estimating, or front-end engineering experience.
  • Experience analyzing customer specifications, single-line diagrams, and technical requirements to develop optimized solutions.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to balance technical, commercial, and profitability objectives.
  • Ability to identify market trends and collaborate cross-functionally to drive product and process improvements.
  • Ability to travel up to 10-15%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing engineering teams.
  • Background in power distribution, medium-voltage switchgear, transformers, or related electrical infrastructure products.
  • Knowledge of ANSI, IEEE, UL, and NEMA standards.
  • Experience reviewing single-line diagrams, schematics, protection and control systems, and communication network drawings.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience within manufacturing, EPC, utility, industrial, or consulting engineering environments.

About this job

Define and drive globally scalable reference architectures for controls, automation, and operational technology within Siemens' AI Factory Architecture organization. Partner across engineering, digitalization, and sales teams to create frameworks connecting power, cooling, automation, digital twins, and AI-enabled operations for hyperscale and enterprise environments worldwide.

Full job description

Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory Controls & Automation Architect serves as the global technical authority for controls, automation, and operational technology (OT) within Siemens' AI Factory Architecture organization. This highly visible role will define and drive globally scalable reference architectures spanning Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), SCADA, PLC-based automation, OT networks, telemetry, and digital platforms that support the next generation of AI and mission-critical infrastructure. 

 

With a global mandate across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, this role will partner with engineering, digitalization, sales, and customer teams to create repeatable frameworks that connect power, cooling, automation, digital twins, and AI-enabled operations. The successful candidate will help shape how hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, sovereign AI, and high-density GPU environments are designed, integrated, monitored, and operated worldwide. 

 

This is not a traditional controls engineering or controls programming role. We are seeking a systems thinking architect who can translate complex engineering requirements into scalable global standards, support strategic customer engagements, and drive the integration of power, cooling, automation, and digital systems into a unified architecture that accelerates the deployment of next-generation AI infrastructure. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own and define the controls and automation strategy within Siemens global AI Factory architecture framework. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures, design standards, and integration frameworks for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and AI-focused data center environments. 
  • Establish controls strategies, communication standards, resiliency requirements, and data integration frameworks across automation and digital platforms. 
  • Partner with electrical, cooling, and digital architecture leaders to integrate power, thermal, controls, and operational technologies. 
  • Define standards for telemetry, metadata, equipment tagging, and operational data supporting digital twins, analytics, and AI-enabled operations. 
  • Ensure reference architectures balance global standardization with regional requirements across North America, EMEA, and APAC. 
  • Support strategic customer engagements, architecture workshops, RFIs/RFPs, and complex pursuits involving hyperscalers and major data center customers. 
  • Develop technical guidance, training, and reusable content for regional solutions architects and sales teams. 
  • Evaluate Siemens and third-party technologies and define interoperable architectures that support customer and business objectives. 
  • Represent Siemens as a technical thought leader with customers, partners, and industry organizations. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
  • 10+ years of experience in data centers, mission-critical infrastructure, controls, automation, or OT environments. 
  • Experience designing, integrating, or architecting BMS, EPMS, SCADA, PLC, or industrial automation systems. 
  • Strong understanding of mission-critical power, cooling, and facility infrastructure. 
  • Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, or automation frameworks. 
  • Knowledge of industrial networking, systems integration, and OT cybersecurity principles. 
  • Experience leveraging AI, LLMs, APIs, scripting, and automation tools to improve engineering and operational outcomes. 
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders. 
 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or AI/GPU data center environments. 
  • Experience with digital twins, digital thread, operational analytics, or cloud-to-edge integration. 
  • Experience applying AI-enabled analytics, predictive operations, or automated root-cause analysis. 
  • Familiarity with NEC, NFPA, UL, ASHRAE, IEC, IEC 62443, and related industry standards. 
  • Experience integrating controls systems across power, cooling, energy storage, or liquid cooling technologies. 
  • Experience working with hyperscalers, data center developers, engineering firms, OEMs, or system integrators.

What is Building Automation?

Siemens Building Automation Systems is a building management system (BMS) that automatically manages and controls all systems within a building. These systems include lighting, heating, cooling, ventilation, fire detection and notification, CCTV, door and window controls, water and waste management. It consists of sensors, controllers, software and communication devices. Siemens offers building automation systems for all building types and sizes, and for every use. The system is designed to manage a wide range of building systems, such as HVAC, lighting, security, fire safety, and other critical building functions.

Click HERE to learn more about Siemens’ Building Automation and Control Systems.

The Service Sales Team is committed to supporting our Service Agreements business for commercial building automation controls, fire/life safety and security systems. The Service Sales Team supports our Operations Team whose focus is to perform service and maintenance in large commercial buildings such as hospitals, universities, and industrial facilities.

Job.JobTitle: Principal Technical Program Manager – Data Center Strategy & Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
The Principal Technical Program Manager will lead complex, multi-year data center infrastructure, consolidation, migration, and technology-transformation programs across enterprise and cloud environments. 


This role is responsible for translating business and technical requirements into executable infrastructure strategies, coordinating cross-functional engineering and operational teams, and maintaining control of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder expectations. The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of data center, network, security, compute, storage, virtualization, and disaster-recovery environments with senior-level program leadership. 


The position is best suited to an experienced infrastructure leader who can operate effectively in ambiguous environments, establish governance, challenge incomplete requirements, and guide programs from initial assessment and strategy through design, procurement, deployment, migration, commissioning, and operational handover. This closely reflects the candidate’s demonstrated experience managing large data center portfolios, critical migrations, network and security architecture, and enterprise infrastructure programs.  


Key Responsibilities:

Data Center Strategy and Program Leadership 

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex, multi-phase data center and critical-infrastructure programs.  

  • Develop data center consolidation, migration, modernization, capacity, resilience, and lifecycle strategies.  

  • Establish program objectives, delivery roadmaps, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, governance structures, and success criteria.  

  • Convert strategic requirements into executable project scopes, schedules, resource plans, budgets, and risk-management plans.  

  • Lead infrastructure assessments to evaluate current-state architecture, operational maturity, service resilience, capacity, technical debt, and business-continuity risks.  

  • Identify gaps between contracted scope, stated requirements, and discovered operational or technical needs.  

  • Evaluate program alternatives and clearly communicate cost, schedule, risk, operational, and technical tradeoffs to leadership.  

  • Maintain accountability for overall program performance while coordinating multiple projects, vendors, and technical disciplines.  


Data Center Design and Infrastructure Coordination 

  • Coordinate the development and review of high-level data center infrastructure architectures and design requirements.  

  • Ensure that compute, storage, virtualization, network, cybersecurity, facilities, cloud, and application requirements are incorporated into the overall solution.  

  • Facilitate technical alignment among data center architects, facilities engineers, network and security teams, platform teams, application owners, operations, and external consultants.  

  • Support active-active, primary-secondary, disaster-recovery, high-performance computing, and critical-production infrastructure strategies.  

  • Review design assumptions for availability, scalability, maintainability, redundancy, recoverability, capacity, and operational readiness.  

  • Identify infrastructure dependencies and integration requirements across network, security, compute, storage, application, and facility environments.  

  • Support the development of migration architectures, sequencing plans, coexistence strategies, rollback plans, and cutover requirements.  

The role does not replace the licensed architects or engineers responsible for detailed electrical, mechanical, structural, fire-protection, or code-compliance design. It provides technical program leadership and ensures that those disciplines are properly coordinated. 


Migration and Deployment Management 

  • Develop and govern migration frameworks for critical applications, infrastructure platforms, and data center services.  

  • Coordinate application discovery, dependency mapping, migration-wave planning, readiness reviews, cutover execution, rollback planning, and post-migration validation.  

  • Lead deployment planning for greenfield and brownfield data center environments.  

  • Ensure infrastructure, network, security, operations, facilities, and application teams are aligned before migration or production activation.  

  • Establish formal entry and exit criteria for design, build, testing, commissioning, migration, and operational handover phases.  

  • Track implementation defects, open risks, incomplete deliverables, and operational-readiness gaps through final closure.  

  • Coordinate business-continuity and disaster-recovery planning for critical services.  

The candidate’s background includes leading active-active greenfield data center deployments, establishing migration processes for more than 10,000 critical applications, and managing major infrastructure programs with substantial budgets and extended delivery schedules.  


Network, Security, and Technology Integration 

  • Provide program-level oversight for enterprise data center network and security architecture.  

  • Coordinate LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, software-defined networking, routing, firewall, remote-access, and unified-communications workstreams.  

  • Ensure network and security designs meet availability, performance, segmentation, scalability, and operational-support requirements.  

  • Facilitate coordination of routing, failover, connectivity, authentication, access-control, and security-zone requirements.  

  • Ensure cybersecurity, governance, risk, and compliance requirements are incorporated into program planning and design decisions.  

  • Guide technical teams in evaluating infrastructure standards, technology lifecycles, automation opportunities, and future-state roadmaps.  


Commercial, Procurement, and Vendor Management 

  • Support the preparation, evaluation, clarification, and negotiation of RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, SOWs, and vendor proposals.  

  • Translate technical and operational requirements into clear procurement documentation and evaluation criteria.  

  • Coordinate technical due diligence of data center operators, consultants, contractors, technology suppliers, and managed-service providers.  

  • Evaluate vendor proposals for technical compliance, delivery risk, commercial assumptions, scalability, resilience, and operational suitability.  

  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual milestones, deliverables, service levels, and quality requirements.  

  • Identify scope gaps, exclusions, assumptions, change requests, and commercial risks before they affect delivery.  

  • Support contract negotiations and change-control discussions by providing documented technical and program-impact analysis.  


Governance, Risk, and Executive Communication 

  • Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, escalation, decision-making, and change-control processes.  

  • Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.  

  • Track schedule, budget, scope, quality, resource capacity, benefits realization, and operational-readiness indicators.  

  • Prepare executive-level reports, decision papers, program dashboards, and recommendations.  

  • Clearly communicate complex technical issues to executive, business, operational, and nontechnical stakeholders.  

  • Escalate unresolved risks, scope conflicts, budget pressures, resource constraints, and delivery concerns in a timely manner.  

  • Facilitate steering committees, design reviews, readiness reviews, risk workshops, and executive decision meetings.  

  • Create consistent program-management processes and reusable organizational assets across portfolios and business units.  

The candidate has demonstrated experience developing governance frameworks, managing program changes and tradeoffs, coordinating subject-matter experts, and reporting schedule, budget, quality, and risk to senior leadership.  


Stakeholder and Team Leadership 

  • Build strong working relationships with CIOs, directors, senior managers, engineering leaders, application owners, operations teams, facilities organizations, procurement, finance, and external partners.  

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.  

  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, decision rights, and escalation paths across program participants.  

  • Promote accountability, transparency, customer advocacy, continuous improvement, and high delivery standards.  

  • Mentor project managers, technical leads, analysts, and other program team members.  

  • Resolve conflicts constructively while protecting agreed program objectives, governance, and technical requirements.  


Required Qualifications: 

  • Ten or more years of progressive experience leading enterprise infrastructure, data center, network, cloud, or technology-transformation programs.  

  • Demonstrated experience managing large, complex, multi-year infrastructure programs involving multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder groups.  

  • Strong knowledge of data center architecture, enterprise network infrastructure, cybersecurity, compute, storage, virtualization, and disaster-recovery concepts.  

  • Experience leading data center consolidation, migration, modernization, greenfield, or major infrastructure deployment initiatives.  

  • Demonstrated ability to develop program strategies, scopes, schedules, budgets, resource plans, governance structures, and risk-management frameworks.  

  • Experience coordinating architects, engineers, facilities teams, operations personnel, application owners, vendors, and executive stakeholders.  

  • Experience managing program budgets, forecasts, commercial risks, and significant technology portfolios.  

  • Experience supporting or leading RFI, RFP, SOW, vendor-selection, and contract-scope activities.  

  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.  

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally based on program requirements.  

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.  


Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience with active-active data center architectures and large-scale application migrations.  

  • Experience with high-performance computing and other business-critical infrastructure environments.  

  • Experience with Cisco networking, SD-WAN, software-defined networking, Palo Alto security platforms, BGP, OSPF, and enterprise remote-access solutions.  

  • Familiarity with IT service management, business continuity, disaster recovery, ERP, and infrastructure lifecycle management.  

  • Experience working with colocation providers, engineering consultants, general contractors, cloud providers, and managed-service organizations.  

  • PMP, PgMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CDCP, CDFOM, or comparable technical or program-management certification.  

  • Experience working in global, matrixed organizations.  

  • Experience managing programs valued at $100 million or more.  

The resume supports extensive cross-functional leadership, formal project planning, RAID management, infrastructure assessments, executive reporting, and development of procurement documentation such as RFIs, RFPs, and SOWs.  


Key Performance Indicators:

Success in the role will be evaluated through: 

  • Achievement of program milestones within approved scope, schedule, and budget.  

  • Quality and completeness of infrastructure requirements and delivery plans.  

  • Timely identification and mitigation of program risks and dependencies.  

  • Accuracy and transparency of executive reporting.  

  • Successful completion of data center migrations and production cutovers.  

  • Reduction of unplanned scope changes and unresolved design gaps.  

  • Stakeholder confidence and effectiveness of cross-functional coordination.  

  • Vendor performance and contractual compliance.  

  • Operational readiness and successful transition to support teams.  

  • Delivery of measurable improvements in infrastructure resilience, scalability, capacity, security, cost, or service performance.  


Compensation & Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $154,200 to $277,600 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation (10-15%). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/


Equal Employment Opportunity 

The company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees. Employment decisions will be based on qualifications, experience, business requirements, and demonstrated ability to perform the responsibilities of the position. 

 

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).  Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

How long is the Building Automation Solutions Sales Internship and when can I start?

This internship is a 10-week program where you will rotate through various departments at your local branch office, focusing all on smart buildings and sustainable infrastructure.  Internship Program Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7 and June 14, 2027.

What is Building Automation?

Siemens Building Automation Systems is a building management system (BMS) that automatically manages and controls all systems within a building. These systems include lighting, heating, cooling, ventilation, fire detection and notification, CCTV, door and window controls, water and waste management. It consists of sensors, controllers, software and communication devices. Siemens offers building automation systems for all building types and sizes, and for every use. The system is designed to manage a wide range of building systems, such as HVAC, lighting, security, fire safety, and other critical building functions.

Click HERE to learn more about Siemens’ Building Automation and Control Systems.


What is Building Automation Solutions Sales?

The Building Automation Solutions Sales Team is committed to supporting our new construction customers and will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines. Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services.

About this job

Siemens seeks a Grid Operations Architect to design and lead the strategic transformation of a global high-performance computing infrastructure serving 3,000 engineers. The role owns the architectural vision for scaling from 263,000 cores to nearly one million cores across 18+ distributed grids while migrating to a modern scheduler platform.

Good fit if you have deep experience architecting large-scale distributed computing systems, scheduler platforms, and capacity planning at enterprise scale.

Full job description

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.


Position Overview:

Siemens DISW’s Engineering Grid Computing Services team strategically supports over 3000 engineers located in R&D centers worldwide. The Engineering Grid Computing Service (EGCS) within GTI operates 18+ globally distributed high-performance computing grids across 7+ sites, currently provisioning 263,000+ CPU cores across four scheduler platforms (Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, and SLURM). This infrastructure processes up to 12 million jobs per day at peak and serves approximately 3,000 engineers — it is the compute backbone that chip design, verification, and validation depend on. We are seeking a Grid Operations Architect to own the architectural vision and technical strategy for the next generation of this computing fabric. The immediate mandate: scale consolidated grid capacity from a quarter million cores to almost one million cores over the next five-six years while simultaneously transforming and modernizing the entire environment— the migration from Altair Grid Engine to Accelerator Plus, a hierarchical scheduler purpose-built for the throughput demands of EDA workloads This is a senior technical leadership role that bridges grid operations, infrastructure engineering, and strategic planning. Today, a lean team of 3 core grid administrators and 4 regional service delivery partners operate this global service — the Architect role is the structural investment that accelerates transformation and reduces key-person risk. You will define how Siemens DISW’s compute infrastructure is designed, deployed, and operated on a world-class scale. The key purposes of this role are based on the following: 

  • As EDA workloads grow and push the limits of what performance can be achieved with existing designs, a next generation architecture is the answer to meet the growing computing demands.
  • The Accelerator migration is the architectural response — and it needs a dedicated owner.
  • Key Technical/Strategic leadership need has been identified, providing depth and resilience to team
  • The path to 24x5 follow-the-sun coverage, >50% toil reduction through automation, and full-service excellence depends on an architectural foundation that today's operational team does not have the bandwidth to design.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the multiyear architectural roadmap for scaling grid compute capacity from 263K+ cores to 1M+ cores across 18+ globally distributed grids, consolidating across sites while maintaining availability and performance.
  • Design the phased migration plan from AGE to Accelerator's hierarchical scheduling platform
  • Design next generation grid topologies, scheduling frameworks, and resource management strategies that optimize utilization, throughput, and cost efficiency at a million core scale. One of the largest grids alone handles 60K+ cores and 2M+ jobs/dayarchitectures must perform at this density.
  • Develop consolidation strategies to reduce operational complexity rationalizing 4 scheduler platforms toward a unified Accelerator based model, standardizing tooling, and harmonizing operational policies across regions.
  • Lead capacity planning and forecasting models that project compute demand growth using linear, exponential, and flat percentage projections. Translate business requirements into infrastructure investment plans aligned with the 80% utilization ceiling and 72% procurement trigger governance model.
  • Architect hybrid and cloud burst strategies (e.g., NavOps ) to augment on premises capacity for peak demand and elastic workloads working with A&S and Networking teams while respecting the latency and data locality requirements of EDA workloads
  • Design fault - tolerant, self healing grid architectures that minimize downtime and reduce manual intervention critical for enabling 24x5 follow the sun coverage without proportional headcount growth.
  • Establish architectural standards, reference designs, and best practices for grid deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management across all 18+ grids and 9+ clusters.
  • Design and drive the evolution of the grid automation and tooling ecosystem — modernizing legacy Perl/Shell-based operational tools toward scalable, maintainable platforms (Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, GitLab CI/CD). Target: >50% reduction in manual operational toil across 8 identified operational areas.
  • Architect the observability and analytics stack (Elastic Stack with geo-redundant instances across Americas and Asia, Grafana, Power BI) to provide real-time visibility into grid performance, availability, utilization, and capacity across all grids.
  • Design AI-assisted alerting and auto-classification capabilities leveraging Elastic AI Agent and ServiceNow API integration to move from reactive monitoring to predictive operations.
  • Evolve SLA frameworks and operational KPIs from current state to improve reporting, performance: 99.97% availability per quarter, >97% SLO compliance, 30-minute MTTR, job wait time tracking at P50 and P95.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives for emerging technologies (containerised workloads, GPU/accelerator scheduling, next-gen schedulers) and evaluate their applicability to Siemens EDA workloads.
  • Partner with engineering leadership, R&D teams, and business stakeholders to understand compute demand trends, workload characteristics, and evolving requirements.
  • Collaborate with A&S team, Infrastructure Technology Verticals — networking, storage, virtualization, and data center operations — to ensure end-to-end infrastructure coherence and performance.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with grid software vendors (Altair/Siemens, IBM, SchedMD) for roadmap alignment, escalation management, and strategic feature requests. Leverage Siemens' internal ownership of Altair for strategic advantage.
  • Present architectural proposals, trade-off analyses, and investment recommendations to senior IT leadership and executive stakeholders. Connect every infrastructure investment to a business outcome.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to grid administrators and operations engineers, elevating the team's architectural thinking and engineering practices. Drive cross-training from 2 to 3+ schedulers per person.
  • Establish and maintain grid operations governance — change management (moving toward Git-based infrastructure-as-code), configuration standards, security policies, and compliance frameworks for large-scale compute environments.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis of incidents, performance trends, and utilization patterns using Elastic dashboards and capacity modelling tools (Griddash).
  • Design self-service onboarding and provisioning workflows (ServiceNow catalogue items) to reduce manual provisioning overhead and improve time-to-compute for engineering teams.
  • Ensure software license compliance across all grid engines and associated tooling — particularly critical during the scheduler consolidation from 3 license agreements to 1.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity planning for grid services.
  • Participate in daily operations standups, weekly staff meetings, and bi-weekly cadences with key customer teams. Provide architectural input on operational issues and escalations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure architecture, or HPC/grid computing environments, with at least 5 years in an architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise with distributed computing platforms — hands-on experience architecting and operating at least two of: Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, SLURM, or equivalent workload schedulers.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling compute infrastructure in large, multi-site, enterprise-wide environments (100K+ cores). Experience with scheduler migrations or platform consolidation at production scale.
  • Strong systems-level knowledge of Linux (RHEL/CentOS), including kernel tuning, performance optimization, and large-scale fleet management.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure automation and tooling — Python, Perl, Shell scripting — with experience in modern approaches (Ansible, Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NFS/GPFS, InfiniBand), storage architectures, and virtualisation as they relate to HPC and grid computing.
  • Experience in cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and hybrid cloud/cloud-burst architectures for HPC workloads (e.g., NavOps, Cycle Cloud).
  • Proven ability to develop and communicate multi-year technical roadmaps and translate business requirements into architectural decisions with clear investment justification.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills with experience presenting to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in one or more of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Singularity) and their application in HPC environments.
  • Experience with observability and analytics platforms (Elastic Stack, Grafana, Prometheus,
  • Power BI) at scale — particularly geo-distributed deployments.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML operations and GPU/accelerator scheduling for heterogeneous computing architectures.
  • Experience with database systems (MySQL, MSSQL, PostgreSQL) for operational data management and reporting.
  • Understanding ITIL 4 processes — incident management, problem management, change control— in large-scale infrastructure operations.
  • Experience supporting EDA (Electronic Design Automation) workloads — simulation, regression,
  • DRC/LVS, benchmarking, and tape-out compute patterns.
  • Background in capacity planning, financial modelling for infrastructure investments, and TCO analysis.

This is not a traditional grid administration role. The Grid Operations Architect will shape the strategic direction of one of the largest compute fabrics in the industry — an infrastructure that processes up to 12 million jobs per day and directly enables the design and verification of next-generation

semiconductors. You will lead the most significant technology transformation in the service's history (the Accelerator migration), architect a 4x capacity scale-up across a globally distributed footprint and design the automation and observability foundations that make million-core operations sustainable.

Job.JobDescription:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software

We are a leading global software company dedicated to computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company and the energy of a software start-up, we create a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth.

Position Overview

Lead our Federal Aerospace & Defense sales team covering the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy. You'll nurture executive customer relationships and develop multi-year sales strategies to drive adoption of our Xcelerator portfolio and core products—Teamcenter, NX, and related solutions. Managing five Client Sales Executives, you'll build a high-performing team focused on delivering innovative PLM solutions to federal customers and supporting the war-fighter mission. The Federal group generates significant revenue, and you'll play a critical role in expanding this presence across the Department of War and its supply base. You'll work collaboratively with Sales Managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and seamless customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Relationship & Strategic Leadership

  • Build and maintain high-quality relationships with senior and executive leadership across federal agencies, including U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy
  • Lead the development and execution of long-term comprehensive strategies for customer retention and growth, ensuring continuous focus across cross-functional sales teams on identifying and executing new business opportunities
  • Nurture executive customer relationships and collaborate with sales and technical leadership to develop and implement high-impact multi-year sales strategies
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and strategic account planning with key federal customers
  • Navigate complex, sophisticated federal sales cycles and coordinate across federal contracting vehicles and procurement processes
  • Understand customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment to drive value-based selling

Team Development & Sales Execution

  • Develop, motivate, and coach a high-performing team of five Client Sales Executives to progress and close business using standard sales methodologies
  • Supervise the development and implementation of in-depth account strategy plans aligned with federal customer requirements and strategic objectives
  • Provide mentorship and coaching to team members on complex deal negotiations and customer relationship management
  • Drive identification and execution of new business opportunities within the federal sector, ensuring quota achievement across the team
  • Foster a team culture that emphasizes high ownership, customer-first focus, fast-paced execution, high integrity, and an optimistic environment

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Growth

  • Work effectively in a matrixed environment with internal teams and external partners across the Aerospace & Defense organization
  • Collaborate with sales managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and avoid conflicts
  • Build strong relationships and partnerships both internally and externally; quickly establish trust with senior leaders and empower cross-functional teams to develop solutions
  • Ensure alignment between company objectives and customer needs, balancing growth with customer success and optimizing results at the company level
  • Address competing priorities and solve complex problems in a timely manner
  • Support partner sales representatives in understanding federal customer needs and provide training on new initiatives, including perpetual-to-SaaS migration transactions

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years' experience selling large strategic enterprise software solutions to the Department of War, with ability to navigate complex federal sales cycles. This software sales experience is a non-negotiable.
  • At least 2+ years of managing a sales team, directly or indirectly
  • At least 3-5+ years experience selling into the US Military sector.
  • Consistent track record of planning, negotiating, and closing deals with highly complex accounts
  • Proven quota achievement throughout career with demonstrated success delivering results
  • At least 3+ years' experience in large enterprise software, selling at the C-suite (CXO) level
  • Success leading a matrixed environment and building relationships and partnerships both internally and externally
  • Outstanding interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with ability to engage customers at all levels, including executive and C-level leadership
  • Excellent business judgment and demonstrated success delivering results optimized at the company level (balanced between company and customer needs)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Project), Salesforce.com, SAP, and other job-related software
  • Ability to understand federal customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment
  • Ability to understand sophisticated and typically long sales cycles at the strategic level
  • Must currently reside in the continental USA (firm requirement)
  • 4-year college degree required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Military background or experience in the defense sector
  • Knowledge of government contracting and federal procurement vehicles (GSA, IDIQ, etc.)
  • Experience with federal compliance and export control requirements
  • Understanding of Department of War acquisition processes and requirements
  • Familiarity with Siemens Digital Industries Software portfolio and related products
  • Experience with perpetual-to-SaaS migration strategies and cloud-based software models

Employment Requirements

Accordingly, U.S. citizenship is required for this role. This requirement is a bona fide occupational qualification.  This position requires access to facilities or systems operated by the U.S. Department of War which restricts access to U.S. citizens

Qualified applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified applicants will not require employer-sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States

About this job

Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant performing large-scale electrical grid simulations and consulting engagements for utilities and transmission organizations. Role includes grid analysis, system dynamics studies, client relationship management, and mentoring junior consultants on the team.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of transmission power systems analysis experience, expertise with PSS®E and other grid software, and work history with major ISO/RTO operators.

Full job description

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to planning and integrating renewables, storage, large loads, and FACTS devices into the electrical grid. The Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing and leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Supporting and managing project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations in collaboration with team members to communicate study results.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients’ business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting and leading proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Supporting technical reviews of ongoing studies and contributing to the mentoring and development of junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience performing transmission power systems analysis, with demonstrated ability to independently execute and interpret power flow and dynamic stability studies.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, electrical utilities consulting company, or national labs, including work involving at least one of PJM, MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, ERCOT, or SPP.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E, and experience with or working knowledge of at least one of TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld.
  • Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and an understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting and/or business development experience.
  • Experience in distribution planning, DER integration, or microgrids, and familiarity with or experience using CYME, Synergi, or OpenDSS.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™.
  • Experience leading studies, managing budgets and schedules, and mentoring or developing others professionally.

About this job

Design and implement building automation systems for AI Factory facilities, integrating Building Management Systems with PLCs, power monitoring, and digital twin platforms. Focus on scalable telemetry architectures and data flow optimization using protocols like MQTT, OPC UA, and BACnet/IP.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in building automation or control systems, expertise with BMS, and proficiency in multiple industrial communication protocols.

Full job description

Position Summary  

The AI Factory Building Automation Engineer is a critical technical leader responsible for integrating and optimizing building technology within our mission-critical AI Factory facilities. Leveraging deep expertise in Building Management Systems (BMS) and advanced communication protocols, you will design and implement scalable telemetry architectures, ensuring seamless data flow from operational systems to digital twin platforms. Your work will be instrumental in defining robust alarm, KPI, and visualization strategies, balancing comprehensive observability with stringent system performance requirements.  

You’ll make an impact by  

  • Applying deep expertise in Building Management Systems (BMS), specifically Siemens Desigo CC, to manage and optimize mission-critical facilities.  
  • Designing and implementing scalable telemetry architectures for high-volume, high-frequency operational data within complex building systems.  
  • Integrating BMS with various critical platforms, including PLCs, EPMS (Electrical Power Monitoring Systems), DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management), and digital twin environments.  
  • Ensuring all integrations and data flows adhere to strict latency, bandwidth, and reliability constraints essential for AI Factory operations.  
  • Defining scalable alarm, Key Performance Indicator (KPI), and visualization strategies that effectively balance comprehensive observability with optimal system performance.  
  • Utilizing proficiency in communication protocols such as MQTT, REST APIs, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, and Modbus TCP to facilitate robust system interoperability.  
  • Contributing to the overall efficiency, reliability, and advanced monitoring capabilities of Siemens' AI Factory infrastructure. 
Responsibilities:
  • Support feasibility studies of data center cooling/ compute system control and optimization technologies
  • Lead concept development for joint automation/ controls offering
  • Implement test/ demo projects with partners
  • Setting up MQTT/ REST API/ Modbus/ Redfish integration
  • Test/ Implement Sequence of Control in Amesim/ TIA for simulation and validation

Core Competencies  

  • Building Management Systems (BMS): Deep expertise in BMS, particularly Siemens Desigo CC, for mission-critical facilities.  
  • Communication Protocols: Proficiency in MQTT, REST APIs, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, and Modbus TCP.
