About this job

Product Marketing Manager for Innovator3D IC, a software suite for advanced semiconductor packaging and chiplet integration. Focus on market trends, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for signal/power integrity and simulation products used by leading semiconductor companies.

Good fit if you have 5+ years product marketing experience in IC design or packaging, understand chiplet heterogeneous integration, and can work cross-functionally with sales and product teams.

Full job description

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

The Electronic Board Systems Group (EBS) of Siemens EDA develops software solutions for the prototyping/pathfinding, simulation/modeling, detailed physical implementation and management of the associated data for advanced 2.5/3D IC heterogeneously integrated semiconductor packages. Advanced 2.5/3D semiconductor packaging significantly enhances system performance, integration density, and energy efficiency while enabling heterogeneous chiplet integration for AI, Hyperscalers, HPC and mobile applications. Siemens EDA has the broadest and most comprehensive technology stack in the market today. Siemens EDA has long been recognized as the innovation leader in IC and 2.5/3D packaging software solutions that cover the entire development process. The world’s leading fabless semiconductor and electronic system companies count on Siemens EDA design technologies to meet the challenge of increasing product complexity while meeting aggressive business targets.

The Opportunity: Innovator3D ICTM Product Marketing

The EBS portfolio unit is seeking a Product Marketing Manager for the Innovator3D IC product family of technologies. The Innovator3D IC™ product family enables “right first time” design and heterogeneous integration of chiplets into a high-performance integration platform. This suite of products helps companies predictably achieve their design and market window schedules by resolving the barriers of design complexity that impact design cycles, thereby accelerating designer productivity.

  The successful candidate would be able to identify market trends, opportunities, leverage key themes and customer needs in the signal/power integrity and simulation segment into marketing programs, sales materials, and field marketing campaigns.  With a strong focus on cross-functional collaboration and creating sophisticated marketing programs in a complex, ever-changing global market landscape, the successful candidate will make a material difference to revenue within the business unit.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify market trends, opportunities, and competitive threats to shape product and go-to-market strategies that maximize corporate revenue.
  • Define key product messages, positioning, and branding strategies to enhance market perception and adoption.
  • Leverage key industry themes and customer needs to create impactful marketing programs, customer collateral, sales materials, and field marketing campaigns.
  • Develop and execute brand and segment strategies that align with divisional initiatives and corporate goals.
  • Drive marketing programs that establish Siemens EDA and the Innovator3D IC product family as industry thought and technology leaders.
  • Support product launches, ensuring the successful adoption and continued growth of Innovator3D IC product family in the market.
  • Collaborate with Market Development and Product Strategy & Technology teams to develop and refine messaging, pricing, packaging, and promotional plans.
  • Collaborate with other Siemens EDA technology divisions to develop, message, position and promote a comprehensive 3D IC solution stack
  • Work closely with market development and sales teams to craft compelling messaging for new solutions, product releases, and marketing campaigns.
  • Monitor and analyze market trends and competitive intelligence to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Develop and execute event strategies for key trade shows, industry conferences, and customer events to enhance brand visibility and lead generation.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field (Masters degree preferred).
  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, or a related role within the electronics industry, in the domain of IC design, IC package design or printed circuit board.
  • A firm understanding of the principles and challenges associated with the heterogeneous integration of multiple chiplets into a high-performance substrate platform including prototyping, pathfinding, detailed design, Multiphysics analysis and manufacturing signoff.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical features into value propositions.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute marketing campaigns.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with sales, product management, and business development teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret market data and customer insights.
  • Ability to travel as needed for industry events, conferences, and customer engagements.

About this job

Senior Energy Consultant supporting power market modeling, asset valuation, and strategic planning for utilities and energy developers. Develops production cost models, analyzes grid operations, and delivers market outlooks to inform investment and resource decisions.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of production cost modeling experience, understand U.S. power markets and renewable integration, and can travel up to 25% of the time.

Full job description

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step. 

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is helping businesses navigate complexity, drive growth, and steer strategic direction in an evolving landscape. Our wide range of services offer solutions in planning, managing risk, improving operations, conducting custom market studies, supporting M&A activities, and developing infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Energy Consultant to deliver valuable solutions to utilities, investors, and project developers. We seek someone with deep expertise in power market modeling to support asset valuation, curtailment and congestion analysis, strategic market outlooks, and project siting decisions. Transform the everyday with us!

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S. 

You’ll make an impact as you: 

  • Develop and run production cost and market models to support Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and broader integrated system planning studies.
  • Build power price forecasts and long-term market outlooks to inform utility, developer, and investor decisions.
  • Analyze system operations, resource adequacy, and portfolio performance under different planning scenarios and policy pathways.
  • Support clients in evaluating generation, storage, and transmission investments within integrated planning frameworks.
  • Deliver insights that help clients optimize portfolios, manage risks, and align with evolving market and regulatory conditions.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven reports and presentations that communicate technical results and strategic implications.
  • Mentor junior consultants in modeling, analytics, and interpretation of results.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications: 

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, economics, operations research, finance, statistics, physics, or mathematics.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in production cost modeling and power market analytics (using  Aurora, PLEXOS, PROMOD, or other production cost modeling tools).
  • Strong understanding of U.S. power markets, renewable integration, and transmission constraints.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, primarily within the U.S.

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Prior consulting experience with utilities, developers, or investors.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical analyses in clear, client-ready deliverables.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, interconnection processes, and decarbonization policies.

We are looking for a Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is essential to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Leading and performing advanced power system studies, including system dynamics, electromagnetic transients, interconnection analysis, and grid code compliance using industry-standard tools.
  • Performing and reviewing detailed modeling and simulation work for synchronous machines, inverter-based resources, and control systems.
  • Managing and supporting technical project execution by tracking milestones, validating study assumptions, and ensuring work meets defined technical scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Developing, validating, and documenting study methodologies and assumptions, and producing detailed technical reports and client-ready presentations.
  • Collaborating with multi-disciplinary engineering teams to interpret study results and resolve complex system performance issues.
  • Providing technical mentorship to junior consultants on modeling approaches, simulation techniques, and established guidelines.
  • Designing and implementing automation scripts and workflows to enhance model development, study execution, post-processing, and quality control.
  • Supporting on-site technical consulting engagements and delivering specialized training on power system modeling, simulation tools, and study methodologies.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in power system studies, with strong hands-on expertise in PSCAD and electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations.
  • Proven experience developing, validating, and troubleshooting detailed PSCAD models for inverter-based resources, renewable generation, energy storage systems, and grid-connected power electronics.
  • Experience performing EMT studies for grid compliance, including fault ride-through, control interactions, harmonic and subsynchronous interaction analysis.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required

We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Lead will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing/leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Managing/supporting project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations with study results in collaboration with team members.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients’ business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Providing mentoring and technical development to junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, developers, or national labs; 5+ years preferred.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required; additional experience with TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld. preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting experience.
  • Experience working in the ISO-NE, PJM, and/or SPP regions
  • Experience in distribution planning.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™ or EMTP-RV

Integrated Medical Services LPN

Summary

As an Integrated Medical Services LPN at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide direct patient care, medication administration, clinical monitoring, and documentation within the scope of Florida nursing practice and under appropriate supervision.

This role supports clients receiving behavioral health, crisis stabilization, detoxification, and substance-use treatment services while promoting safety, recovery, and continuity of care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver safe, compassionate nursing care, including assessments, vital signs, clinical monitoring, treatments, and activities of daily living.
  • Administer medications accurately, monitor therapeutic effects and adverse reactions, maintain medication security, and report medication-related concerns.
  • Observe and report changes in physical, behavioral, psychiatric, or withdrawal-related conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies.
  • Support admissions, transfers, discharges, referrals, and interdisciplinary treatment planning.
  • Implement provider orders and perform authorized nursing procedures, including wound care, specimen collection, injections, and point-of-care testing.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation in the electronic health record.

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, audits, regulatory compliance activities, and ongoing professional development.

Work Environment

This position may involve working in behavioral health and substance-use treatment settings and requires flexibility to work evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed.

About this job

Good fit if you have an APRN license in Florida, board certification as FNP or PMHNP, and experience in behavioral health or integrated care.

Full job description

Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)

Aspire Health Partners is a leading Integrated behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care organization committed to providing comprehensive healthcare services to individuals and families. We strive to deliver high-quality, compassionate, comprehensive, and cost-effective care within an integrated, patient-centered, and supportive environment.

As a Integrated Medical Services APRN, you will play a vital role in our integrated care continuum, providing exceptional medical services to patients with a focus on behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care. This is an exciting opportunity to work with our multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional care and ensure our patients receive comprehensive treatment for their mental health, addiction, and primary care needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric and medical assessments, including health histories, physical examinations, mental status evaluations, and risk assessments.
  • Evaluate and diagnose mental health, substance use, and medical conditions, including acute and chronic illnesses, withdrawal, intoxication, and psychiatric crises.
  • Develop and implement individualized, recovery-oriented treatment plans in collaboration with clients and interdisciplinary care teams.
  • Prescribe, monitor, adjust, and discontinue medications in accordance with clinical guidelines, organizational policies, and applicable state regulations.
  • Order, interpret, and review laboratory tests, diagnostic studies, and other clinical assessments to support treatment decisions.
  • Monitor treatment effectiveness, medication adherence, side effects, safety concerns, and barriers to care.
  • Provide education regarding diagnoses, medications, treatment options, wellness strategies, and recovery goals.
  • Coordinate care with physicians, psychiatrists, therapists, nurses, pharmacists, case managers, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Identify patients requiring specialty referrals, emergency intervention, hospitalization, or higher levels of care.
  • Participate in treatment team meetings, discharge planning, case reviews, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with organizational, professional, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • Current Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) license in the State of Florida.
  • Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or other applicable APRN specialty.
  • DEA registration and prescriptive authority as required.
  • Experience in behavioral health, psychiatry, primary care, substance use treatment, crisis stabilization, or integrated healthcare settings preferred.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, treatment planning, communication, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Qualifications:

  • Valid APRN license in Florida.
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit https://info.flclearinghouse.c.om to learn more.
  • Master's degree in Nursing or Post MS Certificate from an accredited University/College.
  • Board Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or Adult Gerontological Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPC).
  • 2 years of experience as a Nurse Practitioner (preferred). Willing to work with motivated new graduates.
  • Excellent clinical assessment, diagnostic, and treatment skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a patient-centered approach.
  • Proficient in using electronic medical record (EMR) systems and other relevant healthcare software.

Benefits: We offer a competitive salary package and are an approved employer for Federal loan forgiveness programs. In addition, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and more. We value work-life balance and prioritize the well-being of our employees.

If you are a passionate and dedicated Nurse Practitioner who thrives in an integrated care environment and is committed to making a positive impact in the lives of others, we encourage you to apply.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in IT/Data Science/Health Informatics, 3+ years healthcare data analysis or quality experience, EHR system knowledge, and can work on-site in Orlando.

Full job description

Quality Data Analyst (On-Site Only – Orlando, FL)

Pay Rate: $22.00 per hour
Location: Orlando, FL 32804
Work Arrangement: 100% On-Site

Important Information for Applicants

->This position is NOT remote.
->Hybrid work is not available.
->Relocation assistance is not offered.

Applicants should be local to the Orlando area or able to reliably commute to our Orlando office. Candidates requiring relocation support or a remote work arrangement will not be considered.

Join Aspire Health Partners as a Quality Data Analyst

Are you passionate about using data to improve healthcare outcomes? Aspire Health Partners is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Data Analyst to support our mission of delivering high-quality behavioral health services. This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys uncovering insights, improving processes, ensuring compliance, and leveraging technology to drive organizational excellence.

As a Quality Data Analyst, you will work closely with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams to evaluate performance, support quality initiatives, and ensure data integrity across the organization.

What You'll Do

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze healthcare and quality performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
  • Provide actionable insights that support informed decision-making and operational excellence.
  • Utilize data analytics to measure outcomes and track organizational performance.

Internal Auditing & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits across clinical and administrative departments.
  • Monitor compliance with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend data-driven corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement and monitor audit findings and resolutions.

Quality Improvement

  • Assist in designing and executing quality improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and help develop sustainable corrective action plans.
  • Monitor progress, measure results, and report findings to leadership.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence.

Technology & Systems Support

  • Support the integration, optimization, and ongoing use of quality and compliance-related IT systems.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and security.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for data systems, reporting tools, and quality processes.
  • Train staff on audit procedures, data reporting practices, and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, IT systems, internal auditing, or quality management within a healthcare environment.
  • Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and quality standards.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and confidentiality.
  • Power BI experience strongly preferred.
  • Certification in Healthcare Quality, Auditing, or related discipline.

Additional Requirements

Successful candidates must be able to obtain and maintain:

  • Level II Background Clearance
    All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.c... to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)
    In accordance with Aspire Health Partners' transportation and insurance requirements.

About this job

Maintenance Technician for ONE DAYTONA mixed-use property in Daytona Beach. Role includes routine inspections, facility upkeep, repair work (painting, drywall, plumbing, carpentry, electrical), equipment operation, and event support with flexible scheduling including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Good fit if you have two or more years of building or facilities maintenance experience, knowledge of multiple trades, valid driver's license, and can work flexible schedules including weekends and special events.

Full job description

At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


ONE DAYTONA is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to:

  • Help shape a welcoming, well-maintained environment for tenants, guests, and visitors.
  • Drive operational excellence through proactive facility maintenance, property upkeep, and attention to detail.
  • Support the successful execution of community events, activations, and day-to-day property operations.

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Conduct routine inspections to identify maintenance, cleanliness, and safety concerns throughout the property.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in delivering high-quality work.
  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset and willingness to support a variety of operational needs.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help shape the daily experience of everyone who visits, works, and does business at ONE DAYTONA.

From maintaining the appearance and functionality of the property to supporting special events and responding to operational needs, your work will have a direct impact on creating a safe, welcoming, and first-class destination. As a member of the Property Operations team, you'll play an important role in preserving the quality and reputation of ONE DAYTONA while helping deliver the exceptional experiences that keep guests, tenants, and visitors coming back.

About this job

Lead track maintenance and safety infrastructure at Homestead-Miami Speedway, a 650-acre NASCAR facility hosting events nearly 300 days per year. Supervise maintenance teams, coordinate equipment and staffing, and ensure the track remains race-ready year-round.

Good fit if you have two to four years of maintenance or facility operations experience and can lead teams while working flexible schedules including weekends and holidays.

Full job description

HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway is seeking an experienced Track Maintenance Supervisor to:

  • Help shape a safe, race-ready environment for competitors, employees, and event partners.
  • Lead a skilled maintenance team responsible for the upkeep of critical track and facility infrastructure.
  • Drive operational excellence through proactive planning, problem-solving, and execution of maintenance projects and event activities.
  • Create efficient processes that support seamless event operations and year-round facility readiness.
  • Advance the speedway's ability to host world-class racing and entertainment events through strong leadership and hands-on expertise.

...based in Homestead, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a working supervisor, leading and participating in maintenance and repair activities involving the track surface, safety barriers, fencing, and facility structures.
  • Plan, prioritize, and coordinate maintenance projects while identifying and implementing practical solutions to operational challenges.
  • Schedule, train, develop, and supervise track maintenance personnel, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and to high standards.
  • Coordinate equipment, staffing, and logistical needs to support race weekends, special events, and daily operations.
  • Operate and oversee the use of maintenance equipment required for facility upkeep and event execution.
  • Train on-track crews and support race operations by ensuring personnel understand procedures, responsibilities, and safety expectations.
  • Partner with racing series, internal teams, and event stakeholders to support successful event preparation, execution, and post-event activities.
  • Maintain schedules, support racing activities, and ensure the facility remains event-ready year-round.

What You’ll Bring

  • High school diploma or GED required; equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
  • Two to four years of maintenance, facility operations, construction, or related experience.
  • Experience operating equipment used in maintenance, facility operations, or event support environments.
  • Proven ability to lead, train, and develop teams while managing schedules and competing priorities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Ability to read and interpret safety regulations, operating procedures, maintenance instructions, and technical documentation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic math skills, including measurements, percentages, area, circumference, volume, and practical applications of algebra and geometry.
  • Valid Florida driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Bilingual skills are a plus.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to play a direct role in maintaining one of NASCAR's premier racing venues and ensuring it is safe, operational, and ready to host world-class events.

Your work will have a visible impact on every event held at Homestead-Miami Speedway. By leading maintenance operations, overseeing critical safety infrastructure, and coordinating teams and resources, you'll help create the foundation that allows races and events to run successfully. This role combines hands-on leadership with operational responsibility, offering the chance to influence the performance, safety, and long-term success of a facility that brings people together through unforgettable motorsports and entertainment experiences.

About this job

Coordinator, Guest Services at Daytona International Speedway supports guest experience by managing nonprofit volunteers, event staffing, equipment, transportation, and administrative activities. The role involves supervising staff, coordinating logistics for racing events and year-round activities, and managing vendor contracts and payroll.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in sport or event management, one to two years of event experience, staff supervision experience, and strong organizational skills

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

Daytona International Speedway seeks a talented professional to join our team as Coordinator, Guest Services. This position supports an exceptional guest experience by coordinating nonprofit organization volunteers, event staffing, equipment, transportation, vendor services, and administrative activities for Guest Services and other departments.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Nonprofit Organization (NPO) Supervisor, recruiting and maintaining relationships with volunteer groups and coordinating required documentation, contracts, credentials, and post-event payments.
  • Assist with preparing training materials for Guest Services Fan Crew members and NPO volunteers.
  • Coordinate social media and radio advertising for hiring events and NPO recruitment.
  • Use ABI MasterMind to replicate events, schedule staff, track labor costs, and process payroll for event employees.
  • Provide supervision for Tours staff, Crew Chiefs, Tram Maintenance, and Support personnel.
  • Assist at the Guest Services Desk in the Daytona International Speedway Ticket and Tours Lobby.
  • Prepare post-event summaries for management following major events.
  • Coordinate radios, golf carts, apparel, and other event equipment and supplies.
  • Support vehicle operations by coordinating vendor pricing, contracts, certificates of insurance, vehicle trade valuations, ticket trades, and vehicle pickup and return schedules.
  • Track vehicle registrations, license plates, service, and repairs; coordinate with Transportation and the DMV to maintain current registrations.
  • Maintain the toll authority account and monitor available funds.
  • Prepare vendor contracts, statements of work, invoices, and payment requests, coordinating legal review as needed.
  • Prepare and submit expenses and outstanding invoice information for monthly accruals.
  • Assist with hiring-event paperwork and HR documentation and processing for full-time and part-time employees.
  • Request permits for ADA carts and help ensure event operations follow established Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) guidelines.
  • Serve as the workers’ compensation liaison.
  • Coordinate show car appearances and special vehicle and transportation moves.
  • Assist the Director with the annual operating budget and prepare supporting documentation for smaller-event billbacks.
  • Partner with the Tours Manager to develop the annual modified tour schedule.
  • Participate in employee training sessions and travel regionally as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in sport management, event management, or a related field.
  • One to two years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Event management experience, preferably within the sports industry.
  • Demonstrated employee supervision experience, preferably with event-day staff.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft applications and web-based programs.
  • Strong verbal, written, and listening skills, including the ability to prepare reports and correspondence, interpret operating procedures, and communicate effectively with guests, vendors, volunteers, and employees.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Basic mathematical skills to support payroll, expense tracking, invoices, and budget activities.
  • A commitment to customer service, professional conduct, and representing Daytona International Speedway positively.

Schedule and Physical Requirements

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional extended shifts.
  • Ability to travel regionally as needed.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions and stand and walk for extended periods during events.
  • Ability to perform duties involving sitting, reaching, handling equipment, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling.
  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move more than 50 pounds.
  • Vision sufficient to perform assigned duties, including close and distance vision, color and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in creating the world-class guest experiences that make Daytona International Speedway a premier destination for motorsports fans. You'll work across multiple areas of the business, coordinating volunteers, event staffing, transportation, equipment, and operational logistics that directly support major racing events and year-round activities. From planning and preparation to event execution, you'll gain broad exposure to venue operations while building valuable experience in sports, events, guest services, and leadership.

About this job

Junior Data Scientist role at NASCAR in Daytona Beach analyzing data and supporting predictive modeling to drive business decisions. Work with SQL, Python, and AI-enabled analytics tools while collaborating across the organization, with up to 10% travel during race season.

Good fit if you have a degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, or related field, with SQL and Python skills, and familiarity with statistical and machine learning concepts.

Full job description

At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR is seeking a Junior Data Scientist based in Daytona Beach, Florida, to help transform data into actionable insights and intelligent solutions that drive business decisions across the organization. In this role, you'll analyze data, support predictive modeling initiatives, enhance AI-enabled analytics tools, and collaborate with stakeholders to solve real-world business challenges. This opportunity offers hands-on exposure to modern analytics, generative AI, and emerging technologies while helping shape the future of data-driven decision-making at NASCAR.

What You Will Do:


  • Prepare, combine, and analyze data using SQL and Python, investigating data quality issues and documenting business definitions.
  • Apply statistical methods and support predictive modeling to understand fan behavior, identify trends, forecast outcomes, and evaluate business performance.
  • Help develop, maintain, and enhance AI-enabled analytics tools, including Python-based tools and MCP integrations.
  • Test analytical tools and AI-generated answers against trusted SQL queries and reports; investigate errors and improve underlying logic, instructions, and tool descriptions.
  • Collaborate with business partners to translate questions and feedback into analyses, visualizations, and practical tools, communicating findings and limitations clearly.
  • Work with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to create repeatable workflows, maintain documentation, and follow established data access and governance practices.
  • Support user adoption, ongoing analytical needs, and additional projects as assigned..
  • Up to 10% travel throughout race season.

What You Will Bring:


  • Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • Foundational SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, and common table expressions, and experience using Python for data preparation and analysis.
  • Understanding of core statistical concepts and familiarity with basic machine learning methods and model evaluation.
  • Foundational understanding of generative AI’s capabilities and limitations, an interest in learning MCP and tool calling, and a commitment to validating AI-generated results.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with attention to accuracy and the ability to explain technical findings in business terms.
  • A collaborative, curious mindset and willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and manage competing priorities.

Why This Role?


This is an opportunity to help shape how NASCAR leverages data, analytics, and emerging AI technologies to support business strategy and decision-making. You'll partner with teams across the organization to uncover insights, develop practical analytical solutions, and improve how employees access and interact with data. Whether you're building predictive models, validating AI-generated outputs, or helping create new analytics capabilities, you'll see your work make a visible impact while continuing to grow your expertise in analytics, machine learning, and generative AI.

INTERNATIONAL MOTOR SPORTS ASSOCIATION (IMSA)

IMSA was originally founded in 1969 and owns a long and rich history in sports car racing. Today, IMSA is the sanctioning body of the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, the premier sports car racing series in North America. IMSA also sanctions the IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge, IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge and Historic Sportscar Racing, as well as five one-make series: Ferrari Challenge North America, Lamborghini Super Trofeo North America, Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin, Mustang Challenge and Porsche Carrera Cup North America. IMSA – a company within the NASCAR family – is the exclusive strategic partner in North America with the Automobile Club de l’Ouest (ACO) which operates the 24 Hours of Le Mans as a part of the FIA World Endurance Championship. The partnership enables selected IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship competitors to earn automatic entries into the prestigious 24 Hours of Le Mans. For more information, please visit www.IMSA.com, https://x.com/IMSA, www.facebook.com/IMSA or www.instagram.com/imsa_racing.

IMSA is seeking an experienced Senior Coordinator, Partnership Marketing to:

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.

Full job description

SEBRING INTERNATIONAL RACEWAY

This racetrack located in Sebring, Florida, is America’s oldest road racing track, with over six decades of storied history. It hosts the historic Twelve Hours of Sebring each year on the third Saturday of March on the 3.74-mile road course. The Twelve Hours of Sebring is one of the five endurance races on the IMSA schedule.


Sebring International Raceway seeks a talented professional to join us in the position of Corner Marshal. This position will report at the Sebring, Florida location.

Summary 
Corner Workers are stationed at various points of danger around the race track and are responsible for observing and monitoring track conditions and communicating with drivers by using flags to warn of track conditions and provide assistance in case of any collisions, accidents or track problems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Observe, monitor and assess track surface conditions.

Provide consistent information to drivers using racing flags and signals.

Observe competitors for driving behavior and their cars mechanical condition.

Help drivers and others in an incident.

Communicate information to radio tower, stewards, and emergency medical responders.

0% travel

Supervisory Responsibilities                               
This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience                               
High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Language Skills                               
Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos.  Ability to write simple correspondence.  Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills                               
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.  Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability                               
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions.  Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
                     
Other Qualifications                               
Must be willing to work weekdays and weekends, and some evenings. Ability to work in all types of weather.

This position is a safety sensitive position and participates in the Substance Abuse Program (SAP).

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Banquet Server / Event Staff, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Part-time
  • Location: Daytona Beach, FL

About this job

Seasonal event-based position supporting maintenance operations at Daytona International Speedway. Work involves assembling track equipment, operating heavy machinery, and performing preventive maintenance during major racing events and facility activities.

Good fit if you have experience with power tools, heavy equipment operation, and general maintenance work.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

The Daytona International Speedway seeks motivated individuals to join the Facility Operations team in the positions of Maintenance_Event based in Daytona Beach, Florida.

This position is a seasonal / event based position to assist the team in the areas of Maintenance Mechanic, Painter, Irrigation and Track Maintenance. Basic office systems knowledge including but not limited to computer system and programs, cellular phone and 2-way radios.

This position will perform routine preventative maintenance and repair procedures on race track and related infrastructures. Operate equipment and use tools as directed.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in executing DIS events – major races, track rentals, other events.

  • Assemble and disassemble track equipment such as track gates, barricades, portable bleachers, etc.

  • Use all types of power tools and large equipment including forklift, front end loader, backhoe, bucket truck.

  • Perform preventive building maintenance duties.

  • Clean, repair, lubricate and maintain equipment, tools and machinery used for construction jobs.

  • Use saws, hammer, nails and bolts for framing.

  • Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, compact and level earth to grade specifications using equipment, picks, or shovels

  • Perform light electrical, plumbing, drywall and carpentry repairs. Participate in general cleaning, painting, and repair work.

  • Other duties as assigned

Job.JobTitle: Guest Services Support Event Staff - Homestead-Miami Speedway
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Banquet Server / Event Staff, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway Guest Services Event Support Roles

NASCAR seeks talented professionals to join our event staff in the position of Support Team, Admissions Crew, Venue Crew, Tram Driver, Tram Ambassador, Tram Attendant, ADA Cart Support, and Information Crew based at Homestead-Miami Speedway.

SUPPORT TEAM

Setup and teardown items such as signage, tents, tables, chairs, and steel barricades, transporting staff to and from specific work locations on property, deliver items such as water coolers and event information to Fan Crew Members, assist all Guest Services departments with various tasks. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)

ADMISSIONS CREW

Admissions Crew checks each guest's ticket or credential for valid entry into the Venue or infield.

VENUE CREW

Venue Crew are responsible for bringing our guests an unforgettable race day experience! Ushers will assist by directing guests to the location of their seats and other points of interest, enforcing Speedway policies and procedures, providing event information to guests, and making sure everything in their area is in working order. Venue Crew may also work as elevator attendants to ensure the safety of our guests.

TRAM DRIVER

Drivers are responsible for safely and efficiently transporting our guests to various areas of the Speedway and ensuring that Tram Ambassadors are performing their duties. All drivers must have a valid Class A, B, or C CDL with current physical. Candidate must also pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR).

TRAM AMBASSADOR

Ambassadors are paired with a Driver and ensure that all safety equipment is operational and in good repair. Ambassadors sit at the front right corner of the tram facing the passengers, ensure that passengers remain seated, make safety announcements, and provide assistance when necessary with loading/unloading.

TRAM ATTENDANT

Tram Attendants proactively assist and greet our guests as they approach the tram plaza, professionally and courteously answer questions, advise guests which queue to enter, and assist with loading/unloading the tram, including guests with disabilities.

ADA CART SUPPORT

ADA Cart Support safely transport guests with disabilities, via golf carts, to and from designated locations. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

INFORMATION CREW

Information crew is positioned at information centers that are located around property and in the Venue. The guest services representative must be able to think quickly, utilize their tools to provide our fans with accurate information in a timely manner, and ensure our fans have a positive race-day experience.

Education and/or Experience:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Prior customer service experience is strongly preferred.

Other Skills, Abilities, and/or qualifications

  • Minimum age 18 years old.
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time.
  • Ability to work with others and take direction.
  • Ability to maintain a professional and courteous attitude with guests at all times.
  • Ability to work nights/weekends as assigned.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills.
  • Some positions may require a valid driver’s license and pass a motor vehicle license inspection report.
  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather conditions for extended periods.
  • Reliable transportation to and from the track location.

NASCAR is seeking a Manager, Contract Revenue, to lead accounting for assigned contract-based revenue streams. This role combines technical accounting expertise with hands-on ownership of contract review, the monthly close, audit support, and process improvement.

You will partner with teams across the business to translate complex agreements into clear accounting conclusions and help ensure revenue is recorded accurately and on time. This position is based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Review and interpret contracts for assigned revenue streams, determine the appropriate accounting treatment under ASC 606 and company policies, and document conclusions in technical accounting memos when needed.
  • Oversee monthly revenue close activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, variance analysis, and financial statement preparation. Research and resolve discrepancies to support accurate, timely reporting.
  • Support the annual external audit by preparing analyses and documentation and working directly with auditors as needed.
  • Maintain revenue accounting policies and procedures, support compliance with internal controls, and recommend improvements.
  • Lead and support initiatives that streamline revenue-related processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Help ensure accurate data flow between Workday and connected systems by overseeing mapping, translation tables, and reconciliations and partnering with system experts to resolve issues.
  • Provide financial data and analysis for special projects, strategic initiatives, and requests from teams including Tax, Legal, and Sales.


What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree and five or more years of accounting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with contracted revenue and a strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606.
  • Two years of public accounting experience preferred. CPA certification or CPA eligibility is also preferred.
  • Ability to explain accounting policies and conclusions clearly to management, business partners, customers, and accounting staff.
  • Advanced Excel skills. Experience with Workday Financials preferred.
  • Strong organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • A collaborative approach, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to accurate, timely work.
  • Experience managing staff is preferred.
  • Flexibility to work occasional overtime when needed to meet department deadlines and priorities.


Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex revenue accounting while helping improve how the work gets done. You will bring clarity to contract terms, partner with teams across the business, and strengthen the processes and systems that support accurate financial reporting.

NASCAR seeks a talented professional to join in the position of Coordinator, Event Operations, based in our Homestead, Florida office.


The Coordinator of Event Operations is a key role at Homestead-Miami Speedway (HMS), supporting the successful execution of major events and year-round operations. Primary responsibilities include assisting the Guest Services team during major events—most notably NASCAR weekend—while also managing track rentals, special events, and related client needs. The position carries a strong sales component, including leasing track time, negotiating agreements, securing renewals, and identifying upsell opportunities. An interest in motorsports and car culture is essential to connect with clients and fans.

  • Monitor and follow up on outstanding issues related to client accounts, track rentals, or events.
  • Identify operational efficiencies and opportunities to enhance revenue and improve the guest experience.
  • Research, evaluate, and contract third-party vendors as needed to support major events and track rentals.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with Levy Catering regarding menus, event setup, and execution.
  • Prepare and distribute internal communications and post-event summaries to HMS stakeholders, capturing feedback and documenting any issues.
  • Coordinate Guest Services support for major events, including outreach, scheduling, and onboarding of volunteer groups, employee check-in, and ensuring all credentialed staff and volunteers are prepared to deliver exceptional guest experiences.
  • Contribute as a collaborative team member, assisting colleagues as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Event Operations.

  • Minimum two years’ experience in motorsports, sales, scheduling, logistics, or a related field.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts, drive renewals, and identify upsell opportunities.
  • Experience in selling or leasing products/services, preferably in a motorsports or event environment.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
  • Ability to plan, execute, and follow up on events, track rentals, and related operations.
  • Proficient in Company-provided hardware and software, email, and Internet usage.  Must be able to use current Microsoft Operating Systems. Must have basic knowledge of Microsoft Office 365.
  • Ability to coordinate volunteer groups, manage employee check-in, and ensure credentialed staff and volunteers are prepared for events.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact professionally with industry members
  • Ability to perform and maintain composure in higher-pressure situations
  • Ability to multitask, set priorities, and meet deadlines
  • Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor

Supervisory Responsibilities

While this position does not currently have any direct reports, the position will provide oversight and guidance to at-track/venue staff and volunteers.

About this job

Certified fire rescue and EMS professionals needed for event-based shifts at Daytona International Speedway during racing weekends. Role involves fire and EMS response functions during major motorsports events with shifts ranging from 6 to 16 hours.

Good fit if you hold Florida Fire I & II and EMT Basic or Paramedic certifications, current BLS CPR, valid driver's license, and can work variable event-based hours.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

Daytona International Speedway is seeking certified Fire Rescue professionals that will interact with our guests and professional racing team participants during racing events. 

Essential Functions:

  • Perform Fire and EMS response functions. Shifts range from 6-16 hours depending on event.

  • Must successfully pass BLS or ACLS protocol test as required by Emergency Services Medical Director

  • Minimum age 18 years old.

  • Preferred candidates will have a verifiable affiliation with a Florida Public Safety or EMS Agency.     

  • Strong communication skills including written reports.

  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather conditions.

  • Positive attitude!

 
This is an event based position. Shifts and hours will vary based on our event needs.

INTERNATIONAL MOTOR SPORTS ASSOCIATION (IMSA)

IMSA was originally founded in 1969 and owns a long and rich history in sports car racing. Today, IMSA is the sanctioning body of the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, the premier sports car racing series in North America. IMSA also sanctions the IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge, IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge and Historic Sportscar Racing, as well as five one-make series: Ferrari Challenge North America, Lamborghini Super Trofeo North America, Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin, Mustang Challenge and Porsche Carrera Cup North America. IMSA – a company within the NASCAR family – is the exclusive strategic partner in North America with the Automobile Club de l’Ouest (ACO) which operates the 24 Hours of Le Mans as a part of the FIA World Endurance Championship. The partnership enables selected IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship competitors to earn automatic entries into the prestigious 24 Hours of Le Mans. For more information, please visit www.IMSA.com, https://x.com/IMSA, www.facebook.com/IMSA or www.instagram.com/imsa_racing.

Job Description

Job Title:                     Part-Time, Transport Driver

Department:                Logistics

FLSA Status:               Non-Exempt

Prepared Date:            November 30, 2021

Reviewed Date:            November 30, 2021

SUMMARY

This position requires a professional transport (truck) driver to drive an IMSA transporter (with trailer) to and from events and/or fly to and from events.  In addition to professional truck driving duties, this position is also responsible for set-up and teardown of equipment utilized throughout the event week/weekend as well as maintaining all equipment in a functional and professional appearing manner.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Drive transporter, often on an interstate basis, for all required events. Must be able to drive to events as prescribed while maintaining all Department of Transportation (DOT) requirements necessary to operate a transporter (i.e., Commercial Driver’s License, testing, drive time regulations, etc.).

Truck and trailer loading and unloading; setting up and breaking down of awnings, tech equipment and any equipment as needed.

Truck and trailer scheduling and minor maintenance.

Work to support all weekend officials by maintaining equipment and supplies; staff any IMSA trailers as needed.

Responsible for equipment maintenance and care including cleaning, restocking and upkeep.

Prepare truck logs, complete timecards, and fuel reports after all trips.

After performing set-up duties at the race event, will also be asked to perform other tasks to help augment other staffing needs around other departments.

Required to operate forklifts and supporting equipment.

Periodically work at the IMSA transportation hub on off-event days.

Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor.

Approximate travel required:  80% including weekends.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

One (1) year certificate from college or technical school and/or five (5) years truck driving and at-race track service experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Minimum of one (1) year forklift operation experience is a plus.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.  Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.  Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from small groups, customers, clients, managers, and other employees of the organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. 

COMPUTER SKILLS

Proficient on Company provided hardware and software. Must be able to work with Electronic Logging Devices (ELD) for DOT compliance in trucks.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to make decisions and think in a fast-paced work environment.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, AND REGISTRATIONS

Commercial Driver’s License (CDL), Class A required and IMSA License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk approximately 10 hours per day; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.  The employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

The employee is occasionally required to talk or hear, sit, climb, or balance, and taste or smell.  The employee must frequently lift and/or move more than 75 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

The Driver must be able to pass the DOT physical and DOT required drug screenings.

Job.JobTitle: Promo Team Event Staff - Daytona Intl Speedway
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Banquet Server / Event Staff, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Part-time, includes weekends
  • Location: Daytona Beach, FL
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Temporary seasonal promotional staff position representing NASCAR and Daytona International Speedway at community events and race weekends. Role includes fan engagement, managing promotional materials, driving the promo car to events, and supporting Event Experience activations.

Good fit if you live in Volusia County or nearby, have a clean driving record and valid license, and are available for events August 20-24 plus at least 2 grassroot events monthly.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

Position Summary 

NASCAR is seeking energetic and self-motivated individuals interested in obtaining practice and relative experience in the motor sports industry. This position will support the Daytona International Speedway Event Experience and Marketing departments through onsite event activations and grassroot initiatives. Promo Team members will credibly and responsibly represent oneself as the face of Daytona International Speedway to current and prospective fans by assisting in community events and race day responsibilities. This is a temporary seasonal position and hours will be dependent on the appearance schedule.

Responsibilities/ Duties/ Functions/ Tasks 

  • Represent NASCAR and the Daytona International Speedway at local and regional events 

  • Enthusiastically interact with and educate the public on Daytona International Speedway history, information, and ticket opportunities at community events 

  • Organize and manage department assets such as promo materials and giveaways, signage, equipment and various display/promo vehicles. 

  • Assist in the set up and tear down of the display at community events, including management of the Show Car and/or Promo Car 

  • Proactivity seek and engage with fans to generate leads for campaign marketing and to grow the brand  

  • Be an expert on the products and services offered by Daytona International Speedway 

  • Assist with a variety of Event Experience activations during the 2024 Daytona International Speedway season, such as the Daytona 500! 

  • Other duties as assigned 

Performance Measures 

  • Level of enthusiasm and professionalism displayed during interaction with customers 

  • Compliance with safety regulations/procedures 

  • Reliability and dependability 

Minimum Requirements 

  • Currently living in Volusia County or surrounding areas 

  • Clean driving record, DIS Promo Team Members will be tasked with driving the Promo Car to events so each employee must meet company vehicle driving standards 

  • Possession of a valid Driver’s License 

  • Post high school education required or equivalent experience 

  • Exceptional work ethic, eagerness to learn, and a passion for the sports/motorsports industry 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills 

  • Professional appearance and demeanor 

  • DIS Promo Team Members will receive event shirts but will be expected to wear other professional attire such as black or khaki pants and comfortable shoes 

  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as scheduled and meet the minimum scheduling requirements to remain an active member

  • Promo Team Members must be available for onsite events on dates August 20-24, and open to work at least 2 grassroot events per month 

Special Position Requirements 

  • May require some out-of-town travel with necessary travel expenses covered by the Company 

The Promo Car is the official company vehicle for Daytona International Speedway which appears throughout the state sixty to one-hundred times annually. The program setup typically includes the Promo Car, promotional giveaways, interactive games, and ability to prospect. DIS Promo Team members are expected to show up early to help with setup and stay after events for tear down. The position requires you to have a means of transportation to events; they are primarily in the Daytona Beach area but in some instances statewide. The ideal applicant will be sales driven, a people-person, on-time, hard-working, and eager to learn the sport of NASCAR.

About this job

Corner Workers monitor track conditions and driver safety at Homestead-Miami Speedway, using flags to communicate with drivers and assisting during accidents or mechanical issues. The role involves observing track surface and competitor behavior while stationed at various points around the racetrack.

Good fit if you have racing knowledge, are bilingual in English and Spanish, hold a valid driver's license, and can work flexible schedules including nights and weekends.

Full job description

HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Corner Workers are stationed at various points around the racetrack and are responsible for observing and monitoring track conditions and communicating with drivers by using flags to warn of track conditions and provide assistance in case of any collisions, accidents or track problems.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Provide consistent information to drivers using racing flags and signals.

  • Observe, monitor and assess track surface conditions.

  • Observe competitors for driving behavior and their cars mechanical condition.

  • May be called to assist during an accident

  • Communicate information to Race Control, stewards, Operations, and emergency medical responders.

Required skills/experience:

  • High school diploma/GED

  • Valid Driver’s License

  • Racing knowledge

  • Bilingual, native in English and Spanish.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent verbal and radio communication skills

  • Must be willing to work days, nights, weekend,  occasional holidays and special events

  • Must be comfortable working in an outside environment in all non-life threatening weather conditions (i.e.: heat, cold, light rain, etc.).

  • Must be able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

  • Must attend mandatory annual training and complete required online training initially and annually.
