Job.JobTitle: Event Guest Services Fan Crew - Daytona International Speedway
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Part-time, includes weekends, shift differential pay
  • Location: Daytona Beach, FL
  • Physical: Lifting up to 30 lbs

About this job

Part-time event positions at Daytona International Speedway's major racing events, including the Daytona 500. Multiple roles available in guest services, admissions, ADA assistance, and venue support, with shifts varying from 8-14 hours depending on event needs.

Good fit if you can stand for long periods, work outdoors in changing weather, work nights and weekends, and have strong communication skills.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

Daytona International Speedway is seeking part time event workers in the position of Guest Services Fan Crew.  As a member of the Fan Crew, you will be responsible for bringing our guests an unforgettable racing experience. Fan Crew will work select publicly ticketed events throughout the year.

Guest Services Fan Crew is a seasonal/temporary event based position. Shifts and hours will vary depending on specific event needs. 

FAN CREW JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Ability to stand for long periods of time

  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather

  • Excellent communication skills & positive attitude Must be able to work nights, weekends & holidays

  • Shift length: 8-14 hours depending on event needs

  • Assisting fans in a safe and friendly manner

Please review the list of positions below and note on your application your 1st, 2nd and 3rd preference of role. Not all positions may be hiring at the current time.

ADA CART DRIVER FAN CREW

DRIVERS – ADA Cart Drivers Fan Crew safely transport guests with disabilities, via golf carts, to and from designated locations. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

SHUTTLE STOP – Shuttle Stop Fan Crew are crucial to the safety and efficiency of the ADA Cart program to keep an organized flow of the fan queue line and the ADA Carts.

ADMISSIONS FAN CREW

GATES – Gate Fan Crew check each guest's ticket or credential for valid entry into the Venue or infield.

CAMPGROUNDS – Campground Fan Crew check each guest's ticket and vehicle pass for access into controlled campground areas.

TUNNELS - Tunnel Fan Crew check each guest's ticket and vehicle pass for valid access into the infield & campground areas.

OVERNIGHT - Overnight Fan Crew at the Tunnels & Campgrounds keep the 24 hour operation going. Pay differential offered for those who mainly work overnight shifts.

GUEST SERVICES BOOTH FAN CREW

GUEST SERVICES BOOTH – GSB Fan Crew are positioned at Guest Services Booths that are located around property and in the Venue. GSB Fan Crew must be able to think quickly, utilize their tools to provide our fans with accurate information in a timely manner, and ensure our fans have a positive race-day experience. GSB Fan Crew are also responsible for managing the lost and found program, resolving any ticket discrepancies or issues, and taking fan feedback with a positive attitude.

VENUE FAN CREW

VENUE – Venue Fan Crew are responsible for bringing our guests an unforgettable race day experience! Ushers will assist by directing guests to the location of their seats and other points of interest, enforcing Speedway policies and procedures, providing event information to guests, and making sure everything in their area is in working order. Venue Fan Crew may also work as escalator or elevator attendants to ensure the safety of our guests.

SUPPORT TEAM

SUPPORT – Support Team assists the entire Guest Services department with critical tasks before, during, and after events. Shifts are 12+ hours. Support Team assists with setup and teardown of items such as signage, tents, tables, chairs, and steel barricades; transports staff to and from specific work locations on property; and other duties as assigned. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check and be able to lift in excess of 30 pounds.

WARDROBE FAN CREW

WARDROBE – Wardrobe Fan Crew oversee the organization of wardrobe for all Guest Services sub-departments by issuing and receiving uniforms. Candidate must be comfortable using a computer and may be asked to wash laundry during events.

Major event dates for 2026 & 2027:

August 28 - 29, 2026

January 29 - 31, 2027

February 16-21, 2027

March 6, 2027

Additional days may be available.

Job.JobTitle: Street Team Event Staff - Homestead-Miami Speedway
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Banquet Server / Event Staff, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Join Our Street Team and Be Part of the Racing Action! 

If you have a passion for motorsports or are eager to explore the thrilling world of racing, we want to work with you! We aim to maintain year-round connections with our community, enhance awareness of Homestead-Miami Speedway, and share the thrill of NASCAR with loyal and new fans across South Florida. We are actively seeking enthusiastic and committed individuals to support us with awareness-building and community engagement efforts, with the goal of creating excitement for the upcoming NASCAR Cup Series Championship Weekend from November 6-8, 2026.. 

Since its inception in 1995, Homestead-Miami Speedway has consistently held its position as South Florida's premier motorsports destination. This is your chance to be a part of the most exhilarating racing experience in South Florida, join a dynamic and fast-paced team, and get your foot in the door in the motorsports industry! 

Responsibilities & Tasks: 

In this role, you will serve as the ambassador for Homestead-Miami Speedway at a variety of public appearances and promotional events throughout South Florida. Your mission will be to build community by connecting and engaging with both our loyal fans, newcomers, and potential customers, all with the ultimate objective of encouraging their attendance at our highly anticipated NASCAR Cup Series Championship Weekend in November. Our activations include the promo car, a NASCAR retired race car, promotional giveaways, interactive games, ability to data-collect and prospect. 

Additionally, you will: 

  • Support NASCAR marketing and event experience initiatives, including the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Weekend, NASCAR Racing Experience Media & Influencer Day, Fourth of July Celebration at the track, and Fast Lane Friday events, to name a few.
  • Engage with customers and prospects on-site at grassroots events to generate leads and close ticket sales to the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Weekend.
  • Collect valuable data from event attendees, actively gather prospects for future email campaigns, and encourage consumer sign-ups for our mailing list.   
  • Educate the community about Homestead-Miami Speedway, its history, and ticket opportunities.
  • Maintain expertise in the products and services offered by Homestead-Miami Speedway.
  • Always ensure we're well-stocked with promotional materials and giveaway items.
  • Actively participate in public appearances with our promo car and/or retired race car, with a primary responsibility for maintaining the impeccable condition of both vehicles.
  • Coordinate transportation of the retired race car with the towing team and supervise vehicle loading and unloading to ensure it is always handled with care as well as properly staged at events and activations.
  • Responsible for assisting in the set up and tear down of the displays. You will need to travel to the office the day prior to collect all grassroots activation. On the day of the event, you will transport these items to the event location using your own car, set up the activation, dismantle it after the event, and then return all grassroots items to Homestead-Miami Speedway post event.
  • Ideal candidates should be sales-oriented, personable, punctual, hardworking, and eager to learn about the world of NASCAR. Also, they exhibit reliability and dependability, and always adhere to safety regulations and procedures.
  • Some out-of-town travel may be required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • Minimum 18 years of age.
  • Bilingual, native in English and Spanish.
  • Demonstrate high levels of energy and enthusiasm and professionalism when interacting with customers. Always carry a happy disposition!
  • Candidates must possess strong attention to detail and consistently strive to enhance the presentation and final display and/or activation setup.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, capable of effectively engaging with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, detail-oriented, and strong team player.
  • Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and think strategically to solve problems.
  • Available to work flexible hours, including weekdays, weeknights, and evenings, adapting to event schedules.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Sales experience desired!
  • Current enrollment in a college or university program in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Sports Management, or a related field, with a strong interest in motorsports and event marketing.

Join our team and help us showcase Homestead-Miami Speedway as the ultimate destination for motorsports enthusiasts in South Florida!

The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway is hiring for Ticket Office Event Staff. This position will provide customer service, product upsell, and order processing via telephone, mail, and walk-ups. This is a part-time seasonal position.

Duties & Responsibilities:
•    Selling parking passes to all walk-up customers.
•    Process cash and credit card payments.
•    Serve as a staff member working in a ticket booth.
•    Develop a working knowledge of track pricing, policies, procedures, and general event information. As the first line for guest questions, Event Ticketing Staff must be able to answer questions or direct guests in the proper direction.
•    Direct vehicle traffic flow to proper areas.
•    Assist guests with questions regarding directions, information about the facility, and parking assistance.
•    Handle will-call requests at the ticket office. 

•    Other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience:
•    High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
•    1-2 years’ event staffing or ticket sales experience preferred.

Other Qualifications:
•    Minimum 18 years of age.
•    Ability to work outdoors in changing weather conditions for extended periods.
•    Attention to detail and ability to provide a high level of customer service is required.
•    Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.
•    Flexible schedule during the event.
•    Previous cash handling experience preferred.
•    Reliable transportation to and from the track location.
•    Pass background screening.

Accounting Associate – Position Summary

The Accounting Associate plays a key role in supporting the Business Office at Legacy Pointe at UCF by performing daily accounting and billing functions that ensure accurate financial operations. This position focuses on Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and resident billing, working closely with the Business Office Director and Senior Business Office Coordinator to maintain accurate records, resolve discrepancies, support month-end close processes, and uphold internal controls and regulatory expectations. The role requires strong attention to detail, confidentiality, and the ability to provide high-quality customer service to residents, families, vendors, and internal departments.

In addition to processing invoices, payments, deposits, and resident charges, the Accounting Associate assists with reconciliations, reporting, audits, and billing accuracy across multiple departments. The position involves frequent interaction with residents and families, requiring professionalism, patience, and clear communication when addressing billing questions or concerns.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. Associate’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or current enrollment in an accredited Accounting or Finance degree program
  2. Entry-level candidates welcome; 0–2 years of experience in accounting, accounts payable/receivable, bookkeeping, or billing preferred
  3. Experience in senior living, healthcare, hospitality, or multi-department organizations is a plus
  4. Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate financial records and follow established procedures
  5. Working knowledge of basic accounting principles and mathematical calculations, including percentages and reconciliations
  6. Proficiency in Microsoft Windows, Excel (including formulas), and Word; ability to learn accounting and billing systems
  7. Ability to handle confidential resident and financial information in accordance with policy and HIPAA principles
  8. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with residents, families, vendors, and staff
  9. Ability to write clear and professional emails, memos, and billing-related communications
  10. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  11. Ability to work independently, take initiative, use good judgment, and function effectively as part of a team
  12. Willingness to provide resident-facing customer service while maintaining professionalism

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we provide a full continuum of care, including Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing. Our community is built around hospitality, service, and accountability, with a commitment to ensuring that residents feel valued, respected, and supported.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is seeking compassionate and dependable Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for full-time day-shift opportunities across our Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care departments. The CNA provides direct, person-centered care to residents by assisting with activities of daily living, promoting independence, and supporting resident safety, dignity, and well-being. Working under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team, the CNA helps residents begin their day comfortably while maintaining a positive and supportive care environment. Department placement will be based on current staffing needs, qualifications, experience, and candidate preferences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Assist residents with morning routines, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and personal hygiene.
  2. Support residents with activities of daily living (ADLs) while encouraging independence whenever possible.
  3. Respond promptly to call lights, bells, intercoms, and resident requests.
  4. Assist with transfers, ambulation, mobility devices, and repositioning.
  5. Support breakfast and lunch services, including meal setup and feeding assistance when needed.
  6. Take and accurately record vital signs, weights, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  7. Monitor residents for changes in physical, emotional, or cognitive conditions and promptly report concerns to nursing staff.
  8. Provide individualized support to residents with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments.
  9. Accurately document resident care and observations in electronic medical records.
  10. Change bed linens and maintain clean, safe, and organized resident rooms.
  11. Prepare, clean, and properly store care equipment, treatment trays, and supplies.
  12. Assist with resident routines, daily activities, and other assigned care needs.
  13. Communicate respectfully with residents, families, visitors, and coworkers.
  14. Protect resident rights, privacy, safety, and dignity.
  15. Work collaboratively with nursing staff and other departments to maintain quality care.
  16. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Ability to communicate effectively with residents, families, and healthcare professionals.
  6. Ability to read, understand, and follow care plans, safety procedures, and nursing instructions.
  7. Experience using electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  8. Basic computer, documentation, and mathematical skills.
  9. Patience and compassion when supporting individuals with cognitive and physical limitations.
  10. Strong teamwork, organization, and problem-solving abilities.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with transfers, mobility, and positioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled environment.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan
  5. Paid time off that grows with tenure
  6. Eight paid holidays annually
  7. Scholarship programs for employees and dependents
  8. Employee recognition and milestone awards
  9. Employee discounts on attractions, travel, and entertainment
  10. Annual employee appreciation events

Working at Legacy Pointe means being part of a team that values compassion, professionalism, and the meaningful relationships built with residents every day.

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we provide Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing services. Our community is committed to providing residents with a welcoming, safe, and supportive environment where dignity and quality of life are always priorities. Our healthcare team plays an essential role in providing consistent, compassionate care throughout the day and night.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is seeking compassionate and dependable Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for full-time overnight opportunities across Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care. The overnight CNA provides direct resident care, assists with activities of daily living, responds to resident needs, and helps maintain a safe and comfortable environment throughout the night. This role is especially important in supporting residents who require assistance with nighttime routines, mobility, personal care, and reassurance. CNAs work under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team while following established care plans and safety procedures. Candidates may be considered for different departments based on qualifications, experience, preferences, and available positions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide compassionate, person-centered care to residents throughout the overnight shift.
  2. Respond promptly to call lights, bells, intercoms, and resident requests.
  3. Assist residents with toileting, personal hygiene, dressing, and other activities of daily living.
  4. Provide support with nighttime mobility, transfers, ambulation, and repositioning.
  5. Turn and reposition residents as directed to promote comfort and prevent pressure injuries.
  6. Assist residents who awaken during the night and provide reassurance, comfort, and appropriate assistance.
  7. Support residents living with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments using patience and individualized care approaches.
  8. Observe and promptly report changes in residents' physical condition, behavior, or emotional well-being to licensed nursing staff.
  9. Take and record vital signs, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  10. Document care accurately and in a timely manner using electronic medical records.
  11. Follow established care plans, nursing instructions, infection prevention practices, and safety procedures.
  12. Assist residents with early morning personal care and preparations for the day as assigned.
  13. Change bed linens and maintain clean, comfortable, and organized resident rooms.
  14. Prepare, clean, and properly store care equipment, supplies, and treatment trays.
  15. Maintain resident confidentiality, privacy, safety, and dignity.
  16. Communicate important resident information and observations to nursing staff.
  17. Work collaboratively with coworkers to maintain consistent, high-quality resident care.
  18. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Previous overnight experience in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care preferred.
  6. Ability to provide compassionate care to residents with varying physical and cognitive needs.
  7. Strong observation, communication, and documentation skills.
  8. Ability to recognize and report changes in resident condition promptly.
  9. Ability to follow individualized care plans, nursing instructions, and safety guidelines.
  10. Familiarity with electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  11. Basic computer and mathematical skills.
  12. Ability to work independently while remaining an active member of the nursing team.
  13. Dependability, good judgment, and commitment to resident safety.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist with resident transfers, positioning, and mobility.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is grounded in a simple and meaningful purpose: to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. Legacy Pointe is a modern, welcoming community where people feel seen, valued, and cared for. Whether someone is participating in a wellness program, engaging in a cognitive activity, receiving compassionate support, or enjoying a meaningful moment of connection, our priority is always their comfort, dignity, and quality of life.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Joining Legacy Pointe means becoming part of a team that appreciates your work and supports your well-being. We want you to feel equipped, encouraged, and valued in your role.

Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

Work That Makes a Difference

Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings moments where your presence, patience, and compassion can change someone’s experience for the better. You help residents feel comforted, safe, understood, and supported, especially those living with cognitive impairment, who depend on consistency and connection. You build trust, create calm, and offer reassurance through even the simplest interactions. At the end of the day, you know your work mattered. Every role at Legacy Pointe contributes to these moments of impact, and we value the people who show up with empathy, skill, and dedication. There is purpose here. There is growth here. Cook – Position Summary

The Cook is responsible for preparing high-quality, nutritious meals for residents in accordance with established menus, standardized recipes, and individual dietary requirements. This role plays a critical part in resident satisfaction by ensuring meals are prepared safely, served on time, and meet all texture modifications, allergy restrictions, and physician-ordered diets. The Cook adheres to proper food handling, sanitation, and temperature-control standards while maintaining an organized, clean, and efficient kitchen environment. Working collaboratively with the Dietary team, the Cook supports daily meal service, special events, and catering functions while consistently demonstrating professionalism and hospitality aligned with the community’s service excellence philosophy and core values.In addition to food preparation, the Cook is responsible for maintaining compliance with federal, state, and local food safety regulations, including infection control and allergen-handling practices. This position requires effective communication with dietary staff, nursing, and leadership to address resident preferences, intake concerns, equipment needs, and operational issues. The Cook contributes to quality assurance efforts through taste testing, audits, and participation in training and orientation for new team members when assigned. The role involves working in a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment and requires reliability, attention to detail, adaptability, and a genuine interest in serving older adults.

Requirements and Qualifications

  1. High school diploma or GED preferred, with at least one year of cooking experience in healthcare, hospitality, restaurant, or senior living environments preferred
  2. Ability to prepare meals using standardized recipes while following dietary restrictions, texture modifications, allergy protocols, and food safety standards
  3. Knowledge of safe food handling, sanitation practices, temperature controls, and infection prevention procedures
  4. Ability to obtain and maintain required Food Handler certification within established timeframes
  5. Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced kitchen environment
  6. Effective communication skills and the ability to work respectfully and collaboratively with dietary staff, nursing, leadership, residents, and families
  7. Demonstrated professionalism, reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic
  8. Basic math and computer skills to support food preparation, documentation, and electronic dietary systems as applicable
  9. Ability to stand for extended periods, use hands for food preparation, and safely lift or carry items up to 50 pounds
  10. Availability to work weekends, holidays, evenings, and varying shifts as required

Reporting to the Housekeeping Manager, this role performs routine, scheduled, and as-needed cleaning of resident apartments, common areas, dining spaces, offices, and healthcare units in accordance with established cleaning schedules, infection control standards, and safety protocols.

The Housekeeper plays an essential role in infection prevention and overall community presentation by sanitizing high-touch surfaces, properly handling waste, and using approved cleaning products and equipment. This position requires attention to detail, respect for resident privacy, and the ability to respond promptly and courteously to housekeeping requests and urgent needs such as spills, accidents, or outbreak-related cleaning.

The role requires the ability to work independently and as part of a team, follow written and verbal instructions, and adapt to changing priorities. The Housekeeper must demonstrate professionalism, a service-oriented attitude, and a genuine interest in supporting a senior population while working flexible schedules, including weekends or holidays as needed.

  2. Prior housekeeping, janitorial, environmental services, or custodial experience preferred
  3. Experience in senior living, skilled nursing, assisted living, memory care, healthcare, hospitality, or commercial environments strongly preferred
  4. Familiarity with cleaning chemicals, floor care equipment, and infection control practices preferred
  5. Prior experience working with older adults or individuals with disabilities is a plus
  6. Knowledge and Skills

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we offer a full continuum of care, including Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing. Our community is built around hospitality, service, and accountability, with a commitment to helping residents feel valued, supported, and cared for. We are seeking compassionate, dependable Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) who are passionate about providing high-quality care and making a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults.

Position Summary

The Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) provides direct nursing care to residents under the direction of nursing leadership and in accordance with applicable nursing regulations and established care plans. Responsibilities include administering medications and treatments, monitoring changes in resident condition, maintaining accurate clinical documentation, and collaborating with healthcare team members to ensure resident safety and quality care. LPNs may work in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care depending on qualifications, candidate preferences, and staffing needs. This role requires professionalism, strong clinical skills, effective communication, and a commitment to compassionate, resident-centered care.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide direct nursing care in accordance with physician orders, established care plans, and nursing standards.
  2. Administer medications and treatments safely and accurately within the LPN scope of practice.
  3. Monitor residents for changes in physical, emotional, behavioral, and cognitive conditions.
  4. Report significant changes in resident condition to the appropriate nursing staff or healthcare provider.
  5. Take and document vital signs, blood glucose readings, and other clinical observations.
  6. Perform wound care, dressing changes, and other nursing procedures as authorized and assigned.
  7. Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation using electronic medical records.
  8. Assist with developing, implementing, and updating individualized resident care plans within assigned responsibilities.
  9. Communicate effectively with physicians, residents, families, nursing supervisors, and interdisciplinary team members.
  10. Provide direction and support to Certified Nursing Assistants and other care team members consistent with applicable regulations and departmental procedures.
  11. Respond promptly to resident needs, changes in condition, and emergency situations.
  12. Assist with resident admissions, transfers, and discharges as assigned.
  13. Follow infection prevention, medication safety, and resident safety procedures.
  14. Provide appropriate care and reassurance to residents with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, and other cognitive impairments.
  15. Maintain residents' rights, privacy, dignity, confidentiality, and emotional well-being.
  16. Encourage resident independence while providing appropriate nursing support.
  17. Maintain clean, organized, and properly supplied treatment and nursing areas.
  18. Complete required documentation, training, and other assigned responsibilities.
  19. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. Graduate of an accredited practical nursing program.
  2. Current, active Florida Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license required.
  3. Current CPR/BLS certification required.
  4. Previous experience in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, Memory Care, long-term care, or a related healthcare setting preferred.
  5. Knowledge of nursing procedures, medication administration, infection prevention, and resident safety.
  6. Ability to recognize changes in resident condition and respond appropriately.
  7. Strong clinical observation, critical thinking, communication, and organizational skills.
  8. Ability to accurately document care using electronic medical records; PointClickCare experience preferred.
  9. Ability to follow physician orders, established care plans, and nursing procedures.
  10. Strong teamwork and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a healthcare environment.
  11. Patience, professionalism, dependability, and compassion when providing care to older adults.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, and provide hands-on resident care throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with mobility, transfers, and positioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

At Legacy Pointe, we value the dedication and compassion of our healthcare employees. We strive to provide a welcoming workplace where employees feel supported, appreciated, and empowered to make a difference. Eligible full-time employees receive access to benefits that include:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan
  5. Paid time off that grows with tenure
  6. Eight paid holidays annually
  7. Scholarship programs for employees and dependents
  8. Employee recognition and milestone awards
  9. Employee discounts on attractions, travel, and entertainment
  10. Annual employee appreciation events

Benefits and program eligibility depend on employment classification and applicable plan requirements.

Work That Makes a Difference

Nursing at Legacy Pointe is about providing more than clinical care. It is about building trust, supporting independence, and making residents feel comfortable, safe, and respected. Whether you're caring for residents in Skilled Nursing, supporting daily health needs in Assisted Living, or providing compassionate care in Memory Care, your work contributes directly to the quality of life of those we serve. We welcome dedicated nurses who want to be part of a resident-focused community.

Work That Makes a Difference

Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings opportunities to make a positive difference in the lives of our residents through friendly service, patience, and compassion.

As a Server, you play an important role in creating a welcoming dining experience. Whether you are greeting residents with a smile, taking meal orders, serving food and beverages, or maintaining a clean and inviting dining room, your work helps residents feel valued and at home. There is purpose here. There is growth here. And there is a place for you at Legacy Pointe.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is continuously seeking friendly, dependable, and hospitality-focused individuals interested in joining our Dining Services team as Part-Time Servers.

This is an ongoing recruitment opportunity. Applications will be considered for current and future part-time openings as staffing needs arise.

The Server plays a key role in creating a positive dining experience for residents by providing friendly, efficient, and professional table service in accordance with Legacy Pointe's hospitality standards.

This position ensures meals are served accurately, safely, and in a timely manner while maintaining a clean, organized, and welcoming dining environment.

The ideal candidate demonstrates patience, professionalism, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in working with older adults.

Schedule and Availability

We are accepting applications from individuals interested in the following part-time shifts:

  1. Lunch Shift: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  2. Dinner Shift: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM
  3. Weekend and holiday availability is required.
  4. Specific schedules and available shifts will depend on departmental staffing needs.
  5. Candidates interested in either or both shifts are encouraged to apply.

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Greet residents and guests warmly, professionally, and respectfully.
  2. Take accurate meal orders while remaining attentive to dietary restrictions, allergies, food textures, and resident-specific needs.
  3. Serve meals and beverages in a courteous, timely, and professional manner.
  4. Assist residents with dining-related needs while maintaining their dignity, comfort, and safety.
  5. Set up, clear, clean, and reset dining areas before, during, and after meal service.
  6. Maintain clean and organized dining rooms, service stations, and equipment.
  7. Follow food handling, sanitation, infection control, and safety procedures.
  8. Communicate effectively with Dietary staff, Nursing, Concierge, and other departments to support resident needs.
  9. Report resident concerns, meal refusals, dietary changes, and service-related issues to the appropriate supervisor.
  10. Demonstrate patience, empathy, and attentiveness when interacting with older adults, including residents with cognitive impairments.
  11. Assist with dishwashing, food running, bussing, stocking, and other Dining Services responsibilities as needed.
  12. Assist with special events, catered functions, and community dining activities.
  13. Safely operate dietary equipment, including beverage machines, warmers, and service carts.
  14. Demonstrate behaviors that align with Legacy Pointe's core values of Hospitality, Service, and Accountability.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or GED preferred.
  2. Previous experience in food service, hospitality, restaurant service, or senior living dining preferred, but not required.
  3. Experience working with older adults or in healthcare dining is a plus.
  4. Ability to obtain Food Handler certification within the required timeframe, if applicable.
  5. Availability to work part-time lunch and/or dinner shifts.
  6. Weekend and holiday availability required.
  7. Friendly, welcoming, and professional attitude.
  8. Strong communication and customer service skills.
  9. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced dining environment.
  10. Ability to follow instructions, safety procedures, and established dining service standards.
  11. Reliable attendance, punctuality, and a strong work ethic.
  12. Ability to work cooperatively with team members and assist where needed.
  13. Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and lift, carry, push, or pull items as required.
  14. Commitment to maintaining resident dignity, safety, confidentiality, and service excellence.

Join Our Team

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, every team member contributes to creating a welcoming community where residents feel respected, supported, and valued.

Whether you are an experienced Server, a student looking for part-time opportunities, or someone interested in beginning a career in hospitality, we encourage you to apply.

Please Note: This is an ongoing recruitment posting intended to establish a pool of qualified candidates for current and anticipated vacancies. Submission of an application does not guarantee an immediate opening or interview. Qualified applicants may be contacted as opportunities become available.

RN House Supervisor – Position Summary

The RN House Supervisor oversees nursing staff and daily clinical operations within the Skilled Nursing Facility to ensure safe, high-quality resident care. Reporting to Nurse Leadership, this role coordinates admissions, discharges, and care plans; conducts daily rounds; and ensures accurate documentation and compliance with facility policies, infection control standards, and regulatory requirements. The RN House Supervisor provides leadership support to RNs, LPNs, and CNAs, promotes teamwork and professionalism, and serves as a clinical resource for staff, residents, and families. 

This position is responsible for addressing staffing needs, responding to clinical or operational issues during assigned shifts, and assisting with staff supervision and performance oversight. In the absence of senior nursing leadership, the RN House Supervisor may handle urgent disciplinary matters and ensure continuity of care. The role requires an active Florida RN license, prior nursing leadership experience, strong clinical judgment, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working varied shifts, including weekends or holidays as needed.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Florida (required)
  • Associate’s Degree in Nursing from an accredited college or university (required)
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred
  • Minimum of two (2) years of nursing leadership experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility, Long-Term Care, or Acute Care setting
  • At least two (2) years of supervisory or managerial experience in a healthcare environment
  • Strong knowledge of infection control standards, CMS guidelines, and survey readiness
  • Experience with staff education, training, and competency assessments
  • Certification in Infection Prevention & Control (CIC) preferred or willingness to obtain
  • Strong clinical judgment and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to supervise and support RNs, LPNs, and CNAs
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems; PointClickCare (PCC) knowledge preferred
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, evenings, or varied shifts as needed
  • Physical ability to perform job-related duties in a clinical environment

RN - Position Summary

The Registered Nurse (RN) provides direct nursing care to residents in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) under the supervision of the Director of Nursing (DON), Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON), and Nurse Supervisors. This role is responsible for ensuring high-quality resident care, accurate documentation, and compliance with facility policies and state regulations. RNs also supervise Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), ensuring effective teamwork and continuity of care. Duties and responsibilities will be completed while demonstrating behaviors that align with our Community’s Service Excellence philosophy and core values.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  • Provide direct nursing care to residents, including medication administration, wound care, and treatments as prescribed.
  • Monitor residents' conditions and report significant changes to the DON, ADON, or  Nurse Supervisors.
  • Supervise CNAs, ensuring proper documentation, adherence to care plans, and assistance with resident needs.
  • Conduct and receive shift reports at the beginning and end of each shift to ensure continuity of care and effective communication.
  • Assist in resident admissions, discharges, and transfers, ensuring accurate documentation and coordination with healthcare providers.
  • Establishes and maintains a close liaison with residents and families.
  • Educate residents and families on care plans, medications, and health conditions as needed.
  • Maintain compliance with all state and federal Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) regulations.
  • Follow infection control protocols, including proper use of PPE and sanitation procedures.
  • Respond promptly to resident needs, ensuring a compassionate, resident-centered approach to care.
  • Collaborate with physicians, therapists, and social workers to coordinate resident care.
  • Assist with emergency response procedures and provide first aid or CPR as necessary.
  • Document resident care accurately using electronic medical records (EMR) on facility-approved computers, tablets, or iPads.
  • Assists with ongoing care management meetings.
  • Support quality assurance initiatives and participate in performance improvement programs.
  • Work as part of a team, assisting fellow nurses and CNAs when needed to maintain smooth operations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the nursing leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Oversee CNAs to ensure proper resident care and documentation.
  • Assist with training and mentoring new CNAs.
  • Address performance concerns and escalate issues to the DON as necessary.
  • Ensure CNAs follow resident care plans and facility protocols.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Educational Requirements and Experience:

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Florida (Required).
  • CPR/AED certification required.
  • Experience in long-term care or skilled nursing preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) regulations and compliance standards preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Language Ability:

  • Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, speaking the primary language of the residents.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

Mathematical Skills:

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent, and to draw and interpret graphs.

Interpersonal Skills:

  • Ability to work in a polite, respectful, caring, calm, and compassionate way

Ability to Handle Confidential Information:

  • Must be a trustworthy individual who can keep items confidential as appropriate

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in using computers, tablets, or iPads for recording vital signs, charting, and reviewing resident care plans.
  • Basic typing skills to ensure efficient and accurate data entry.
  • Ability to use the Internet.

Problem-Solving & Adaptability:

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.  
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Competencies:

  • Must demonstrate an interest in working with a senior cognitive impaired population.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well.
  • Interacts with guests, residents and staff in a courteous and friendly manner.
  • Responds promptly to resident and visitor needs and assistance.
  • Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Balances team and individual responsibilities. Manages people effectively by taking responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Improves processes, products and services.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well.

About this job

Part-time security guard position at Orlando Health Training Facility in Kissimmee, protecting the facility, property, guests, staff, and players. Responsibilities include patrols, surveillance monitoring, access control, emergency response, and incident reporting.

Good fit if you have a Florida Class D Security License, valid driver's license, and at least six months of security experience.

Full job description

TITLE: Security Guard, Training Facility
DEPARTMENT:  Training Facilities
REPORTS TO: Security Manager
FLSA: Part Time, Hourly; Non-Exempt

What Sets You Apart

We are looking for an honest, attentive, and perceptive individual to join our Security team. You will be responsible for securing the Orlando Health Training Facility at Osceola Heritage Park and protecting the Club’s property, guests, staff, and players. You ensure safety while promoting and enforcing security and act as a visible deterrent against irregular activity.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Patrol the Orlando Health Training Facility at Osceola Heritage Park property to monitor and prevent intrusion, damage, hazards and breaches of security.
  • Lock and unlock doors and walk facilities.
  • Provide a visible presence that enforces safety and security
  • Monitor activity throughout the facilities via closed circuit television.
  • Respond appropriately to emergencies that arise including, but not limited to, fire alarm and burglar alarm.
  • Monitor access to the facility.
  • Assist with Event Day security coverage.
  • Detect and confront unauthorized persons and violators of security procedures.
  • Contact relevant authorities to deal with unlawful or irregular activities.
  • Use radio or other communication devices in a clear and concise manner
  • Write reports, report any malfunctions, misconduct or operational and safety issues.
  • Interview victims and witnesses and write incident reports as necessary.
  • Maintain a professional appearance and attitude.
  • Implement the prescribed emergency plan in case of emergency
  • Assist with the development and implementation of public safety plans for day-to-day operations and special events.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC.  It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • Must possess a High School diploma or G.E.D. or equivalent.
  • Some college studies in Criminal Justice, Private Investigations, Homeland Security, Emergency Management, Emergency Medical Services and/or any other Security related field or military experience is preferred.
  • Six (6) months to one (1) year security experience preferably in a similar environment
  • Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese is preferred.
  • Excellent aptitude to establish rapport with others and ability to build strong interpersonal relationships.
  • Basic computer skills including Microsoft Office suite.
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check and employment verification.
  • Must have a valid FL driver license and Class D Security License.
  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification.
  • Appropriate credentials as mandated by State, County or local law.
  • Ability to work independently with little or no supervision.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to walk, run, kneel and climb stair and react fast to unpredictable situations.
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting, and monitoring surveillance equipment.

About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride:

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons.

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.

TITLE: Merchandise Manager
DEPARTMENT: Merchandise
REPORTS TO: Sr. Director of Merchandise and Licensing
FLSA: Full-Time; Exempt

What Sets You Apart

Orlando City SC is seeking a Merchandise Manager responsible for overseeing the day-to-day of merchandise sales and operations for Orlando City SC, Orlando Pride, and Inter.Co Stadium. Assist Sr. Director of Merchandise & Licensing with the Club’s retail strategy, partner relations, drive strategic business strategies, and meet departmental goals.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support Orlando City, Orlando Pride, and Inter.co Stadium merchandise operations
  • Assist in the execution of merchandise business plan, monitoring overall retail performance and identifying growth opportunities.
  • Meet or exceed monthly/yearly sales goals.
  • Work cross-functionally with all departments to ensure merchandising needs are met.
  • Support Sr. Director of Merchandise & Licensing with department budget adherence, payroll submission, purchase orders and vendor payments.
  • Assist with promotional events and merchandise operations.
  • Fulfill all external, internal, and player merchandise requests as received and in a timely manner.
  • Recruit and manage merchandise associate to ensure operational standards are met.
  • Maintain all operations of ShopOrlandoPride.com including order fulfillment.
  • Maintain high level of customer service to both fans and external clients.
  • Work with new vendors and licensees of the club and MLS and NWSL.

  • Able to work flexible hours including nights, weekends and holidays.

  • The ability to attain and maintain Safesport certification.
  • Excellent computer skills – master of the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Photoshop proficiency preferred.

TITLE: Turf & Grounds Manager
DEPARTMENT: Training Facilities
REPORTS TO: Director of Turf & Grounds
FLSA: Full-Time, Salary; Exempt

What Sets You Apart

We are seeking a detail-oriented Turf & Grounds Manager with a passion for maintaining pristine pitches that leave lasting impressions at our Orlando Health Training Grounds at Osceola Heritage Park.  This role will play an integral part in maintaining multiple pitches for multiple teams.  The ideal teammate is detail oriented, excellent communicator, with a passion to lead a high performing team.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Oversee maintenance of 4 natural grass fields, including but not limited to mowing, edging, fertilizing, aerating, top-dressing, over-seeding, re-sodding and line striping.
  • Create the annual facility operating budget with the Director of Turf & Grounds and manage day-to-day operations to ensure cost effectiveness
  • Responsible for the implementation of an effective fertility, fungicide, and pest control program for Osceola Heritage Park
  • Lead research and procurement of equipment and supplies as needed
  • Work with the Sr. Event Manager to ensure all field conditions are met for third-party events and venue field rentals
  • Build effective and productive relationships within the organization, along with other employees, visitors, and staff
  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS, MLS Next Pro, and MLS Next coaches and soccer operations staff
  • Responsible for maintaining surrounds of the facility including but limited to mowing, raking, mulching, weeding, edging, trimming, pruning, installing plants and other tasks as needed
  • Assist with events at Inter.Co stadium as needed
  • Other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Manage full-time staff
  • Manage interviewing, hiring, and training of employees, appraising performance, rewarding and disciplining employees in conjunction with People & Culture

Qualifications

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Turf Grass Science, Horticulture, or related field preferred.
  • 5-7 years of grounds maintenance-related work experience in soccer, with a minimum of 3 years of leadership experience preferred.
  • Candidate should possess or have the ability to obtain the Florida Commercial Pesticide Applicator License.
  • Ability to operate turf related equipment (i.e., tractors, mowers, aerifiers, field paint machine).
  • Candidate must have strong leadership, interpersonal and supervisory skills.
  • Possess excellent written/verbal communication skills, be detail-oriented and highly organized with the ability to simultaneously handle multiple tasks and adapt to change.
  • Ability to resolve concerns expeditiously and independently.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Fluency in Spanish is desirable but not required.
  • Experience with hosting field events, including sporting and concerts, using various field protection systems is a plus.
  • Ability to perform physical labor for extended periods of time and in various weather conditions.
  • May work in an outdoor setting as required.
  • Able to obtain and maintain a Safesport Certification
  • Able to pass a Background check
  • Ability to walk and stand for short periods.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

TITLE: Manager, Brand Alliances Marketing
DEPARTMENT: Brand Alliances
REPORTS TO: Senior Manager, Brand Alliance Marketing
FLSA: Full-Time; Salaried

What Sets You Apart

As Brand Alliance Marketing Manager, you will oversee partner accounts across all clubs, manage asset activation, develop strategic programs aligned with partner business objectives, identify upsell opportunities, and lead renewals. You will build strong relationships while continually enhancing the service and support provided by the Brand Alliances department.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional service and build strong relationships with partner contacts at all organizational levels.
  • Manage the delivery of all assets for assigned partner accounts, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Develop a deep understanding of each partner’s business and identify mutually beneficial opportunities to collaborate.
  • Advance organizational marketing objectives through partner activations, including ticket offers, partner inventory, retail programs, in-stadium promotions, special events, and community outreach.
  • Identify upsell opportunities and present strategic ideas that align with partner business objectives.
  • Lead the renewal process to strengthen and grow partner relationships, collaborating with the Senior Director and SVP of Brand Alliances on strategies that engage stakeholders across the organization.
  • Partner with Legal and Brand Alliances senior leadership to execute new agreements during the renewal process.
  • Manage budgets for assigned partner accounts to achieve financial and partner objectives, including timely invoice submission, quarterly expense updates, and preliminary budgets for future years.

Lead annual planning sessions for assigned Brand Alliance partner accounts, engaging the broader Orlando City and Orlando Pride team to develop strategies aligned with partner business objectives. Produce annual recaps and collaborate with Business Intelligence to generate insights and recommendations.

  • Collaborate across Creative, Ticketing, Marketing, Social/Digital, IT, Community, and HR to coordinate and support partner programs.
  • Maintain accurate benchmarks, records, and inventory in Brand Alliances OneDrive, KORE CRM and ACTIVATE.
  • Document and track partnership performance promptly and accurately for recaps, including photos, screenshots, Trajektory and Blinkfire data, KORE reports, and other relevant third-party data.
  • Provide ongoing recommendations on asset and inventory management and availability.
  • Support the Brand Alliance Business Development team in creating innovative, sellable assets for prospects and existing partners.
  • Submit partnership creative briefs and proofread collateral featuring corporate partner and Club logos to ensure accurate brand usage across print, digital, social, sponsor artwork, and other materials.
  • Coordinate media and creative traffic logistics with partners and media partners, including reviewing rundowns and inventory.
  • Lead cross-functional meetings and provide regular updates to leadership.
  • Coordinate approved ticket requests and distribution for corporate partners.
  • Negotiate competitive pricing and coordinate orders for giveaways, merchandise, and client gifts.
  • Support the planning and execution of departmental special events.
  • Work home games and support on-site partner activations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • At Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride, soccer and entertainment are more than a job—they are a way of life. Every role is as unique as the person who fills it. Successful candidates will also have the following qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in sport management, business, marketing, or a related field.
  • At least three years of partnership marketing and activation experience, with demonstrated success in media, sports sponsorship, or entertainment. Sales experience is a plus.
  • Strategic thinker and effective communicator who thrives on meeting and exceeding partner objectives.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts and balancing competing priorities.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with experience creating and delivering recap and sales presentations.
  • Experience in the Florida market preferred but not required.
  • Supervisory experience preferred but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced event environment.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours and in varied settings as part of a collaborative team.
  • Ability to successfully pass a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SafeSport certification.

TITLE: Coordinator, Communications
DEPARTMENT: Communications
REPORTS TO:  Sr. Manager, Communications & PR
FLSA:  Full-time, Exempt

What Sets You Apart

Orlando City SC, Orlando Pride and Orlando City B are seeking an energetic, detail-oriented and self-motivated individual to support the Club’s communications efforts across all three teams, as well as the Orlando City Academy.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Communications & PR, the Coordinator, Communications plays an integral role in media relations, matchday operations, content collaboration and written communications across the Club. This position will support communications efforts for Orlando City and Orlando Pride while serving as a primary day-to-day communications contact for Orlando City B and the Orlando City Academy.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Lead media operations logistics across Orlando City, Orlando Pride and Orlando City B, including credentialing, parking and general media support.
  • Oversee home matchday media operations, supporting matchday media staff in the production of match recaps, quote sheets and post-match materials.
  • Collaborate with internal departments, players and technical staff to plan and execute media opportunities, interviews and content initiatives.
  • Contribute to weekly storylines and media pitching, working closely with external media and the Club’s broadcast, digital and content teams.
  • Assist in the production of written materials for Orlando City and Orlando Pride, including press releases, media advisories, game notes and player bios.
  • Support Communications colleagues in coordinating training coverage, media requests and interviews, as needed.
  • Serve as a primary day-to-day communications contact for Orlando City B and the Orlando City Academy, including leading the development of media materials such as press releases, match recaps and other written communications.
  • Represent the Communications Department at Club and venue events, as needed, providing on-site media support.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local, national and international media, ensuring consistent communication and collaboration.
  • Serve as Club press officer for Orlando City and Orlando Pride road matches, as needed.
  • Support media operations for third-party events hosted at Club facilities, as needed.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC and Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:
  • 1–2 years of experience in sports communications, public relations, media relations or a related field.

About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride:

In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut.

The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons.

In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win.

The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year.

In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando.

In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League.

For more information on Orlando City SC and Orlando, visit OrlandoCitySC.com or Orlando-Pride.com.

TITLE: Creative Project Manager

TITLE: Part-Time Stadium Security Guard
DEPARTMENT: Stadium Operations
REPORTS TO: Security Manager
FLSA: Part Time; Non-Exempt

What Sets You Apart

We are looking for an honest, attentive, and perceptive individual to join our Security team. In this role, you will help secure Inter.Co Stadium and protect the Club’s property, guests, teammates, and players. You will help maintain a safe and secure environment while serving as a visible security presence and deterrent to unauthorized or irregular activity.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Patrol Inter.Co Stadium property to monitor and prevent intrusion, damage, hazards, and security breaches.
  • Lock and unlock doors and conduct facility walkthroughs as needed.
  • Provide a visible presence that promotes and enforces safety and security.
  • Monitor activity throughout the facility via closed-circuit television (CCTV).
  • Respond appropriately to emergencies, including but not limited to fire and burglar alarms.
  • Monitor access to the venue on event and non-event days.
  • Assist with event-day security coverage.
  • Identify and address unauthorized persons and violations of security procedures.
  • Contact appropriate authorities regarding unlawful or irregular activity when necessary.
  • Use radios and other communication devices in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Document and report malfunctions, misconduct, incidents, and operational or safety concerns.
  • Interview victims and witnesses and prepare incident reports as necessary.
  • Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Implement prescribed emergency procedures when necessary.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of public safety plans for day-to-day operations and special events.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

It’s never just a job at Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride. It’s a way of life. We live and breathe soccer and entertainment. We believe each role is as unique as the person who does it. To join our team, you will also possess these qualifications:

  • High school diploma, G.E.D., or equivalent required.
  • College coursework in Criminal Justice, Private Investigations, Homeland Security, Emergency Management, Emergency Medical Services, or another security-related field is preferred. Relevant military experience is also preferred.
  • Six (6) months to one (1) year of security experience, preferably in a similar environment.
  • Bilingual in Spanish or Portuguese is preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish rapport and build positive working relationships.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to successfully complete required background screening and employment verification.
  • Valid Florida driver’s license required.
  • Valid Florida Class “D” Security Officer License required.
  • Appropriate credentials as mandated by state, county, or local law.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to walk, run, kneel, climb stairs, and react quickly to unpredictable situations.
  • Must be able to work both indoors and outdoors, including exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Must be able to sit or stand for prolonged periods, including while monitoring surveillance equipment.

The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the core functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing duties, the employee may be regularly required to stand or sit for extended periods, walk long distances, use hands to handle, hold or feel objects, tools, or controls, reach with arms, and talk or hear. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee is required to hear conversations in noisy environments. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. The information contained in this position description is for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (A.D.A) and is not an exhaustive list of the duties performed by persons holding this position. Additional duties are performed by the individuals currently in these positions and may change from time to time considering immediate operational requirements.

Full job description

TITLE:  Sports Turf Specialist, Stadium
DEPARTMENT:  Stadium Operations
REPORTS TO:  Grounds Supervisor
FLSA:  Full-time Hourly; Non-Exempt

What Sets You Apart

Are you a self-motivated individual with physical stamina? Do you love the outdoors and maintaining aesthetically pleasing outdoor space? If so, our Sports Turf Specialist role could be for you. You will be responsible for mowing, fertilization, edging, irrigation troubleshooting and repair, top dressing, aerating, painting, sodding, and record keeping for the Inter.co Stadium. You will get a chance to use a variety of practical skills which are valuable and essential to the overall Club.

  • Assist with all operations of field maintenance at Inter.co Stadium to include painting, mowing, irrigation, aerification, chemical application and any special projects as needed
  • Proactively identify turf grass diseases, weeds, pests, and work with Director of Turf & Grounds and Grounds Supervisor to take corrective action as needed

  • Create and maintain good working relationships with all MLS and NWSL coaches and soccer operations staff
