Job.JobDescription:
Scope of position

The Laundry Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the hotel’s laundry department, ensuring the efficient processing, cleanliness, quality, and timely availability of linens, towels, uniforms, and other laundered items. This position leads and supports the laundry team, maintains department standards, monitors equipment and supplies, and ensures compliance with hotel safety and sanitation procedures.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a resort environment.
  • Effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns and issues raised by team members and hotel guests.
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques and use of equipment/ machinery.
  • Previous housekeeping experience in a large hotel environment preferred.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise, train, schedule, and support laundry department team members to ensure efficient daily operations.
  • Oversee the collection, sorting, washing, drying, folding, pressing, and distribution of hotel linens, towels, uniforms, and other laundry items.
  • Ensure all laundered items meet established cleanliness, quality, and presentation standards.
  • Monitor daily laundry volume and prioritize workloads based on hotel occupancy and operational needs.
  • Inspect linens and other items for stains, damage, excessive wear, or quality concerns and remove items that do not meet standards.
  • Maintain appropriate par levels of clean linens and communicate shortages or operational concerns to Housekeeping leadership.
  • Operate and monitor commercial laundry equipment safely and efficiently, including washers, dryers, presses, folders, and related equipment.
  • Perform routine inspections of laundry equipment and report maintenance or repair needs promptly.
  • Ensure proper use and storage of laundry chemicals and supplies in accordance with manufacturer instructions and safety standards.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary laundry facility at all times.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, OSHA requirements, safety procedures, and applicable health and sanitation standards.
  • Maintain accurate records related to laundry production, inventory, equipment issues, and other departmental activities.
  • Communicate effectively with Housekeeping, Rooms Division, Maintenance, and other departments regarding linen needs and operational priorities.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, and a positive work environment.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Education

  • High school diploma.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language (Second language is a plus).
  • Ability to perform assigned duties with attention to detail, speed, and accuracy.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.
  • Able to perform multiple tasks.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be physically fit to lift, pull, and push items up to 50 pounds.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift (up to 8 hours).

Qualifications

Job.JobTitle: Cook 3 - The Venetian Chop House - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Line Cook / Prep Cook, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
Scope of Position

The Venetian Chop House Cook 3 position requires a highly professional and dependable individual with well-rounded culinary experience and a strong commitment to quality. The ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of food safety and sanitation standards, proper food presentation, and the ability to accurately follow recipes and established procedures while consistently maintaining quality.

Position Requirements

  • Must possess outstanding guest services skills, professional presentation, and sophisticated communication skills.
  • Ability to handle a multitude of tasks in an intense, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to maintain composure and objectivity while under pressure.
  • Effective at handling problems in the workplace, including anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving problems as necessary.
  • Effectively listen to, understand, and clarify any concerns and/or issues raised by coworkers and guests.
  • Flexible in terms of working hours.
  • Able to assimilate complex information, including data from disparate sources and consider, adjust, or modify to meet the constraints of a particular need.
  • A food handling certification must be completed within the first 90 days of employment.

Responsibilities

  • Knowledge of meat identification and cookery for various cuts of beef, pork, veal, lamb, poultry, and corresponding cooking techniques.
  • Knowledge of fresh and saltwater fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and various mixed cooking techniques. Poaching, simmering, deep-frying, baking, broiling, sautéing, and pan-frying.
  • Knowledge of vegetable preparation. e.g., various cutting techniques such as brunoise, paysanne, dice, allumette, battonet, mince, julienne, Parisian, noissette. A solid knowledge of proper cooking preparations, boiling, blanching, steaming, grilling, pan frying, baking, and deep-frying.
  • Knowledge and ability to prepare different methods of starch cookery. e.g., risotto, rice, potatoes (croquettes, berny, marcaire, pont- neuf, dauphinoise, dauphine, château, duchesse) polenta, and pasta.
  • Knowledge of identification, classification, and preparation of mother sauces e.g., hollandaise, béchamel, tomato, Espanola, and velouté.
  • Knowledge and ability to identify and prepare secondary sauces such as Mornay, chasseur, choron, beurre blance, marchand de vin, curry and normande.
  • Knowledge of pantry positions products i.e., lettuce identification, classical salad presentation and preparations. 
  • Knowledge in identification and preparation of basic soups such as consommé, clear, cream, puree, bisques, and chowders as well as speciality and national soups using the various and proper thickening agents.
  • Must stay current and up to date with trends.
  • Approach all interactions with guests and employees in a friendly, service-oriented manner.
  • Maintain refrigerators and kitchen in clean, organized manner with all food items labeled and dated to facilitate the necessary production to achieve company goals.
  • Knowledge of Cook 1 and 2 performance objectives, as well as technical skills.
  • Must stay current and up to date with trends.
  • Follow Occupational Health & Safety Administration (OSHA) Regulations including thorough knowledge of food safety with critical control temperatures, danger zones, cross contamination, sanitation, food borne illness, toxins, and chemical poisoning.
  • Has basic knowledge and timely skills of various knife-cutting techniques, such as cutting, dicing, and slicing.
  • Must supply their own basic tools of the trade, i.e., Chef’s knife, paring knife, peeler, etc.
  • Refined skill set in the knowledge and preparation of garnishes.
  • Ensure equipment and kitchen cleanliness.
  • Keep production of food at an adequate level to prevent excess leftovers and waste.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with the Hotel’s Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the Hotel.
  • Perform any other reasonable requests made by your manager or supervisor.

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Culinary certification or degree preferred and/or a minimum of 3 – 4 years of culinary experience.

  Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language (second language is a plus).
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques and use of equipment and machinery.
  • Willing to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.
  • Ability to multi-task and think clearly in high stress and intense situations.

Physical Requirements

  • Physical agility and ability to move quickly in confined spaces.
  • Requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.
  • Ability to push/pull 100 lbs.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Stand or walk for extended periods of time.
  • Work in areas of high heat and humidity.

Scope of Position

The Group Housing Coordinator position represents Caribe Royale Orlando and Buena Vista Suites to meeting planners and multiple internal departments. The position is responsible for meeting planners and internal departmental communication, managing group blocks, understanding group contracts, providing internal and external reporting, and entering rooming lists among other things. This position must be able to communicate efficiently and professionally with guests, meeting planners, and other departments via email or phone while answering any questions and/or concerns with positive customer service.

Position Requirements

  • Must possess outstanding guest service skills, professional presentation, and sophisticated communication skills.
  • Must be able to handle a multitude of tasks in an intense, ever-changing environment.
  • Must be flexible in terms of working hours.
  • Must work well in high-pressure situations.
  • Must maintain composure and objectivity under pressure.
  • Must be effective at handling problems in the workplace, including anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving problems as necessary.
  • Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying the concerns and issues raised by coworkers and guests.

Responsibilities

  • Assist hotel group guests to ensure a successful event by being the housing and billing contact from the signing of the contract through departure.
  • Maintain professionalism through all communication mediums and interdepartmental collaborations.
  • Process all reservation requests, changes, and cancellations received by phone, email, or in person.
  • Identify meeting planner’s reservation needs, determine appropriate room type, and verify availability of room type and rate.
  • Use the hotel’s group contract for the meeting to ensure the special rate, hotel policies, all concessions, and contracted items are addressed and taken care of regarding guestrooms.
  • Accommodate and document special requests/ changes.
  • Set-up proper billing accounts
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Ensure uniform and personal appearances are clean and professional.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets.
  • Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
  • Ensure information entered into the Hotel’s Sales System downloads into the Hotel’s property management system correctly and matches the contract.
  • Create blocks in Passkey for downloading rooming lists and / or creating booking links.
  • Responsible for monitoring blocks in Passkey and the property management system.
  • Responsible for sending meeting planner reports pertaining to their blocks. This includes, but is not restricted to pick up, VIP assignments, audits, and any other requested information.
  • Responsible for sending an introduction to group contact once the group has been assigned.
  • Attend weekly meetings with the revenue team to give pertinent group information.
  • Attend formal meetings pertaining to the group that is assigned (Resume meetings, pre-plannings, Pre-convention meetings, etc.).
  • Effectively manage time without compromising service.
  • Demonstrates and adheres to company values.
  • Perform any other duties as requested by management.

Education

  • High School diploma and/or experience in a hotel or a related field preferred.

Skills and Abilities

  • Able to communicate in the English language; Second language is a plus.
  • Willing to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.
  • Proficient in performing multiple tasks and assigning/delegating tasks to associates.
  • Experience using software programs such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Previous knowledge of PMS system preferred, including Opera or similar programs.

Physical Requirements

  • On a continuous basis, sit at a desk for long periods of time in front of a computer screen.
  • Intermittently twist to reach equipment or supplies surrounding desk.
  • Use telephone and computer keyboard on a daily basis.
  • Must be physically fit in order to lift, pull and push items up to 50 pounds.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.

Scope of Position

The Purchasing & Receiving Clerk is responsible for assisting with the procurement of goods and services, receiving and inspecting deliveries, and maintaining accurate inventory records. This position ensures that all items are ordered, received, and stored in accordance with company standards regulations.

Position Requirements

  • Previous warehouse experience preferred.
  • Fort Lift Certification is a plus.
  • General knowledge of Excel/Word/Outlook.

  • Assist in sourcing and ordering food, beverage, housekeeping, maintenance, and other supplies.

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends and able to perform multiple tasks.

Physical Requirements

  • On a continuous basis, sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time.
  • Intermittently twist to reach equipment or supplies.
  • Use the telephone and computer keyboard daily.
  • Must be physically fit in to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 100lbs and push carts ranging from 200lbs – 500lbs.

The Housekeeping Supervisor will inspect guest rooms, etc. after being cleaned by a Suite Attendant to ensure quality standards. The Housekeeping Supervisor will act as a leader to all housekeeping personnel and assist with guest/Associate issues.

Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort—the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore is Orlando’s ultimate game changer. In a city known for its theme parks and endless lines, Evermore is the paradise guests crave on their days between park visits. Imagine endless relaxation around Orlando’s first and only beach paradise, Evermore Bay. Our stunning 8-acre crystal-clear lagoon is framed by zero-entry swim zones, beach bars, private cabanas, cozy firepits, and 20-acres of white sand. From beachside bars to a vibrant food hall and rooftop dining with views of the fireworks, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences. Guests can challenge themselves on 2 Jack Nicklaus championship golf courses, enjoy water sports including kayaks and paddleboards, a family water slide, rope swing, and activities that fill their days including pickleball, bocce ball, and volleyball.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities: 

  • The starter will provide a warm and welcoming greeting to the start of our guests’ round of golf.
  • Observe the pace of play on the course and take proactive steps to ensure groups maintain a reasonable pace to prevent bottlenecks and delays.
  • Communicate with golfers to encourage adherence to course policies, maintaining a positive and respectful tone throughout interactions.
  • Offer exceptional customer service, addressing golfer inquiries, concerns, and requests professionally and courteously.
  • Provide assistance and guidance to golfers on matters such as course layout, distances, and local rules.
  • Maintain effective communication with the golf shop and other staff to manage player flow and address any issues promptly.
  • Coordinate with the golf shop to ensure a smooth transition of golfers from the Golf Shop to the first tee.
  • Provide the necessary information for guests to enjoy the golf experience.
  • Be prepared with the necessary supplies (tees, pencils, scorecards, ballmarks, etc..) for our guests.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education, Skills, and Experience 

  • Must have Golf Knowledge and be familiar with most golf terminology.
  • Attention to detail is a must.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be highly organized and able to perform multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Problem solving and critical thinking.
  • Inspired to always represent Evermore brand values and standards.
  • Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines/ instructions in English.
  • Sees the extra mile as their starting point in each interaction.
  • Ability to foster relationships with teammates, potential clients, and resort guests.
  • Comfortable with starting and maintaining conversations with guests and Team Members.
  • Maintain the resort’s integrity and prestige by complying with all golf, sales and operational standards, policies, procedures, manuals, memos and instructions.
  • Must be able to work weekends, rotating schedule and holidays.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with guests to enhance the scope of their experience and diffuse and resolve guests' concerns.

Physical Requirements:  

  • Must be able to safely and effectively navigate a 1100-acre resort in order to facilitate and host events and guests as required.
  • Must be able to lift 25lbs.
  • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and reach periodically.
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including exposure to sun, wind, rain, and other elements.

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including  FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.

Department of Transportation (DOT) & Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Requirements:

The Department of Transportation (DOT) and the Federal Motor Safety Carrier Safety Administration (FMSCA) have stringent requirements for Commercial Driver's License (CDL) drivers to ensure safety on the roads. These requirements encompass various aspects, including qualifications, medical standards, testing, and ongoing compliance. DOT and FMSCA require CDL drivers to undergo mandatory drug and alcohol testing as per regulations, including pre-employment, random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion testing. This process can be facilitated through the Human Resources Team or an appropriate third-party provider. These requirements may include, but are not limited to:

  • Shuttle Drivers may be required to obtain a CDL, especially if the shuttle vehicle has a seating capacity exceeding a certain threshold.
  • DOT regulations may require shuttle drivers to pass a DOT medical examination to ensure they are physically fit to operate commercial vehicles.
  • Compliance with DOT regulations regarding the maximum number of hours a driver can drive a commercial vehicle, as well as mandatory rest breaks.
  • Pre-employment, random or post-accident drug and alcohol testing is required.

It's important for resort management to ensure that shuttle drivers are aware of and compliant with all relevant DOT and FMCSA regulations to maintain safety and legal compliance. Specific requirements may vary depending on the location and type of shuttle operations.

Position Summary:  The Executive Director of Finance is responsible for developing and executing financial organizational strategies for the Evermore brand. Will manage financial and accounting information, controlling assets, internal audits, operating budget, capital expenditure budget, critical measurements, quality control, thorough analysis reporting, strategic thinking, and establishing critical measurements that will drive revenue and achieve financial strategic goals. Will report directly to the Managing Director of the resort, providing financial insights and updates regularly, and partner with the Dart ownership CFO to ensure the program is designed to meet strategic objectives and operational requirements and is positioned for successful adoption across the resort.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the development of financial objectives in line with the resort's strategic goals.
  • Monitor and direct the implementation of strategic business plans in partnership with the Managing Director.
  • Responsible for end-to-end program governance, executive stakeholder management, and the integrated delivery of all workstreams, including ERP implementation, service delivery model transformation, process standardization, data governance, and change management.
  • Serve as the executive leader for Evermore's ERP and finance transformation initiative, overseeing program governance, integrated delivery across workstreams (ERP implementation, process standardization, data governance, and change management), program budget and capex governance, and coordination with the ERP vendor, system integrator, and advisory partners.
  • Assist Asset Management (ownership) as needed with financial modelling on existing assets, development opportunities, and potential acquisitions.
  • Produce timely and accurate financial and analytical reports for executive, asset, operational, and financial management teams.
  • Oversee the planning and execution of capital expenses for the resort. This includes making investment decisions, budgeting, and ensuring that capital projects are completed within budget and timelines.
  • Plan, facilitate, review, distribute, and/or present budgeting and cash forecasting activities and reports.
  • Guide department leaders in business strategy, budgeting, and forecasting. Establish and manage procedures to work collaboratively with the department managers to ensure that their financial reports accurately reflect the operational activities and that variances from budgets are appropriately captured, investigated, and reported.
  • Assist in the development, documentation, implementation, and compliance aspects of an effective internal controls system, including written policies, standard operating procedures, and forms.
  • Assist in cash management and treasury activities, including banking, funding, debt, and intercompany transfers.
  • Coordinate the maintenance and support of IT systems, applications, access, and controls with responsible parties to ensure efficient, secure, and productive use of resources and equipment.
  • Establish procedures for effectively managing intercompany transactions and allocations.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements, along with full working papers for the consolidated group of companies in accordance with US GAAP.
  • Oversee and support the Resort Director of Accounting in managing the accounting operations.
  • Oversee CAM: Will handle the Common Area Maintenance (CAM) responsibilities for both Hyatt and Hilton, Conrad, ensuring that their financial requirements and obligations are met in accordance with their respective contracts.
  • Will ensure Evermore is adequately covered by insurance and that contractual obligations are fulfilled.
  • Property Taxes: Will possess in-depth knowledge of property taxes and play a crucial role in managing and optimizing the resort's tax liabilities while complying with applicable tax regulations.
  • Golf Course Management: Will manage finances for Grand Cypress golf in coordination with the Director of Golf Operations.
  • Oversee and support the Resort Director of Accounting in managing the accounting operations.
  • Provide accurate accounting processes with financial integrity based on federal, local, and state laws.
  • Lead and support Evermore’s accounting team, including hiring, training, performance evaluation, and professional development of the staff.
  • Evermore financial information will be consolidated within a larger group of Dart companies so coordination with other Dart accounting and tax teams will be required.
  • Ensure compliance with all tax, regulatory, and contractual obligations as required.
  • Ensure that all accounting processes – including accounts payable and receivable, payroll, cash management, capitalization, general ledger, and tax - are appropriately completed in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Auditing: Will audit the resort's financial records for accuracy and compliance, and subject to periodic operations audits to maintain financial integrity and transparency.
  • Collaborate with Hilton, corporate, and Conrad leadership team to ensure the financial direction aligns with Evermore’s operation strategy, execution, and goal setting.
  • Be a visible leader to all operations teams, attend events, and interact with guests and team members.
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers.
  • Must be willing to work some weekends and evenings, with occasional travel expected.
  • Stay up to date on the hospitality industry in the resort/vacation rental space for benchmarking and new ideas, and be active in key industry organizations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education, Skills, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, preferably with a master’s degree or an MBA.
  • 10+ years of resort/hospitality finance experience in a high-volume resort with a preference for luxury, independents, similar vacation homes, and golf resorts.
  • Expertise in managing property taxes and capital expenses for large properties.
  • Strong financial acumen and the ability to analyze and interpret financial data, create budgets, and make strategic financial decisions.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal, are crucial for presenting financial information to stakeholders and interacting with team members, management, and ownership.

  • Resonate with the Evermore brand and values and carry them daily.

Full job description

216566

Worker Type

Regular Employee

Studio/Department

Finance

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

EA's CFO organization comprises a broad group of finance disciplines. Our common goal is partnership with business teams delivering strategies and providing our players with amazing experiences. All of our finance teams assist the business in achieving profitable creativity by providing financial insight, reporting and guidance.

We use progressive tools to analyze and visualize data, telling the story of financial drivers, performance, risks and opportunities. We value attributes like collaboration and learning. We celebrate inclusion by creating a place where you can come to work and be yourself. Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team provides strategic partnerships to leaders across EA. We do this by engaging with our partners to understand our broad strategy, analyzing data, and delivering insights to help guide EA's performance.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As Finance Director, you will lead the Tiburon Studios Finance team, supporting Madden HD and Mobile, College Football HD and Mobile, and Project Gridiron. Reporting to the Sr. Director of American Football / Catalyst FP&A, this role serves as a strategic finance partner to studio executives, shaping franchise strategy, investment priorities, and financial performance across the portfolio.

You will oversee financial planning and performance management for Tiburon Studios while driving alignment across American Football and Catalyst. As the senior Finance leader in Orlando, you will have significant autonomy and influence in translating business strategy into financial and operational outcomes.

This Orlando-based role follows a hybrid schedule, defined as three days per week and requires strong commercial judgment, executive-level communication, and cross-functional leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with American Football studio, product, commercial, and executive leadership to shape franchise strategy, prioritize investments, allocate resources, and optimize returns.

  • Own financial performance across the American Football portfolio, including P&L management, long-range and annual planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and executive reporting. Identify risks and opportunities, evaluate trade-offs, and guide strategic decisions.

  • Leverage franchise economics, player behavior, monetization trends, and key business drivers to develop financial strategies and recommendations that support growth and profitability.

  • Lead consolidated financial planning and performance management across American Football and Catalyst.

  • Lead the Orlando Finance team as the senior on-site Finance representative, partnering with studio leadership on key business decisions while developing a high-performing team through coaching, empowerment, and accountability.

  • Champion continuous improvement across FP&A through process simplification, automation, and standardization to improve efficiency, scalability, transparency.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment analysis, corporate finance, or a related field; gaming experience helpful.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior executives, influencing strategic business decisions, and leading cross-functional initiatives in complex organizations.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing finance professionals, including leading distributed teams and influencing across organizational boundaries.

  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills, including driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, business case development, investment evaluation, and full P&L management.

  • Knowledge of accounting principles and GAAP.

  • Experience with BI and planning tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, or similar platforms, and use of AI-enabled solutions to improve reporting, enhance forecasting accuracy, and automate routine processes.

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Central Technology is the force multiplier, accelerating creative opportunity and progress at EA. We’re a world-class community of technologists, innovators, strategists, and orchestrators transforming interactive entertainment. Together, we power the platforms, AI-driven tools, live services, and infrastructure that ensure global scale, secure player experiences, and unlock bold new possibilities.

EA Security protects our players, employees, products, and platforms. We set security standards, support game and enterprise teams, assess risk across partners and systems, and ensure compliance with global requirements. Our work strengthens system integrity, supports fair play, and enables teams to build and operate securely at scale.

As a DevSecOps Architect, you will lead reliability, operational excellence, and infrastructure architecture across our enterprise security platforms and AI security operations ecosystem. Partnering with our Lead Systems Architect, you will build resilient platforms and serve as the operational owner for our AI SOC assistant, supporting our Security Operations, Incident Response, and Threat Intelligence teams.

Responsibilities

  • Manage availability, change control, automated recovery, and incident runbooks across SIEM, forwarder fleets, and detection pipelines.

  • Standardize deployments and container orchestration using Terraform, Ansible, and Docker to eliminate operational friction.

  • Conduct design reviews and author architecture decision records with leadership to eliminate single points of failure.

  • Build microservices, CLI utilities, and middleware connecting security platforms, data pipelines, and orchestration engines.

  • Serve as primary technical point of contact and service owner for teams using our AI security assistant.

  • Investigate platform anomalies and user reports across prompts, harnesses, configurations, and code.

  • Resolve platform and harness issues with test-backed code fixes to prevent recurring failures.

  • Author defect tickets with session IDs, execution traces, payload samples, and reproduction steps for developers.

  • Track and optimize token consumption, model inference costs, and prompt caching in AWS Bedrock.

  • Maintain FAQs, how-to documentation, and best-practice guides based on user questions and operational patterns.

  • Design Splunk dashboards and alerting suites tracking platform health, ingestion lag, LLM latency, and adoption.

  • Analyze OpenTelemetry distributed traces and JSON logs to pinpoint API latency and harness failures.

  • Partner with detection engineers to validate detection logic and telemetry feeds against production benchmarks.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience supporting high-availability production platforms, automated alerts, incident response, and change management.

  • Experience developing API integrations, asynchronous workflows, automated tests, and modular tools in Python, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js.

  • Experience analyzing logs, distributed traces, JSON payloads, and APIs using Splunk, Grafana, Datadog, Elastic, curl, or Postman.

  • Experience with LLM mechanics, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, and resolving AI failure modes.

  • Experience designing system architecture and resolving production code issues across enterprise platforms.

Core Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with Splunk Search Processing Language (SPL), dashboard creation, and operational alerting.

  • Experience with SOC alert triage workflows, incident response lifecycles, and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

  • Experience working with agentic frameworks or LLM SDKs such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.

  • Experience with LLM evaluation datasets and observability frameworks such as Phoenix, LangSmith, or Langfuse.

  • Experience configuring prompt caching, model quotas, and token monitoring in cloud AI suites like AWS Bedrock.

  • Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) instrumentation and trace evaluation.

  • Experience automating workflows across Splunk SOAR, SentinelOne, Tanium, or n8n.

  • Experience in internal customer success, platform advocacy, or technical service ownership

Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Central Technology is the force multiplier, accelerating creative opportunity and progress at EA. We’re a world-class community of technologists, innovators, strategists, and orchestrators transforming interactive entertainment. Together, we power the platforms, AI-driven tools, live services, and infrastructure that ensure global scale, secure player experiences, and unlock bold new possibilities.

EA Security protects our players, employees, products, and platforms. We set security standards, support game and enterprise teams, assess risk across partners and systems, and ensure compliance with global requirements. Our work strengthens system integrity, supports fair play, and enables teams to build and operate securely at scale.

The Red Team Director is a highly technical leadership role for the team that plays a critical part in finding the biggest threats to EA’s security, making EA a secure place to work for our 20,000+ people across 38+ global sites. In addition to “classic” Red Team activities and pen testing, this role will help build out an application security program that scales enterprise-wide with a focus on automation and best-practices. We’re a Red Team that can find the worst of the worst, knows what’s most likely to be attractive to attackers, and we roll up our slaves to make things better. 

This role reports into the Vice President of the Enterprise Security Team and you will have direct access to leaders across the security team, IT, production and the studios. You will play a key role in setting EA’s Enterprise security strategy, and you’ll be an ally to all our partners.  And this includes collaborative work across the gaming industry in a common effort to let gaming companies focus on building amazing games, while keeping the bad actors at bay.

The Head of the Red Team will work with many teams across EA, but will partner extensively with our vulnerability management leaders, incident response, threat hunters, and security operations team.  

Primary Responsibilities

  • Respond to emerging threats such as APT and other forms of targeted attacks, organised crime, etc.

  • Plan and conduct attacks on internally or externally hosted applications and infrastructure on a global scale with an emphasis on critical functions targeted by adversaries.

  • Design and develop scripts, frameworks, tools and the methods required for facilitating and executing application security assessments

  • Active participation in attack analysis duties as part of security incident response. This allows this team to remain abreast of the latest adversary TTPs.

  • Assemble and coordinate with the IR Ops and other teams at EA to resolve security incidents as quickly and efficiently as possible.

  • Communicate status of missions and Red Team activities to EA Security leadership and studio leadership.

  • Ensure effective knowledge management of findings and review results of any attack campaign in order to determine severity of findings and identify potential remediation or mitigation strategies.

  • Staying current on attack techniques and understands published and emerging real-life attack scenarios.

  • Mentor and train more junior staff in attack techniques, tool/exploit development, intelligence analysis and adversarial tactics.

  • Communicate effectively with representatives of the Lines of Business, technology specialists, and vendors.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Be an amazing leader and attractor of high-caliber technical talent

  • A proven ability to build relationships across the business and drive change through these relationships

  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to tailor engagements for different types of businesses, leaders.

  • Build and deliver successful security programs from the ground up

  • Plan quarterly roadmaps, make hard trade-offs and communicate them well, manage work, build up and out reporting and business rhythm

  • Building and deploying flexible automation frameworks 

  • 7-10+ years experience in at least 3 of the following (and knowledge of remainder):

    • Technical understanding of tools similar to Cobalt Strike, BURP, Bloodhound

    • Web Penetration Testing (injection, XSS, validation, session mgmt, web services etc.

    • Database (Oracle, MSSQL, and MySQL: hosting, configuration, etc.);

    • Network (protocols, traffic analysis, wireless, etc.);

    • Operating System (UNIX, Solaris, Linux, Mac, Windows: configuration, file system, etc.);

    • Development (coding, scripting, SQL, computer architecture, exploit writing, code analysis);

    • Application Analysis (fuzzing, reverse engineering, disassembling (IDA, OllyDbg);

    • Crypto (password cracking, encryption, algorithm analysis).

The Challenge Ahead

At Electronic Arts, we bring together creators, storytellers, and technologists to deliver extraordinary experiences to players around the world.

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead Finance support for EA's Information Technology (EAIT) and Security organizations. You'll partner with our Chief Information Officer (CIO), CISO and their leadership teams to guide technology investments, resource allocation, and financial performance.

We're looking for someone who understands the business behind the numbers, asks thoughtful questions, develops talent, and helps leaders make informed decisions.

Role Overview:

The Senior Manager, FP&A – Central Technology leads financial planning, analysis, and business partnership activities across EA's Information Technology organization.

Reporting to the Senior Director of FP&A for Central Technology, you will serve as IT and Security’s primary Finance partner, supporting business priorities and investment decisions while maintaining financial accountability. You will follow a hybrid work schedule, defined as three days a week from an Electronic Arts office.

You will manage a team of Finance professionals and improve how financial planning and reporting processes integrate with the broader Central Technology organization.

Responsibilities:

Finance Partnership & Decision Support

  • Be a member of EAIT and Security's extended leadership team, bringing a financial perspective to business strategy, technology investments, resource allocation, and operating efficiency to help shape business decisions. 
  • Partner with executives to evaluate business cases and financial trade-offs, providing recommendations that support informed decisions. 
  • Build an understanding of business operations, priorities, and cost structures to identify opportunities to improve financial and operational performance. 

Financial Planning & Performance Management

  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and performance management processes, ensuring financial accuracy and supporting our business goals. 
  • Oversee financial management across workforce expenses, software licensing, infrastructure, cloud services, capital investments, and other technology expenditures. 
  • Work with business leaders to evaluate financial performance, manage financial risks, and identify opportunities for cost optimization. 

Team Leadership & FP&A Evolution

  • Manage and coach a team of Finance professionals, establishing clear accountabilities and building their financial, technical, and business-partnering capabilities. 
  • Improve FP&A processes across Central Technology through greater consistency, automation, and integration. 
  • Promote the use of data analytics, AI, and financial technologies to improve productivity and decision support. 
  • Guide team members with specialized technical skills and partner with Finance Transformation and technology teams to create sustainable, data-driven solutions. 

What You Bring:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • 8+ years of experience in FP&A or financial management. 
  • Experience supporting senior business leaders and managing or developing Finance teams. 

Financial & Technical Capabilities

  • Knowledge of financial planning, forecasting, financial modeling, accounting principles, and investment analysis. 
  • Experience with enterprise financial systems and reporting tools. Familiarity with Oracle, Anaplan, or Power BI is helpful. 
  • Understanding of how data analytics, automation, and AI can improve financial processes, including experience guiding work performed by technical specialists. 

Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Experience presenting financial analyses and recommendations to senior leaders to support business decisions. 
  • Ability to connect financial results with business operations, question assumptions, and recommend improvements. 
  • Experience independently managing financial responsibilities and prioritizing work across multiple business partners. 
  • Commitment to coaching employees, building collaborative relationships, and improving how Finance supports the business.

About Mobile

Welcome to EA Mobile, home to developers working on iconic franchises such as Plants vs. Zombies, Design Home, Star Wars, Sim City, Golf Clash, Pogo, and more. At EA Mobile, we value creativity, continuous learning, data-driven decision-making, and strong product knowledge. We are looking for passionate individuals who thrive in a growth-oriented environment and are committed to collaborating in dynamic teams to deliver compelling experiences to millions of players worldwide.

People Experience

Most companies call it HR. But at Electronic Arts, we made the deliberate decision to brand our organization People Experience or PE. PE is not just a play on words: it's a team of cultural stewards who carefully create programs and talent strategies that directly impact our teams' experience. For the better. We enable our People to achieve the most meaningful work of their careers. We're responsible for recruiting the best and most diverse talent on the planet. But it doesn't stop there. We also support their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation, and leadership development. We listen to our employees and dive into analytics to anchor our recommendations and decisions to keep engagement high. Last but not least, we're responsible for a total rewards strategy that incentivizes equitably, provides outstanding benefits, and ensures a safe and inspiring workplace for our teams.

The Challenge Ahead:

The Director, People Experience Business Partner for EA Mobile reports to the Senior Director, Lifestyle/Mobile, and drives talent strategy and the People Experience roadmap in partnership with Mobile's senior leadership team. The Director, PE Business Partner serves as a strategic advisor to senior leaders, bringing commercial insight, organizational expertise, and sound judgment to complex business and talent decisions. This role requires the ability to navigate a dynamic, matrixed environment, influence across functions, and translate business priorities into actionable People strategies that strengthen organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and long-term business performance.

You will take leadership roles on EA-wide People Experience programs and related project teams. This is a hybrid remote/in-office role requiring at least three days per week.

What the PE Business Partner does at EA:

  • Designs a comprehensive talent strategy with executives to ensure successful execution of goals, aligned with Company Talent strategy.
  • You will partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COE's) that comprise our Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent Development and Organizational Effectiveness teams to develop and facilitate strategic talent solutions from hiring through career progression.
  • Change Management: Coaches executives and leaders to plan for change management, optimizing for the employee experience, and working through organizational design to create role clarity at the individual and team level.
  • You implement complex change programs for client group(s). Educate management and key stakeholders on best practices in change management. Orchestrate full circle review of change impact to ensure change acceptance.
  • Talent and Workforce Planning solutions: You lead efforts to identify potential successors for important roles and leadership positions. Promote attraction, retention, and development of talent.
  • Culture and Employee Experience: Help establish and foster EA culture, improving programs, diagnostics, and related training/coaching engagements, to develop EAs overall capability to foster a healthy, cohesive, collaborative, fun and equitable workplace. Is accountable for all ER-related issues in assigned client group(s). Work with managers, employees and appropriate others to respond to all employee relations issues in ways that foster a cohesive and enjoyable workplace.
  • You help create insightful approaches to employee recognition and rewards; can assess market data to guide compensation decisions, and are creative about ways outside of compensation to provide meaningful reward and recognition. Is accountable for the successful implementation of the life cycle of the performance and compensation process across all assigned client group(s). Understand concepts of unvested equity and vesting timelines as it relates to compensation.
  • Organizational Effectiveness: Identifies gaps hindering achievement of outcomes and ensures business is focused on solving root cause issues. You work across COEs (as applicable) to develop recommended solutions. Coach, train and fosters management capability
  • Workforce Analytics and Technology: Identifies important metrics to assess and diagnose the health of the organization. You apply knowledge of HR metrics and uses data from several tools (e.g. Workday, etc.) to assess and influence decisions.

The next great People Experience, BP at EA also needs to have:

  • Minimum experience: Bachelor or Masters Degree in a relevant field plus 10 or more years of progressive success as a senior strategic HR business partner/manager.
  • Experience managing large-scale HR programs
  • Knowledge leader, with demonstrated mastery in organizational design, change leadership, and talent management.
  • Excellent change management skills - can create clarity and achieve commitments.
  • Can balance compassion and toughness in coaching others.
  • Good understanding of local employment law, coupled with the ability to gain a high level understanding of territorial employment customs and practices working with EA's worldwide HR team.
  • Passion for creating healthy organizations, driving transformation and helping culture be a competitive advantage.

Together, we power the platforms, AI-driven tools, live services, and infrastructure that ensure global scale, secure player experiences, and unlock bold new possibilities.

EA Security protects our players, employees, products, and platforms. We set security standards, support game and enterprise teams, assess risk across partners and systems, and ensure compliance with global requirements. Our work strengthens system integrity, supports fair play, and enables teams to build and operate securely at scale.

The Senior Security Software Engineer II reports to the Director, Developer Security in the Developer Security team. 

This role is aimed at engineers who operate beyond the scope of a single team or service. You will be responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering solutions to complex, often ambiguous problems that span multiple systems and teams. You will help define and evolve the internal platforms that enable EA teams to build, ship, and operate software securely at scale. This includes working across software engineering, platform engineering, and SRE concerns, with a strong focus on developer experience, system reliability, and operational excellence.

Our environment is intentionally polyglot, and you’ll be expected to work pragmatically across multiple languages, frameworks, and infrastructure rather than specialising in a single stack. Success in this role is measured not just by the code you write, but by the impact you have on how systems are designed, how teams operate, and how effectively engineers across the organisation can deliver high-quality software.

You will play a key role in shaping the platforms and systems that power how EA builds and operates software. Your work will influence not just a single team, but how multiple teams across the company deliver reliable, secure, and scalable services to millions of players.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive large, cross-cutting technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, and domains

  • Define and break down ambiguous problem spaces, and lead them through to practical, high-impact solutions

  • Design and evolve internal platforms and shared services that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience

  • Establish and promote engineering patterns and best practices in areas such as system design, observability, and service reliability

  • Lead architectural decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs across performance, reliability, cost, and speed of delivery

  • Contribute directly to critical parts of the system where deep technical expertise is required

  • Improve how systems are operated in production, including monitoring, incident response, and long-term reliability improvements

  • Influence technical direction across teams through design reviews, collaboration, and hands-on leadership

  • Mentor engineers at multiple levels, particularly Senior engineers, helping to raise the overall technical bar

  • Partner with teams across EA to understand workflows and remove friction through better platform design and tooling

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ Years experience building and operating distributed systems at scale, with a strong understanding of production challenges and failure modes

  • A track record of delivering complex technical initiatives across multiple teams or domains, not just within a single codebase

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep proficiency in at least one modern programming language and the ability to work across others

  • Experience working across a broad, polyglot technology stack, for example:

and cross-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences

that ignite the emotion of sport through industry-leading sports video games,

EA SPORTS UFC .

About the Role:

The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high-fidelity consumer experiences.

Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.

Your Responsibilities:

Experience Strategy:

  • Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long-term, multi-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.

  • Consumer-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.

  • Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.

Connected Fan Experiences:

  • Unified Journeys: Map and refine end-to-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.

  • Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.

  • Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.

  • Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.

  • Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.

Experience Innovation & Data Informed Design:

  • Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next-generation interaction models, including AI-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real-time sports feed integrations.

  • Data-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.

Your Qualifications:

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world-class, large-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.

  • Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.

  • Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.

  • Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.

  • Tooling & Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.

  • Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

Your Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development or DevOps engineering experience.

  • 5+ years of experience with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.

  • 3+ years of programming experience with C++

  • 3+ years of experience developing automation for large-scale or live-service environments.

  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with one or more cloud providers such as AWS, GCP, or Azure (multi-cloud experience preferred).

  • Experience with Perforce and/or Git version control workflows.

  • Experience building and maintaining monitoring and alerting systems (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or CloudWatch).

  • Strong understanding of networking, security practices, and environment isolation.

  • Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment.

  • A passion for automation, developer enablement, and building reliable systems that scale.

  • Knowledge of Unreal Engine and its build and development ecosystem (e.g., Unreal Build Tool, Unreal Automation Tool, Horde, SubmitTool) is desired.

Bonus

  • Experience in multiplayer and live games.

  • Experience with artifact management, distributed caching, and CI parallelization.

  • Familiarity with secure software development practices, including secrets management and automated security scanning.

  • Experience supporting game or real-time service build pipelines for console and PC platforms.

  • Desire to mentor engineers and advocate for continuous improvement in automation and DevOps processes.

  • Passion for continual learning and growing in your career.

Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Electronic Arts Inc. is a leading global interactive entertainment software company. EA delivers games, content and online services for Internet-connected consoles, personal computers, mobile phones and tablets.

EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment with over 25 years of innovation, passion, and connecting millions of players across the globe to their favorite sports, teams, and players.  

We are looking for a Messaging Artist who is passionate about solving complex problems and building experiences to delight our players.

Responsibilities:

  • Design Brand and simple graphic design systems and elements for American Football Live Art team.
  • Collaborate & cooperate with a team to create a multitude of design themes for programs that reflect our game.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage time to meet content scheduling requirements.
  • Work with a cross-disciplinary team and partner with different groups to set priorities and develop design solutions to meet business goals within technical limitations.
  • Understanding the American football audience works with its games as a service/live service model and make use of this knowledge in the development of art content.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in design, marketing, or related studies.
  • 2+ years of experience in graphic design or visual design.
  • Proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, and other design software.
  • Experience with Figma, Miro and other collaborative tools is a plus.
  • Understanding of composition, grid, color theory, typography, and layout design.
  • You are comfortable presenting cohesive design approaches and iterating based on feedback.
  • Knowledge of football & video games are beneficial, but are not a requirement.
  • 3d & motion graphics are helpful, but not a requirement.
  • It is required you share a portfolio or work samples, inclusive of unique and original designs. Marketing, social media, and ad designs are a bonus.

EA Studios - Respawn

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Founded in 2010 by the original creators of the Call of Duty Franchise, Respawn was created with the philosophy that when talented people have creative freedom, they’ll make extraordinary games that achieve the unexpected. From our roots as an indie studio to joining the expansive roster of studios at Electronic Arts, this remains our guiding principle. We truly love what we do and want to share our passion with players worldwide.

Our shipped titles include critically acclaimed multi-platform games Apex Legends, Titanfall, Titanfall 2, Star Wars™ Jedi: Fallen Order,  Star Wars™ Jedi: Survivor, and Medal of Honor: Above and Beyond.

Join us for the opportunity to create groundbreaking games with some of the best developer talent in the industry.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Jedi team in creating a best-in-class experience for our players. On the Jedi Engineering team, we believe in individual ownership of features, close collaboration with other departments, and prioritizing the player experience.

What you’ll do...

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, modular UI systems, in-game HUDs, menus, and front-end features.

  • Drive PC-specific UI/UX features,owning the holistic experience from the engineering side. This can  include everything from mouse-and-keyboard navigation, dynamic cursor behaviors, comprehensive key remapping, detailed settings menus, and beyond.

  • Be able to proactively identify, diagnose, and solve issues as they arise. This includes both bugs and areas where the player experience can be improved.

  • Collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders - engineers,UI/UX designers, technical artists, technical designers, producers, QA.

  • Contribute to healthy team morale and culture

  • Share and receive opinions about the game as a whole

Ideally, you'll have...

  • 4+ years’ experience in the games industry working as an engineer, with experience in UI/UX.

  • Proficiency in C++.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and adapt to changing project requirements.

  • Familiarity with PC gaming and player expectations on that platform.

  • Familiarity with UX best practices.

  • Passion for making a great player experience.

  • Unreal Engine experience is a major plus, but not required.

If this opportunity sounds like a great fit for you, please submit your resume and we will get back to you once we have reviewed it.

In addition to opportunities for creative impact and professional growth which come with being a member of our team, working at Respawn has many other perks and benefits! Learn more at respawn.com/perks.


Pay Transparency - North America


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). 

PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$122,300 - $170,700 CAD * California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$143,800 - $217,200 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.
In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to temporary employees scheduled to work full time. 
 In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance.

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this role is on-site hybrid (3x per week) in Orlando, FL. Relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top-selling videogame franchises, award-winning interactive technology, fan programs, and cross-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences that ignite the emotion of sport through industry-leading sports video games, including Madden NFL football,  EA SPORTS FC soccer, NHL® hockey, and EA SPORTS UFC.

As a Technical Game Designer on EA SPORTS Madden NFL Football, you’ll be a hands-on creator who builds new presentation features and complex systems. You’ll partner closely with design, engineering, and content teams to prototype, implement, iterate, and polish—from early concept through live tuning. If you're passionate about game design and thrive working with a collaborative team, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with designers, engineers and other creatives to develop the vision and innovate on compelling gameplay systems.
  • Implement and drive gameplay systems and/or modes from concept to ship quality.
  • Align and collaborate with multiple disciplines and communicate the vision of gameplay features.
  • Ensure a high-quality release by bug fixing, balancing, and creating a fun gameplay experience.
  • Pitch ideas, provide feedback and rapid iteration with the team
  • Build all-new innovative Madden experiences (mechanics, modes, progression, meta systems, tuning frameworks, etc.) that integrate cleanly into the core game.
  • Quick prototype building of new features
  • Create robust scripting-driven implementations (logic, state machines, event flows, data setup) that are scalable and maintainable.

Requirements:

  • Experience with scripting languages (such as Lua, Python, Javascript, and/or other scripting languages).
  • Worked on multiple shipped titles as a Technical Designer
  • Passion for crafting gameplay systems, mechanics and game modes.
  • Familiarity, passion and knowledge of American Football and football products.
  • Expertise in comprehending the game design process, specifically with game mechanics and design theory.
  • Experience with content-driven game engines (Unreal, Frostbite, Unity, GtkRadiant).
  • Ability to read and understand C++
  • Experience developing and in a multiplayer live service environment
